Role Description

Job Title: Product Manager Experience: 5+ Years Location: Hyderabad Education: MBA from IIMs Role Overview We are looking for a highly motivated Product Manager to drive product strategy, roadmap planning, and execution. The ideal candidate will have experience managing end-to-end product lifecycles, working closely with engineering, design, business, and customer stakeholders to deliver impactful digital products. Key Responsibilities Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap. Gather and prioritize business and customer requirements. Convert business needs into detailed product requirements and user stories. Collaborate with engineering, UX/UI, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions. Manage product launches and ensure successful adoption. Track key product metrics and drive business outcomes. Required Skills & Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Product Management. About Sibros Technologies

Who We Are

Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.

Learn more at www.sibros.tech.

Our Mission

Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.

Follow us on

LinkedIn | Youtube | Instagram

About The Role

Job Title: Product Manager - Core Platform & Infrastructure

Reporting to: Group Product Manager

Job Type: Full-Time

Experience: 5+ years

As a Product Manager for Core Infrastructure at Sibros, you aren't just managing a backlog - you are the architect of the foundational pipeline that connects vehicles to the cloud. You will sit at the intersection of embedded automotive systems, distributed cloud computing, and business strategy. We are looking for a highly technical product leader who can navigate the complex, high-stakes landscape of modern vehicle architectures. You will own the core platforms that orchestrate flawless over-the-air (OTA) updates, secure remote diagnostics, and resilient vehicle-to-cloud data ingestion, transforming complex technical constraints into a highly reliable, scalable enterprise platform.

What you’ll do

Own the Core Vehicle-to-Cloud Pipeline: Lead the full product lifecycle for our foundational infrastructure products, including OTA orchestration engines and remote command delivery. You will ensure this core platform acts as a rock-solid, extensible foundation that reliably powers all downstream applications built on top of it, such as advanced troubleshooting, predictive maintenance, and fleet management tools.
Optimize Value Delivery: Ruthlessly prioritize the platform backlog. You’ll make the hard trade-off decisions between technical debt, architectural scalability, security compliance, and OEM feature requests to maximize platform ROI.
Define System Boundaries and APIs: Partner closely with Embedded, Cloud, and Security Engineering to define robust APIs, data contracts, and platform abstractions that allow Sibros to integrate seamlessly into diverse OEM vehicle architectures.
Drive Platform Reliability & Scale: Define and track critical platform KPIs (e.g. OTA success rates, command latency, system uptime) and use technical discovery to address architectural bottlenecks proactively.
Autonomous Decision-Making: Act as the primary authority for your platform infrastructure domain, synthesizing deeply technical constraints and market requirements into a clear, prioritized roadmap without requiring day-to-day tactical guidance.
Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Interface with Business Development, Solutions Architecture, and Engineering to translate complex OEM infrastructure requirements into scalable, platform-agnostic solutions that serve diverse vehicle segments.

What you should know

Required Qualifications

Professional Experience: 5+ years of Product Management experience in high-growth environments, with a proven track record of delivering deeply technical platform products, infrastructure, or middleware at scale.
Automotive & Mobility Domain Expertise: Strong understanding of the vehicle architecture ecosystem, including telemetry, automotive communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet), and diagnostic standards (UDS, SOVD).
Systems Thinking & Scale: Experience managing backend or platform products that bridge embedded edge environments and distributed cloud infrastructure. You design with the entire ecosystem in mind, ensuring that changes to the core platform account for, support, and align with upstream OEM workflows, downstream applications, and broader data dependencies.
Strategic Autonomy: You are a principled, self-directed leader with a history of making high-stakes technical decisions independently. You excel at navigating ambiguity and establishing clear technical directions in a fast-paced environment.
Technical Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex architectural constraints and infrastructure concepts into strategic business value for executive stakeholders and OEM partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Automotive Cybersecurity & Safety Standards: Familiarity with functional safety (ISO 26262), automotive cybersecurity (ISO 21434).
Engineering Roots: A background in Embedded Software, Cloud Systems Architecture, or Systems Engineering is highly desirable.
Enterprise Integration: Experience building developer-facing tools, SDKs, or highly flexible APIs used by third-party enterprise engineering groups.

What We Offer

Competitive compensation package with performance incentives.
A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and the opportunity for rapid career advancement.
Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
Flexible working hours to accommodate different time zones.
Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance and wellness programs.
A culture that values innovation and promotes a work-life balance.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

This job description provides a comprehensive outline designed to attract highly technical product managers looking to advance their careers in the dynamic and growing software-defined vehicle industry. Adjustments can be made based on the specific needs of your team and changes in business strategies.

As part of our next phase of expansion, we are now building an AI-Native product line from the ground up. This position is for a Product Manager who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys 0→1 product building, and wants to work closely with a small, high-ownership team operating in a rapid development environment. 
You will get an opportunity to help build one of the early AI-native operating systems for educational institutions in India - with direct exposure to founders, real customer scale, rapid experimentation, and the ability to shape products from day one. 
It is for someone who likes going deep into user problems, learning directly from customers (in our case - universities and institutions on the ground), experimenting fast, and translating operational pain points into scalable AI-native workflows and products. 

Build & Shape the Product 
● Work closely with leaders, product, and engineering teams to build an AI-native platform from the ground up 
● Drive bottom-up product discovery through direct interaction with universities, administrators, operations teams, faculty, and students 
● Translate problems into scalable, AI-first product experiences 
● Think beyond features - build systems, workflows, automation, copilots, and AI-assisted experiences with real outcomes 

Operate in a Rapid AI-Native Environment 
● Work in a fast-moving setup with high experimentation, rapid shipping, and continuous iteration 
● Use AI tools and AI-assisted workflows as part of day-to-day product management and execution
● Balance speed with product thinking, usability, adoption, and long-term platform direction 
● Collaborate deeply with engineering in an execution-heavy environment rather than operating in silos 

Own Outcomes, Not Just Requirements 
● Take ownership of problem statements, product decisions, execution alignment, and adoption outcomes ● Stay close to customers and continuously refine the product based on real-world usage and feedback 
● Bring strong clarity amidst ambiguity and help prioritize what truly matters in a 0→1 journey 

What we’re looking for 
● 3–5 years of experience in Product Management within B2B SaaS, AI, or AI-led products
● Strong problem-solving ability with comfort in unstructured environments
● Curiosity to deeply understand operational systems and user behavior 
● High ownership mindset with willingness to roll up sleeves and work closely with small teams
● Someone excited about AI-native software and the future of how enterprise systems will evolve 

Who we are
At Meritto we believe in building more than just solutions. Meritto is a category leader in AI-powered Vertical SaaS for the education sector - a 500+ member organization built over the last eight years with strong financial discipline, deep cultural intent, and a long-term view on customer outcomes. Through products like Meritto, Collexo, and Mio AI, we are helping educational institutions modernize enrollment, engagement, payments, and student experiences at a massive scale. 
We’re redefining the way education connects with technology. As one of India’Largest Vertical SaaS + Embedded Payments platform, we’re on a mission to build the “Digital Backbone of Education Institutions” by simplifying how educational organization runs — from enrollment to lifecycle, advancement to finance, and beyond. Having mastered the art of student acquisition, we’re now expanding our horizons to cover the entire spectrum of running an educational organization—from managing the student lifecycle to driving student success and outcomes. 
What’s our work culture like? We work from the office in a dynamic, inclusive, and merit-driven space fueled by the energy of collaboration and creativity coming together.

About The Team

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

About The Role

We are looking for a Product Manager 2 who is passionate about solving high-impact problems in a fast-paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.

What You Will Do

Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritised problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.


What You Will Need

Overall experience of 4+ yrs with at least 4+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
Exceptional problem-solving skills based on first principles of thinking
Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps
Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development

About Bureau

Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.

Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.

Why Bureau?

Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.

About the Role: Product Manager - RASP

You will own Bureau RASP (Runtime Application Self-Protection). It is a rare chance to take a category-defining security product from launch to scale.

Sophisticated mobile fraud now executes inside the app itself. Bureau RASP answers with a four-layer Zero Trust framework embedded in the customer's app:
Application integrity: code obfuscation, anti-tampering and anti-debugging, powered by XVM, our proprietary virtualization engine.
Runtime and environment: detection of root, jailbreak, emulators, cloned apps, hooking and overlay attacks.
Network and data channel: protection against MITM, packet sniffing, geo spoofing and VPN or proxy bypass.
Visibility and policy: monitor, warn or block per threat from a dashboard, with immutable audit logs.

It is built at the OS level, goes live in minutes with no code changes, and feeds runtime signals into Bureau's Graph Identity Network. You will decide where it goes next.

What you’ll be doing

Own the RASP vision, strategy and roadmap across Android and iOS.
Track the mobile threat landscape and turn new attack patterns into shipped protections.
Partner with security, SDK and platform engineers to deliver detections that are accurate, hard to bypass and light on app performance.
Shape the customer experience: zero-code onboarding, the policy engine, alerts and audit reporting.
Connect RASP signals with Device Intelligence, Behavioural Biometrics and the Graph Identity Network to create value no standalone RASP can match.
Work with sales, solutions and marketing on positioning, pricing, demos and competitive wins.
Spend time with CISOs, fraud heads and app teams at banks, fintechs and e-commerce firms to learn what they need.
Define success metrics such as adoption, detection efficacy, false positives and integration time, and report on them.

What You’ll Bring

Must have

4-6 years in product management, with at least 2 years on a B2B security, fraud or mobile SDK product.
Working knowledge of mobile app security: Android and iOS internals, reverse engineering, rooting, hooking and tampering.
Comfort going deep with engineers on technical trade-offs, and going wide with customers on business outcomes.
A record of taking a product from early release to enterprise adoption.
Clear writing and sharp prioritisation.

Good to have

Experience with RASP, app shielding, device fingerprinting or mobile threat defence.
Exposure to BFSI or fintech customers and regulatory expectations for app security.
An engineering or security research background.

Our Culture

We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way
We value performance, not hours worked
Speed, ownership, and impact matter most

Compensation

Competitive salary + potential equity
Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

Job Description

Who Are We 

Hansen Technologies is a global software and services provider supporting the energy, utilities, water, and telecommunications industries. Our solutions help organizations deliver essential services, introduce new products, engage customers, and manage critical revenue and customer operations across more than 80 countries.

As AI reshapes our industry, we are embedding intelligent capabilities across our products and operations to deliver smarter, faster, and more resilient solutions.

This is a full-time onsite role based in our Pune-Balewadi office.

Why This Role Matters 

Our strategic AI agent platform and framework, enables secure, governed, and scalable AI capabilities across Hansen products.

We are looking for a Product Manager who can combine product strategy, delivery leadership, and people leadership. You will own the platform’s vision, roadmap, and end-to-end lifecycle, turning emerging AI innovation into a trusted enterprise platform with measurable adoption and customer value.

Working closely with our Chief Innovation Officer, AI Spark team, engineering, architecture, and global product stakeholders, you will bring structure, pace, and accountability to one of Hansen’s most important AI investments.

What You’ll Do 

Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, value proposition, and outcome-focused roadmap for Hansen Hansen’s AI platform. 
Own the full product lifecycle from discovery and prioritization through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. 
Translate product goals into clear backlog priorities, release objectives, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans with Engineering and Architecture. 
Assess customer needs, market trends, AI capabilities, and internal product requirements to guide investment and roadmap decisions. 
Move innovation into production and BAU, keeping releases, bugs, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications on track. 
Lead and coach the cross-functional platform team while influencing senior stakeholders across a global, matrixed organization. 

What You Bring 

Strong product management experience in enterprise software, SaaS, platform products, or technology-led environments. 
Recent and credible exposure to AI/ML, Generative AI, agentic AI, AI platforms, or data-driven products. Coding experience is not required. 
Proven ownership of product vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, lifecycle, adoption, and measurable outcomes. 
Delivery-management capability, including experience turning strategy into executable plans and maintaining momentum after launch. 
Experience moving an emerging product from innovation or build stage into secure, reliable, scalable production and BAU. 
People leadership, coaching, or mentoring experience, with confident executive-level communication and product advocacy. 
Ability to balance customer value, commercial priorities, technical complexity, governance, and delivery realities. 

Why Join Us? 

Shape one of Hansen’s most strategic AI investments and influence how enterprise-grade AI agents are adopted across a global product portfolio. 
Own a high-visibility product roadmap and work directly with senior leaders, engineering teams, and product stakeholders. 
Turn fast-moving AI innovation into practical, secure, governed, and scalable platform capabilities. 
Join a collaborative, globally connected team that values ownership, openness, responsible innovation, and high-quality execution. 
Build your career with opportunities to influence Hansen’s wider product portfolio as Hansen’s AI platform scales. 

Contact Us 

If you have the experience and enthusiasm to shape the future of Hansen Hansen’s AI platform, please “Apply Now” via the link or visit our careers page.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Visit our website at hansencx.com for more information.

Data Privacy Notice 

By applying to this role, you consent to Hansen collecting, processing, and storing the information you provide for recruitment purposes. You also agree that your details may be securely retained in our talent database for future opportunities and reference in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.

Job Description Summary

The Product Manager for AI at GE Vernova plays a crucial role in the development and execution of AI-powered products that transform business processes. This role is essential to our mission of pioneering AI-driven innovation and enhancing user experiences across the enterprise.

The Product Manager will work with across GE Vernova and with the AI Portfolio Manager to identify, prioritize and build out AI products. These products (several) focus on delivering improvements and value through the lens of the Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) framework, measuring the impact of AI initiatives.

Additionally, the Product Manager facilitates cross-business coordination, leveraging AI applications to drive operational improvements and foster innovation across Vernova. Expertise in AI, combined with strong business acumen, is pivotal in translating complex technical challenges into strategic opportunities that propel the organization forward. These duties extend to not only internally developed solutions, but also to external suppliers (e.g. 3rd party software).

As a GE Vernova accelerator, GE Vernova Advanced Research is driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero-carbon future.

Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150+ energy-focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

Product Ownership and Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business, engineering, and research, to develop and execute product roadmaps that align with strategic objectives.
Roadmap input: Provide input, alongside the Portfolio manager, to build the product roadmaps
Technical Collaboration: Work closely with data scientists, IT, and designers to ensure the development of robust AI solutions, maintaining technical rigor and introducing new methods for verifying success and identifying risks.
User Experience: Focus on delivering exceptional user experiences by understanding and addressing user needs in AI applications.
Cross-Business Coordination: Support the coordination of AI applications to drive improvements and innovations across Vernova.
Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilize data analytics to measure product performance and make informed decisions. Define and monitor metrics and KPIs to ensure the success and impact of AI initiatives.
Post-Launch Support: Monitor product performance post-launch, gather user feedback, and iterate on product features to enhance value delivery.
3rd party solutions: Oversee the interjection of AI products coming from 3rd party software suppliers and determine best technology fit.

Position Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, with 10-15 years' relevant experience.
Experience with GE/GE Vernova highly preferred.
Business Acumen: Ability to integrate business strategy with technical initiatives.
Leadership: Proven leadership in managing cross-functional teams and projects.
Communication Skills: Excellent communication and presentation skills to engage with diverse stakeholders and occasionally C-Suite executives.
Experience building and deploying AI applications.
Problem-Solving Skills: Analytical skills to identify and solve risks and challenges.
Technical Proficiency and Data-Driven Mindset
Must be willing to work out of an office located in Bangalore, India.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Role : Product Manager, Trading Infrastructure.

You will own the professional and algo trading surface of Arrow: the products where latency, data depth and execution quality are the whole point.

Five areas sit in your remit, and each one is a product in its own right.

TBT charts: In-house tick-by-tick charting: sub-second candles, order-flow and footprint views, replay, with chart latency held close to feed latency.
HFT algos: In-house algos and a strategy marketplace retail traders can deploy on co-located infrastructure, with risk guardrails and exchange approvals built in.
API latency: The trading and market-data APIs: round-trip order latency at p50/p95/p99, WebSocket feed delivery, SDK ergonomics, rate limits, sandbox.
Colocation access: Productizing exchange co-lo for clients: rack and VM offerings, provisioning, cross-connects, pricing and compliance.
Tick-level data: Dissemination of full-depth, tick-by-tick market data: live feeds, snapshots, historical tick archives, entitlements and fan-out at scale.

This is the first dedicated Product Manager on the Arrow team.

You will work directly with the CTO, the HFT desk, the quant team and exchange-connectivity engineers, and you will set the product process as much as run it.

Expect to spend as much time with latency histograms and order-book data as with roadmap documents.

What You'll Do

Own the TBT charting roadmap.
Define what a tick-by-tick chart must do for a scalper that a one-second chart cannot: sub-second aggregation, order-flow and footprint views, volume-at-price, replay, and multi-instrument sync.
Set and track the chart-update latency budget against the raw feed.
Bring in-house HFT algos to retail.
Scope the first algos and the strategy marketplace: which strategies ship first, how traders discover, configure and deploy them on co-located infrastructure, what the kill switches and position limits look like, and how each algo clears SEBI and exchange approval before launch.
Own API latency as a product metric.
Define the order round-trip and feed-delivery SLOs at p50, p95 and p99, instrument them end to end (client, gateway, OMS, exchange), publish them transparently, and drive the engineering backlog that moves them.
Run the developer experience for the trading API: Go and Python SDKs, WebSocket market-data streams, docs, sandbox, rate limits, static-IP and algo-tagging requirements, and onboarding for API clients from first key to first live order.
Productise colocation access.
Turn exchange co-lo into something a professional client can buy: rack, VM and managed-server tiers, provisioning SLAs, cross-connects, pricing, and the compliance and audit trail each exchange requires.
Own tick-level data dissemination.
Define the market-data products: full-depth live feeds, TBT versus snapshot tiers, historical tick archives, entitlements and billing, and the fan-out architecture needed to serve thousands of clients without adding latency.
Talk to professional traders every week: scalpers, option market-makers, quants and API users.
Turn what they say and what their order flow shows into specs engineers can build from without a second meeting.
Write crisp PRDs with success metrics, latency budgets, failure modes and exchange-rule constraints (algo approval, order-to-trade ratios, throttles, circuit limits, square-off timings) spelled out.
Partner with the CTO, the HFT desk and exchange-connectivity engineers on trade-offs between latency, throughput, reliability and features; a feature that adds 200 s to the hot path is a product decision, not just an engineering one.
Define and track the metrics that matter: order latency and feed latency by percentile, API uptime, active API clients, algo deployments and their P&L distribution, co-lo utilisation, and tick-data subscriptions.

What We're Looking For

4 - 8 years in product, trading-systems engineering or quant/HFT trading, with at least 3 years owning a technical or fintech product end to end.
You understand market microstructure.
Order books, tick data, matching-engine behaviour, order-to-trade ratios, what co-lo buys you and what it does not.
You know why a scalper cares about the difference between 1 ms and 3 ms.
Hands-on with trading APIs.
You have built or run something against a broker or exchange API, understand REST versus WebSocket versus binary protocols, and can read a latency histogram and say where the time went.
Fluent with data.
You can write SQL, pull your own latency and order-flow data, and argue a prioritisation call with numbers rather than opinions.
Shipped in a regulated environment.
You can read a SEBI or exchange circular on algo trading, API access or market data and turn it into a product requirement.
Clear writer.
Your PRDs, SLO definitions and API docs get read and acted on by engineers and traders alike.
Bias for shipping.
You have taken a feature from a trader complaint to production in weeks, not quarters, and iterated after launch.

Nice To Have

Worked at an HFT or prop firm, an exchange, a market-data vendor or an algo trading platform.
Familiarity with NSE/BSE TBT and snapshot feeds, exchange co-lo offerings and the NNF/API order-tagging framework.
Have run a live strategy through a broker API, even a small one.
Options knowledge beyond the basics: Greeks, market-making, hedged-position margin.
Python or Go, enough to prototype an API call, parse a tick file or build your own latency dashboard.

What We Offer

A real execution edge to build on: co-located infrastructure and a 17-year HFT track record that no other retail broker in India starts with.
First dedicated PM in the seat.
You define the role, the process and the roadmap, and you report to the CTO.
Direct access to the HFT desk, quant team and exchange-connectivity engineers; the people who built the engine sit a few desks away.
Offices in Mumbai (Andheri East); market hours mean an early start and a clear end to the day.

Description

Alexa+ is our next-generation assistant powered by generative AI. Alexa+ is more conversational, smarter, personalized, and gets things done.

Our goal is make Alexa+ an instantly familiar personal assistant that is always ready to help or entertain on any device. At the core of this vision is "Alexa AI Developer Tech", a close-knit team that’s dedicated to providing software developers with the tools, primitives, and services they need to easily create engaging customer experiences that expand the wealth of information, products, and services available on Alexa+.

Interested in Alexa+? Ever wonder what's involved in enabling third-party partners to create experiences for Alexa+? Then come help us build the AI-native SDKs that partners use every day to expand Alexa+ capabilities!

You will join a growing organization working on top technology using Generative AI and have an enormous opportunity to make an impact on the design, architecture, and implementation of products used every day, by people you know.

We’re working hard, having fun, and making history; come join us!

Key job responsibilities

As the Sr Technical Product Manager for Alexa AI Developer Tech, you will define the vision, product roadmap, and features for building conversational experiences leveraging spoken language technologies and machine learning. This includes enabling other teams in Alexa, other teams across Amazon, and external partners to create highly-engaging Alexa experiences and features that customers love using in their daily lives. You will create business requirements documents and develop a long term roadmap for tools, documentation, and developer support. You will also be responsible for collaborating with and guiding a cross-functional team of engineers and designers to achieve your vision. The ideal candidate has a strong technical background with superb analytic thinking and communication skills. A track record of defining market leading products that enable developers to bring their ideas to life is preferred.

A successful candidate will have passion for developers and experience in designing platform strategies. You have a background in software development and product management, specific to software platforms and ecosystems. You are highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively across multiple organizations, and adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high-quality, simple-to-use products and applications that developers and customers love.

Next-gen AI Exposure

Be part of Amazon's strategic push into next-generation AI assistants.
Work directly with state-of-the-art LLMs and generative-AI technologies.
Gain expertise in an emerging, high-demand field that few engineers have deep experience in.

Massive Scale Impact

Influence AI interactions for 600+ million Alexa devices worldwide.
See your work impact daily conversations in millions of households.
Work on Alexa+, which represents Amazon's response to competitors like ChatGPT.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience managing technical products or online services
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the data, query, and context foundations that help customers and AI agents understand and act on operational and security telemetry.
Effective investigation depends on finding the right data, querying it efficiently, and understanding how it relates to the customer's environment. As AI agents take on more analytical work, they need dependable access to telemetry and context: which service an entity belongs to, what it depends on, who owns it, and what changed. This role owns the shared platform capabilities that make that possible across observability, security, and platform optimization.
You will own established search and analytics capabilities while building toward federated analytics and a richer customer context foundation. This is a technically deep role requiring first-hand experience with data platforms, search, or analytics products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into useful capabilities that teams can adopt.
What You Will Own
The search and query platform. Search and query capabilities, query language and analytical functions, partitions, views, and shared query services. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing analytical depth, ease of use, and cost for both human and agent workloads.
Federated analytics. Define how customers and agents query and correlate Sumo data with data in connected systems. Establish the use cases, supported analytical capabilities, and tradeoffs around data movement, freshness, performance, permissions, and cost, working closely with the teams responsible for integrations and access.
Customer context and the knowledge graph. Build the shared understanding of a customer's environment: entities, services, workloads, ownership, topology, and dependencies. Define how that context is assembled from telemetry, metadata, and connected systems, how relationships are maintained, and how the accumulated context improves investigation and analysis over time.
Data discovery and shared context services. Help people and agents discover available sources, schemas, fields, and relationships, and retrieve the data and context relevant to a task. Own the shared capabilities that make this information reusable across product experiences, with clear provenance, freshness, and permission boundaries.
What You Will Be Doing
Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for the data and analytics platform, connecting current customer needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation.
Own the health and evolution of shipping query capabilities, partitions, and views, using customer feedback and workload data to prioritize improvements.
Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, distributed analytics, scalability, and cost at enterprise scale.
Define and validate federated analytics use cases, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
Develop the entity and context strategy, including how services and resources are identified consistently across data sources and related to one another.
Partner with investigation, security, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared platform capabilities and clear interfaces.
Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure query and context capabilities respect established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
Measure query success, latency, reliability, cost, context quality, and adoption, and show how platform improvements improve customer outcomes.
What You Bring

Product at Uber means making big decisions without perfect information—and owning the outcomes. As a Senior Product Manager (Tech), you will turn massive complexity into clarity at speed, navigating the "messy" reality of multi-sided marketplaces and high-stakes technical integrations. You will be at the heart of our most ambitious missions, architecting solutions that bridge the digital and physical worlds for millions of users globally.

About CertifyOS

CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.

Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. We’re solving that problem.

Our API-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.

Our vision is simple: One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data.

We’re backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. We’re building a high-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients.

About The Role

CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure for the next generation of provider technology. As we scale across Credentialing, Monitoring, Rosters, Provider Network Operations, the biggest bottleneck is no longer just building features - it is making the platform easier for internal teams and customers to configure, operate, and extend safely. As the Senior Technical Product Manager, Data, you will own the strategy and execution for the system that keeps credentialed practitioners continuously compliant with NCQA standards. You'll be accountable for the end-to-end data provisioning experience, the data elements, the quality of that data, and the source veracity that proves historical compliance during audits. The ideal candidate would be comfortable making all provider data pipelines trustworthy, fast, configurable, and cheap to run at scale, while moving the team from a service-driven, manual-review posture toward a productized, self-serve, AI-native one. This role sits at the intersection of platform thinking and technical product expertise. You'll partner closely with the Application Product team, Operations, Implementation and Client Success teams.

What You Will Do

Sourcing: getting the data
Own "detect need" and source routing. Define what triggers a data request (a new file, a monthly monitoring cycle, an expiring element) and the rules that route it to the best source: bulk file, API, scraper, paid vendor, outreach or a human analyst. Every attempt and its raw response is recorded.
Own source economics. Know the cost, coverage and latency of every source. Decide when to build a scraper, buy an API or pay for a bulk feed.
Association: getting it on the right practitioner
Own attribution and matching. Define how acquired records are matched to practitioners across identifiers that are often missing or conflicting, including probabilistic matching models. Set the quality bar for false and missed matches, and own the review path for low-confidence results.
Own survivorship and Master Data Management governance. Define which source wins for each attribute, and make that configurable. Golden record rules, merge and unmerge, audit trail, and a monitoring and observability loops so matching changes never ship blind.
Across the chain
Build explainability. Anyone in the company should be able to ask why a license is missing, stale or attached to the wrong practitioner, and get a traced answer from source to screen. Partner with engineering on the observability that makes the answer trustworthy.
Measure data loss end to end. Build the attribute-level funnel that shows where data drops out between acquisition and the application, and give each application pod a data health metric tied to its own north star.
Keep data pipelines stable. Triage pipeline and data escalations, separate one-off fixes from product gaps, and cut the volume of manual re-scrapes and stale-data tickets.
Define metrics for data platform effectiveness: Metrics by application and client, source success rate and freshness, % of requests resolved without a human, match precision and recall, % of data errors caught before a client reports them, time to explain a data issue, and external data cost per practitioner.
Must-Haves

AI-native execution. At home and highly productive in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar. You use them to query data, prototype, write specs and automate your own work, and you know where they fail.
5 to 8 years of experience, with at least 3 years with technical product management experience with data products or backend products.
Technical fluency across APIs, data pipelines, retries and orchestration, and third-party data integrations. 
Hands-on experience with at least one of: data acquisition, scraping or ingestion; or entity resolution, record linkage, MDM or identity matching.
Strong SQL and data literacy: completeness and freshness metrics, data modeling basics, warehouse tooling (BigQuery a plus). You query the data yourself before you form an opinion.
Experience turning manual operational workflows into product capability, and the judgement to say no to one-off requests.
Clear written communication. You write specs an engineer and a coding agent can both build from.

Nice-to-Haves

Experience in healthcare technology, provider data management, credentialing, or NCQA/CMS-regulated data environments.
Experience with rules/flagging engines, exception-review workflows, or compliance audit tooling.
Experience building AI-assisted internal tools, agentic triage/resolution, or support copilots.
Familiarity with BigQuery, embedded analytics, or customer-facing compliance reporting.
Background as an engineer or technical implementation lead before PM.
Startup/high-growth experience in data platform or US SaaS applications

Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.

QAD's AI Platform is the domain intelligence layer that sits between the ERP and autonomous AI agents. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable — transforming QAD from a system of record into a system of action.

Job Description

This role owns the full product lifecycle for QAD's Copilot, Search, and Conversational Analytics capabilities — from architecture through to market launch. You will define what gets built, why it matters to manufacturing users, and how it reaches them: shaping the product vision, driving engineering delivery, and partnering with GTM to ensure adoption.

The intelligence that powers these surfaces — how queries are understood, how manufacturing context is assembled, how data is retrieved, and how responses are generated — is where QAD's AI moat is built. You will need to engage deeply with these layers, not as an engineer but as the product owner who defines the contracts, quality standards, and sequencing decisions that determine whether they work in production at enterprise scale.

You will report to the Head of Platform Product, with day-to-day direction from the Director of the AI Platform org. This role is evaluated through the quality of your product thinking, your influence on engineering direction, and the outcomes you drive in the market.

The Opportunity

Manufacturing users today cannot query their own operations without analysts, BI tools, or pre-built reports. QAD's AI platform changes this — but only if the Copilot and Search layer is built correctly and lands with users. You will own both sides of that equation.

Define the semantic search and conversational analytics product that allows manufacturing users to query operational data — orders, inventory, suppliers, quality records — in natural language, without SQL or BI expertise
Own the intelligence contract: how queries are understood, how manufacturing context is assembled, how retrieval is orchestrated, and how responses are grounded in governed data — the foundational decisions that determine product quality at scale
Drive the Copilot from concept to customer — including the contextual layer architecture, the grounding contract against the platform's Semantic Layer, and the GTM motion that gets it adopted in manufacturing workflows
Build the feedback loops that make the product smarter over time: how recurring query patterns surface ontology gaps, how session analytics drive prioritisation, and how discovery findings translate into product improvements
Establish QAD's conversational analytics presence in market — working with GTM to define positioning, enablement, and the narrative that differentiates QAD's intelligence layer from horizontal AI tools

Key Responsibilities

Copilot & Conversational Analytics

Own the product definition for QAD's Copilot: how queries are understood, context assembled, data retrieved, and responses generated — specifying the contracts that engineering builds against
Define the grounding contract: the rules that ensure every Copilot response cites governed manufacturing data, not hallucinated inference — including confidence signalling and graceful fallback behaviour
Drive the conversational analytics strategy: how natural language queries translate into analytical results across manufacturing data domains without exposing SQL or BI complexity to the user
Specify the disambiguation model: how the Copilot handles ambiguous queries, missing context, and conflicting data signals in real manufacturing workflows

Search

Own the product definition for QAD's semantic search layer: indexing strategy, query understanding, entity recognition, ranking, and result structure across manufacturing data domains
Define the search intent taxonomy — operational (find order, trace shipment), analytical (show trends, compare periods), and diagnostic (why is this delayed, what caused this variance) — and specify result formats by intent type
Drive the federated search architecture: how results from ERP operational data, analytical stores, and the knowledge graph are ranked and merged into a coherent, useful response

Discovery, Delivery & GTM

Maintain a structured customer discovery programme — extracting real manufacturing query patterns and translating findings into specific product and architecture implications
Own the product backlog: writing stories to Staff Engineer level of specificity — API contracts, state machines, data flows, edge cases — that engineering can build without verbal clarification
Partner with GTM to define the launch and adoption strategy for Copilot and Search: positioning, sales enablement, onboarding playbooks, and the narrative that lands with manufacturing buyers
Define the quality framework for these surfaces: what signals matter for product performance — retrieval relevance, grounding rate, latency distribution — and how they inform roadmap decisions

Stakeholder Management & Managing Up

Proactively surface dependencies, risks, and scope changes to the Director and Head of Platform Product — with a resolution proposal, not just an escalation
Communicate product and architecture decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders — translating trade-offs into business implications without jargon
Build credibility with Engineering, Architecture, and GTM through the quality and precision of written work

Qualifications

Product Experience

7–12 years in product management, with significant time owning AI-powered, search, or analytics products in enterprise B2B environments — from definition through production launch
Proven track record owning the full product lifecycle: customer discovery, specification, engineering delivery, and GTM — not just one slice
Experience working in matrixed organisations — driving outcomes across Platform, Engineering, Architecture, and GTM without direct authority
Evidence of structured discovery practice applied to a technical product surface — ability to extract product implications from user research, not just UX insights

Core Technical Depth — Required

These are the primary technical domains this role owns. Strong command is expected from day one.

Semantic search architecture: indexing strategy, query understanding, entity recognition, ranking models, and relevance evaluation at enterprise scale
Conversational AI product design: how natural language queries are translated into structured analytical results across complex, domain-specific data without exposing backend complexity to users
LLM-integrated product specification: grounding strategies, hallucination mitigation, response quality gates, and context window management — sufficient to define product contracts engineering builds against
Data platform fluency: OLAP vs operational DB reads, federated search across heterogeneous stores, and how data freshness constraints affect product quality — sufficient to hold authoritative conversations with data engineers
SQL and data modelling: sufficient to validate query plans, understand schema implications, and reason through retrieval architecture trade-offs

Working Familiarity — Expected to Grow Into

These domains sit in adjacent platform layers that Copilot and Search consume. Deep expertise is not required on day one, but working fluency is expected — and will expand as the platform scales toward agentic capabilities.

Intent detection and query understanding pipelines: how user inputs are parsed, classified, and routed across platform layers

About The Role

PubMatic is building the next generation of AI-powered products for digital advertising, including intelligent agents that help customers monitor marketplace performance, identify new opportunities, troubleshoot issues, make recommendations, and take action. We are also evolving our data visualization, reporting, and analytics platform that publishers and partners rely on to understand their performance.

We are looking for a highly technical, customer-oriented Product Manager to lead our Agentic Platform and AI strategy while driving the roadmap for our analytics and reporting platform. This role owns the foundational capabilities that enable teams across PubMatic to build, evaluate, deploy, and operate production-grade AI agents, and leads strategic customer-facing AI and analytics experiences that turn complex marketplace data into actionable intelligence.

You will work at the intersection of Generative AI, agentic systems, advertising technology, data, and product experience. You will partner closely with engineering (onshore and offshore), design, and commercial teams, and with DSPs, ad networks, agency trading desks, exchanges, publishers, and audience/data providers, to turn emerging AI capabilities into scalable products that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Do

AI and Agentic Platform

Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for PubMatic's shared AI and Agentic Platform, enabling teams company-wide to build and operate production-grade AI agents.
Own platform capabilities including agent orchestration, model and tool integration, context and knowledge management, evaluation frameworks, observability, governance, and reusable agent infrastructure.
Lead the strategy and development of publisher- and marketplace-facing AI experiences that transform complex marketplace data into actionable intelligence.
Build rigorous evaluation methodologies combining offline evaluation, golden datasets, LLM-based evaluation, human review, experimentation, and production telemetry.
Define success metrics across AI quality, customer adoption, task completion, business impact, latency, reliability, and cost.

Data Visualization, Reporting & Analytics

Define, develop, and execute the vision, roadmap, and requirements for PubMatic's data visualization, reporting, and analytics platform.
Develop clear, compelling PRDs and user stories for new initiatives and enhancements, including business justification, revenue potential, and operational impact.
Monitor product adoption, proactively identify opportunities, and make actionable recommendations to drive uptake and effectiveness.

Validate product direction through customer and internal stakeholder interaction and by analyzing market and product trends.
Create and maintain a prioritized product backlog.
Work closely with UX and engineering teams to guide development and testing.
Partner with Sales, Services, and Product Marketing on training, collateral, and product rollout, and evangelize PubMatic offerings internally and to prospects and the installed base.
Own the full product lifecycle, from opportunity identification and strategy through requirements, experimentation, launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.

6-8+ years of Product Management experience, including 1-2 years of hands-on experience leading technically complex agentic platforms and building AI agents in production, and experience in data visualization, analytics, or business intelligence.
Strong understanding of modern AI application architecture, including LLMs and reasoning models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation and knowledge systems, agent orchestration and tool use, AI evaluation and experimentation, prompt and context engineering, and observability and production monitoring.
Demonstrated ability to identify business problems and strategic, revenue-generating opportunities.
Demonstrated ability to partner deeply with engineering and AI teams, making thoughtful product and technical tradeoffs.
Experience taking ambiguous, zero-to-one products from concept through production and measurable adoption.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to define metrics and evaluation frameworks for probabilistic AI systems.
Firm sense of accountability and ownership for the end-to-end product lifecycle.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical teams, customers, and senior leadership.

Experience building enterprise AI products where reliability, governance, privacy, security, and explainability are critical.

About the Role
Delhivery moves millions of shipments a day across one of the most complex physical networks: pickups, line-haul, sorting, last-mile, returns, and cross-border. Every one of those steps generates data, decisions, and money on the table. We believe the next decade of logistics will be won by whoever applies AI most intelligently to the physical world.
We are building a team of Product Managers who will reimagine logistics with an Agentic first approach. You won't be bolting a chatbot on a dashboard. You will own problems where a better model or a smarter agent changes unit economics, customer experience, or network reliability at national scale.
.What You’ll Do
Find the right problems. Spend time in hubs, with riders, ops leaders, and merchants. Translate messy operational pain into opportunities for creating a seamless flow that scales.
Own outcomes, not outputs. Define success metrics tied to cost per shipment, delivery success, NPS, or revenue, and be accountable for moving them.
Ship AI products that real operators use. Design human-in-the-loop workflows, fallbacks, and feedback loops so models earn trust on the ground and keep improving after launch.
Drive adoption across the org. Work with Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to embed AI into how teams actually work.
Partner deeply with data science and engineering. Shape problem formulation, data requirements, evaluation methodology, and model-versus-rules trade-offs. Understand precision/recall, drift, latency, and cost well enough to challenge and be challenged.
Run rigorous experimentation. A/B tests, shadow deployments, and phased rollouts across geographies and hubs, with clear go/no-go criteria.
Stay at the frontier. Evaluate new LLM, agentic, and vision capabilities, and decide pragmatically what to build, buy, or fine-tune.
The kind of problems you could own
Network intelligence: demand forecasting, capacity planning, dynamic routing, and ETA prediction across the network
Last-mile optimization: address intelligence and geocoding, delivery-attempt prediction, route and slot optimization, rider productivity
Computer vision on the ground: shipment damage detection, automated weighing and dimensioning, sort-center throughput, proof-of-delivery verification
Generative AI and agents: autonomous customer support, ops copilots for hub managers, document and invoice automation, internal knowledge assistants
Risk and trust: fraud, RTO (return-to-origin) prediction, NDR resolution, and merchant risk scoring
Pricing and commercial intelligence: dynamic pricing, serviceability, and yield optimization
You will be matched to problem statements based on impact, your strengths, and the stage of each problem. Expect to work across more than one.

What We’re Looking For
Experience
2–5 years in product management, ideally with at least 1–2 years shipping ML or AI-driven products (or a strong data science, ML engineering, or analytics background that you have transitioned into product)
A track record of taking a product from ambiguous problem to measurable business impact
Strong academic grounding; engineering degree from a top-tier institution preferred, MBA a plus but not required
Skills
Working fluency in ML concepts: model evaluation, training data quality, feedback loops, and the practical differences between classical ML, deep learning, and LLM-based systems
Hands-on comfort with data: SQL is a must, Python or notebooks a plus. You pull your own numbers.
Experience with, or sharp point of view on, GenAI product design: prompt and eval design, RAG, agents, guardrails, and cost/latency trade-offs
Excellent structured thinking and the ability to communicate with engineers, data scientists, and frontline ops leaders equally well
Bias to action, ownership, and comfort operating in complex, high-volume, real-world environments
Pedigree signals we value
Prior experience at product-led or AI-forward companies (marketplaces, e-commerce, mobility, fintech, SaaS, or AI-native startups)
Evidence of impact: shipped models or AI features with quantifiable results, side projects, or published work
Curiosity about the physical world: supply chains, operations, and hardware-meets-software problems

Overview

Role: Product Manager II

Help millions of people discover why Copilot is worth paying for.

Copilot is becoming the AI companion people reach for at work, and more and more of those moments happen on a phone. Every day, people discover something new Copilot can do for them. Your job is to make sure that, when they are ready for more, the path to a paid plan is clear, helpful and genuinely valuable. You will own real experiments on a product used around the world, learn fast and see your work land with customers in weeks, not years.

Why this role, why now

Copilot recently came together as one app across web, desktop and mobile, with chat, agents and creation in a single experience. Monetization is moving inside the product, where value is felt. Early signals on mobile are strong, and in-app purchase is now live on iOS and Android. It is an exciting moment to join: the patterns for monetizing AI are being invented now.

How we work

Small, empowered mission teams with clear ownership.
Every bet starts with a written hypothesis, is measured rigorously, and decisions are made on evidence.
AI-native by default: we use AI agents and tools throughout our own workflow to research, prototype, analyze and ship faster.
Ship fast, learn faster, scale what works.
India shapes global strategy here, not just execution.

You'll thrive here if…

You would rather own the outcome, good or bad, than be shielded from it.
You love turning data and customer insight into a sharp idea worth testing.
You form a view, test it quickly and update it when the data disagrees.
You thrive with high ownership and ask for help early.
You already use AI to work faster and keep exploring what else it can do.
Shipping often sounds energizing, not exhausting.

This role may not be for you if…

You want a fully specified plan handed to you every quarter.
You prefer long studies to running a test and learning from it.
You measure success by features launched rather than customers who find value.

Why join us

This is a chance to shape how AI is experienced and valued by people around the world, early in your career and at real scale. You will learn alongside a fast-moving, AI-native team, own outcomes from day one and grow quickly. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, we would love to meet you.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

What you will own

At this level you own a well-scoped mission end to end and the metric that goes with it, and you grow quickly toward larger scope.

Upgrade moments: value-led upgrade experiences across Copilot and Microsoft 365 apps on mobile.
The path to paid: experiences that help people and their organizations move to paid plans with confidence.
An experiment portfolio: write the hypothesis, design the test, specify the telemetry, ship with engineering and design, read out the result and decide.
A metric that is yours: such as engagement with upgrade experiences or paid conversion, and a clear story of what moved it.

Your first 30 / 60 / 90 days

First 30 days: learn the product, customers and data deeply.
By 60 days: ship your first hypothesis-led experiment from a crisp spec engineers love.
By 90 days: run several experiments at once and own a metric you can move.

Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree AND 2+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development.
OR equivalent experience.
Additional Or Preferred Qualifications

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field AND 3+ years of product management experience.
OR a relevant advanced degree AND 2+ years.
OR equivalent experience.
Consumer or mobile features shipped with measurable results.
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and funnel analysis.
SQL or Kusto (KQL), and comfort pulling your own data.
Experience building or growing iOS or Android apps.
B2B SaaS, product-led growth, subscriptions or in-app purchase experience.
A growth track record at a startup or consumer-tech company.

Company Description
AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.
AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

Job Description
You’ll own one or more parts of the traveller journey across app and web; we’ll set the exact charter with you. Work on our roadmap includes:
Search and booking — comparing buses, smarter filters, a cleaner seat layout and fewer payment drop-offs.
The trip — an AI-powered Trip Mode, live tracking, delay alerts and boarding-point guidance.
Cancellations and refunds — alternatives before a cancel, clear refund tracking and easy reschedules.
Growth and monetisation — rewards and referrals, cross-sell and upsell, and supply-side monetisation through operator ads and sponsored listings.

What you’ll do
Own outcomes — set the roadmap and KPIs for your area, and own the results.
Find the real problem — talk to travellers, bus operators, sales and on-ground teams and support, and keep asking why until you reach the root cause.
Design the experience — sketch and prototype, and work with designers to craft “aha” moments and delightful nudges.
Build with AI — prototype faster, and turn manual, support-heavy journeys into self-serve ones.
Let data decide — pull your own data, run A/B tests and challenge assumptions.
Ship end to end — write clear specs, launch smoothly, keep improving, and keep engineering, design and business aligned.

What success looks like
Measurable gains in your metrics — conversion, repeat bookings, app ratings, fewer support contacts.
Superlative experiences, with clear “aha” moments and delightful nudges that travellers notice.

Amazon Business is transforming how businesses, governments, and organizations purchase products and manage procurement operations. Serving millions of business customers worldwide, Amazon Business combines the selection, convenience, and value of Amazon with capabilities tailored to the unique needs of business customers.

Amazon Business Analytics (ABA) plays a critical role in this transformation by building a suite of customer facing analytics products that help organizations turn purchasing data into actionable insights. Our customers range from small and medium businesses to large enterprises and public sector organizations. Our products empower procurement leaders, finance teams, and business administrators to understand organizational spending, identify savings opportunities, monitor purchasing behavior, and make informed business decisions.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Technical (PMT) to help shape and deliver the next generation of Amazon Business Analytics experiences. In this role, you will drive product strategy and execution across our customer facing analytics portfolio, spanning spend visibility, self service reporting, intelligent insights, and AI powered conversational analytics. You will build intuitive and scalable products for the full range of business customers, from those seeking simple, out of the box spending insights to large enterprises requiring sophisticated analytics across complex organizational structures.

You will have the opportunity to reimagine how business customers interact with their purchasing data, moving beyond traditional dashboards and reports toward intelligent, proactive, and conversational experiences. You will use advances in generative AI, large language models, and modern data technologies to make analytics more accessible, personalized, and actionable for customers worldwide.

This is a highly visible role that requires strong customer obsession, technical judgment, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence and deliver across multiple engineering and business organizations. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, dives deep into customer and technical challenges, and has a demonstrated track record of building and scaling customer facing technology products.

You will lead the development of intelligent analytics experiences, including conversational interfaces, natural language querying, proactive insights, and AI powered capabilities. You will also build products that help customers analyze organizational spending, identify savings opportunities, and improve procurement outcomes. You will balance ease of use for smaller businesses with the depth that large enterprises require, and develop capabilities that serve customers across multiple geographies.

You will partner closely with engineering, applied science, UX, and data teams to define product requirements, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and deliver scalable, reliable analytics solutions. You will define success metrics and use customer feedback, experimentation, and data to keep improving outcomes. Genpact services customer operations at enormous scale—tens of millions of voice, chat, email and ticket interactions a year—in regulated, audit-intensive industries including banking, insurance and healthcare. Inviting applications for the role of Technical Platform Product Manager -Product & Platform Engineering!

Role Summary
The most senior individual-contributor product management role, responsible for the strategic direction, development, and business of a major service or a portfolio of services used by customers ranging from single engineers to large enterprises. Principal PMT-ES Product Managers are trusted members of organizational leadership who define 3–5 year vision and roadmaps, own pricing and go-to-market strategy, and are typically assigned where the business opportunity or technology strategy is not yet defined. They operate with complete independence as single-threaded owners, influence customer and internal engineering roadmaps, and may own P&L.

Key Responsibilities
Own the strategic direction (business and technology), development, and business aspects of a major service or a portfolio of services used by a wide spectrum of customers, from startups to enterprises, typically working with multiple engineering teams
Operate with complete independence on initiatives where the business opportunity, product strategy, or even the problem itself is not yet defined, and drive clarity
Define the strategic vision and long-term roadmap for strategic service initiatives, and drive teams to execute on it across business verticals and market segments
Own positioning, go-to-market strategy, and pricing strategy; may own product marketing strategy (branding, promotions, deals) and Profit/Loss (P/L)
Own end-to-end service experience: customer engagement, PR/FAQ and requirements definition, CX design, compliance, feature priority, messaging, and reliability
Identify opportunities to accelerate customer business success, and anticipate customers’ future growth, turning those signals into viable long-term business opportunities
Construct a portfolio of service offerings by generalizing gaps across customers and technology segments to drive new and improved services
Handle significantly complex product management scenarios, make the case for investment, and prioritize initiatives for maximum impact with minimal resources
Own service dependencies and endemic customer-facing problems, and drive improvements in architecture, quality, testability, maintainability, and efficiency
Apply deep knowledge of core systems in one technology domain, or broad knowledge across several, to evaluate engineering alternatives and customer architectures, and to decompose complex propositions into straightforward solutions

Distinguish between one-way and two-way doors, take smart risks, and make it safe for design and technology teams to experiment
Ask the hard questions (Where do we need to invent? Should this product continue to exist?)
Drive joint or cross-organization launches and strategic partnerships across multiple services; influence engineering roadmaps and priorities, internally and externally
