Your work will span integrations with global food aggregators, order management, and the Rebel
Kitchen system stack. You'll work with external partners and internal engineering teams to improve order success, while partnering with kitchen teams to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve operational efficiency.
This role requires curiosity about how systems work, a strong process mindset, and comfort engaging with users across the organization - from kitchen staff and dispatch teams to brand managers and business leaders.

What You'll Do
• Build the Rebel Kitchen Stack: Continuously improve the systems used for kitchen preparation,
order management, routing, and dispatch. Translate observations from kitchen operations into
practical features that reduce effort, errors, and turnaround time.
• Work with Global Aggregators and Ordering Partners: Partner with platforms such as Swiggy,
Zomato, Talabat, Uber Eats, IRCTC, Keeta, and Noon across markets to build and improve API
integrations covering menus, availability, order processing, and order status updates. Coordinate
requirements, testing, certification, and rollouts with partner teams.
• Drive Order Success: Identify and address failures across the order lifecycle - from store and
menu availability to order acceptance and fulfilment. Investigate rejection patterns, diagnose
issues with engineering and operations, and drive fixes that prevent recurrence.
• Understand the Technology: Develop a working understanding of our microservices
architecture, APIs, databases, and system dependencies. Contribute to technical discussions,
identify edge cases, and help balance operational needs with scalability and reliability.

What You'll Do 
• Stay Close to Ground-Level Users: Spend time with kitchen staff, dispatch teams, operations,
brand teams, and customer support to understand how the platform performs in practice. Use
these insights to define solutions and validate their effectiveness.
• Own Features Through Execution: Take features from problem definition and requirements
through prioritization, development, testing, launch, and adoption. Document business rules,
dependencies, exception scenarios, and acceptance criteria clearly.
• Build Reliable Processes: Establish clear workflows for platform configuration, partner
onboarding, rollouts, and issue resolution. Create documentation and training that help teams use new capabilities consistently.
• Measure Outcomes: Define and track metrics such as order success, rejection rates, menu
availability, preparation and dispatch time, and manual effort. Use data to prioritize improvements and assess their impact.

What You'll Bring
• Technical Acumen: A solid understanding of APIs, microservices, and database principles, with
the ability to reason through system flows and integration failures. Experience with cloud platforms or external integrations is a plus.
• Product Sense: The ability to turn operational problems into clear requirements and prioritize
solutions based on user needs, business impact, and implementation effort.
• Operational Curiosity: A willingness to spend time in kitchens, observe workflows firsthand, and understand the constraints teams face during peak operations.
• Analytical Problem-Solving: Comfort working with data to identify failure patterns, investigate
root causes, and measure whether a solution delivers the intended outcome. Familiarity with SQL is a plus.
• Process Orientation: Attention to detail when defining workflows, handling exceptions,
documenting requirements, and planning rollouts.
• Communication Skills: The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users and communicate operational requirements precisely to engineers and external partners.
• Collaboration and Ownership: A proactive approach to coordinating across engineering,
operations, business teams, and aggregator partners, with consistent follow-through.
• Familiarity with Product Tools: Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Slack, and API
testing tools like Postman is a plus.
If you enjoy solving complex platform problems, working with global partners, and seeing your
products improve everyday kitchen operations, we'd love to hear from you.

The Rebel Culture
We believe in empowering and growing people to perform the best at their job functions. We follow outcome-oriented, fail-fast iterative & collaborative culture to move fast in building tech solutions. Rebel is not a usual workplace. The following slides will give you a sense of our culture, how Rebel conducts itself and who will be the best fit for our company. We suggest you go through it before making up your mind.
Culture@RebelFoods.pdf

The group you’ll be a part of

The Customer Support Business Group focuses on enabling our customers with premier customer support throughout their lifecycle with Lam. We drive performance, productivity, safety, and quality of customers installed base performance and deliver service and lifecycle solutions for their most critical equipment and processes.

The impact you’ll make

As a Product Manager 2 within the Spares organization, you will support the management of Lam's spares portfolio supporting products which are End of manufacturing. You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to drive Engineering projects, resolving customer escalations, sustaining product install base and ensure timely support for field failures.

What You’ll Do

Utilize Product Lifecycle (PLC) mapping and analytical tools to identify and execute programs required to manage the spares portfolio.
Analyze, prioritize, and disposition Obsolescence Problem Reports (OBPRs).
Plan, coordinate, and resolve component obsolescence issues with suppliers and OEM partners.
Drive engineering projects to address obsolescence gaps impacting sustaining products.
Analyze part forecasts, historical consumption, and manufacturing demand to determine spare part requirements for new and existing product lines.
Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Suppliers, and Spares Analysts to support business objectives.
Facilitate and execute Last Time Buy (LTB) and Bridge Buy (BB) strategies.
Support customer communications, manufacturing teams, and field service organizations regarding obsolescence and product changes.
Contribute to achieving operational performance metrics, including lead time reduction, cost optimization, and on-time delivery targets.
Support senior Product Managers in strategic portfolio planning and lifecycle management initiatives.

Who We’re Looking For

Understanding of Product Lifecycle Management processes and obsolescence management.
Ability to perform part and assembly impact analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to evaluate business cases and financial impacts.
Experience managing stakeholders across global teams.
Knowledge of Engineering Change Management, Product Structuring, and Configuration Management.
Ability to understand component attributes and system-level product interactions.
Strong verbal, written, presentation, and communication skills.
Working knowledge of SAP R/3 or equivalent ERP systems.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of relevant industry experience.
Experience in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Configuration, or Engineering Change Management.
Experience working in manufacturing, supply chain, product management, semiconductor, or related technical environments.Experience in OEM component selection and qualification.
Understanding of financial concepts such as Gross Margin and Return on Investment (ROI).
Exposure to Quick Base development or administration.
Project Management experience.
Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing, material planning, and production control processes.
Strong technical aptitude with the ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams (Mechanical, Electrical, RF, Materials Science, etc.).
Experience with project planning and tracking tools.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

jobs.sourceTitle: Global Product Manager – Sustainable Seafood Certification (MSC/ASC)
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 99,600 employees operate a network of 2,600 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.

At SGS, we have an open corporate and international culture. We offer a dynamic work environment in a leading global company. Our high professional standards and our sustainability approach guarantee you a future-oriented work environment. We invest in our employees for the long term and are committed to supporting your development within the company. Our business principles include: Integrity, Health, Safety & Environment, Quality & Professionalism, Respect, Sustainability, and Leadership.



Job Description

ROLE PURPOSE

The Global Product Manager, MSC/ASC ensures that the certification services related to the MSC/ASC Chain of Custody and ASC Farm are successful and have long-term viability. The main responsibilities and purpose of this role are :

To have overall responsibility for the successful management of the schemes ensuring the global operation is efficient and meets the expectations of SGS markets (affiliates), external clients, scheme owners and accreditation bodies. 
To ensure global internal and external KPIs are met, and all relevant approvals and accreditations are maintained to safeguard the SGS business and reputation. 
To provide overall commercial strategy and go-to-market (GTM) guidance for affiliates to facilitate product growth in key countries and regions. 
Digital mindset to track competitors' products, research and monitor market trends and to help improve the efficiency of the global MSC/ASC growth strategy. 
MAIN RESPONSIBILITES

Operational:

To manage the Global MSC/ASC team in multiple locations effectively to ensure the team remains competent, motivated and efficient. 
Maintain full knowledge and understanding of SGS IT systems, procedures and external approval criteria to conduct audit report reviews and allow efficient management of technical review and certification decision process. 
Develop relevant internal and external KPIs and monitor them to facilitate decision-making and drive continuous improvement. 
Ensure all relevant accreditations and approvals are adhered to, to safeguard the SGS business and brand reputation. 
Manage the launch of new MSC/ASC schemes and revisions. 
Manage the costs and expenses of department effectively to contribute to the overall achievement of the department’s P&L targets. 
Carry out performance review appraisals for team and lead recruitment activity as necessary. 
Technical:

Act as the MSC/ASC technical expert for the global network and effectively convey key messages to stakeholders at all levels within the network demonstrating pragmatism whilst maintaining the integrity of the scheme.

Provide subject matter expertise to the Global Food Team, International Sales and Global Key Account Managers as needed. 
In line with the segment strategy, provide business plan for the growth of the product in key countries and regions. 
Alignment with Marketing function in the development of the relevant specific marketing materials to support business growth. 
Contribute to the achievement of the overall objectives of the Food Assurance business. 
General:

At all times, behave in accordance with the Company’s Code of Integrity & Professional Conduct. 
At all times, adopt a safe behavior by exercising due regard for the health and safety of employees and clients, in line with policies and procedures. 
This job description should not be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements, but a general description of the job. 
The role reports to the Global Food Certification Manager



Qualifications

PROFILE

Extensive knowledge and experience of the MSC/ASC Seafood Certification certification business and relevant regulations. 
Ability to combine technical credibility with relationship management and commercial awareness. 
REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

Excellent understanding of food Aquaculture and quality systems in a certification and auditing context. 
Background from Certified Body is a must have. 
Digital mindset with experience of compliance, food safety and regulatory intelligence platforms. 
Pragmatic, with proven analytical and problem-solving skills. 
Strong team leadership and people management skills. 
Business / commercial acumen to support go-to-market (GTM) strategies. 
Pragmatic with ability to think outside the box. 
Excellent verbal, presentation and technical writing skills. 
Strong interpersonal and communication skills with an ability to build trusted relationships at all levels within and outside the organization. 
Attention to detail with ability to multi-task effectively, work under pressure. 
Ability to manage conflicting priorities across multiple countries or projects. 
Fluent in the English language. 
Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook). 
Experience with Copilot 365 and/or similar AI‑powered productivity and decision‑support tools. 
DESIRABLE SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

Lead auditor level (including the required food processing industry experience) qualification in specific product. 
People management and managing or working with remote teams. 
Extensive audit experience includes commercial proposal preparation (including extensive experience in multi-site proposals and Integrated Audit proposals). 
Responsibility for maintaining accreditation against ISO 17065. 
Work experience within a large multinational company and managing communication within a large network. 
Please note that this is a fully remote role, and we welcome candidates based across Europe or India who have a valid right to work in their country of residence. Please apply with your CV in English.



Additional Information

Why SGS?

Global and very stable company, world leader in the TIC (Testing, Inspection and Certification) industry. 
Flexible schedule and hybrid/remote model. 
SGS university and Campus for continuos learning options. 
Multinational environment where you will work with colleagues from multiple continents. 
Benefits platform. 
Join Us: At SGS we believe in innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and personal development.

jobs.sourceTitle: Fund Accounting and Administration Product Owner - Insurance Accounting, Vice President
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking a senior business Product Owner for the Insurance Accounting product within State Street’s Fund Accounting and Administration platform. This role represents accounting, operational, regulatory, and client needs and serves as a senior business authority across complex functional areas and strategic initiatives.

This is not a technical product owner role. While the position partners closely with technology and development teams, accountability is focused on business requirements, accounting logic, client outcomes, regulatory compliance, product strategy and prioritization, rather than system architecture or technical solution design.

Why this role is important to us

The Vice President, Product Owner plays a critical role in ensuring that product capabilities and enhancements accurately reflect insurance and investment accounting requirements and deliver meaningful value to clients. By acting as the voice of the business, this role ensures solutions are fit for purpose, compliant, and aligned with product strategy, while enabling efficient and effective delivery through agile development teams. The role also drives alignment across business and technology stakeholders, and supports investment decisions for complex, multi-year initiatives.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As the Vice President, Product Owner, you will act as a senior business lead and subject matter expert for the Insurance Accounting product and related strategic initiatives. Responsibilities include:

Serving as one of the primary business authorities for insurance accounting functionality and related reporting
Communicating product direction and measurable business outcomes for assigned product capabilities
Leading complex product initiatives and enhancements that span multiple business processes, client segments, or delivery teams
Engaging clients and internal stakeholders to understand needs, priorities, and impacts
Leading business analysis and functional design efforts; creating clear business design documents and requirements
Defining accounting ledger entries, multi-cost basis behavior, and accounting outcomes for enhancements
Establishing needs for reporting solutions and ensuring alignment with accounting, regulatory, and client requirements
Translating business and accounting requirements into well-defined epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria
Providing business use cases and functional testing scenarios
Providing senior-level oversight of testing strategy and validating accounting accuracy, control effectiveness, and business outcomes
Partnering with product management, development, operations, client service, and other stakeholders to manage dependencies, resolve issues, and maintain an actionable backlog
Assisting with product roadmaps and longer-term functional direction, including recommendations for modernization
Overseeing delivery of enhancements through iterative planning, prioritizing business value and client impact
Identifying cross-product and data dependencies and driving alignment across accounting, reporting, operational, and client-facing capabilities
Creating and maintaining user documentation
Delivering training sessions, and product demonstrations for internal teams and current or prospective clients
Supporting software maintenance and client service teams with business-level troubleshooting
Assisting onboarding teams and clients with conversions and implementations, as needed 


What We Value

The following skills and attributes will help you succeed in this role:

Strategic product leadership and the ability to translate business objectives into clear product direction and priorities
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, including the ability to make informed decisions in complex or ambiguous situations
Deep analytical and research capabilities
Sound accounting judgment and attention to financial details
Ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives simultaneously
Clear and effective communication with a wide range of stakeholders
Strong presentation and written communication skills
Ability to build alignment and drive accountability across complex initiatives
Excellent time management and organizational skills
Proficiency with Microsoft tools (Copilot, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)


Education & Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in accounting or a related field; advanced degree, CPA, CFA, or relevant product experience is preferred.
12+ years of experience as a business Product Owner, product leader, or senior end user of insurance, fund accounting, or financial software OR 12+ years of experience as a senior business analyst, business Product Owner, or product leader supporting financial or accounting platforms
Demonstrated experience leading complex product initiatives
Strong experience with insurance accounting and/or investment accounting, including complex asset classes (e.g., fixed income, derivatives, mortgage loans, alternative investments)
Knowledge of inbound and outbound data flows across the investment lifecycle (e.g., trade processing, cash, market data)
Experience leading within an agile software development environment as a business Product Owner, product leader, or senior business analyst
Significant experience working directly with clients and other stakeholders
Experience with AI tools and applying them to improve product development, analysis, and day-to-day business processes


This role does not require hands-on software development, system architecture design, or technical solution ownership.

Are you the right candidate? Yes!

We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
TJX Companies

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description

Job Title: Staff Product Owner

Location: Hyderabad, India

Role Summary: The Staff Product Owner will lead strategic product ownership for infrastructure platform capabilities within Platform Infrastructure and Enablement, partnering across engineering, operations, security, vendors, and business stakeholders to define priorities, manage dependencies, and deliver scalable, secure, resilient, and business-aligned technology outcomes for TJX.

About TJX

TJX is a leading off-price retailer with a global technology organization that supports business growth across multiple geographies, including the U.S., Canada, Europe, Australia, and India. TJX India serves as an extension of the global IT organization and provides a platform for talent, innovation, capability, and capacity. The Hyderabad office brings together collaborative technology teams that partner across global business and technology functions to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions for the enterprise.

What You’ll Discover

Inclusive culture and career growth opportunities 
Global IT Organization which collaborates across U.S., Canada, Europe, Australia and India, click here to learn more. 
Challenging, collaborative, and team-based environment 

Business Area / Tower Profile

The Platform Infrastructure and Enablement (PIE) organization delivers, operates, and continuously improves the foundational infrastructure platforms that enable TJX applications and enterprise services. PIE provides resilient, scalable, and secure capabilities across data centers, cloud environments, stores, and distribution centers, forming the core platform layer on which application teams build and run solutions.

Job Summary

As a Staff Product Owner within Platform Infrastructure and Enablement, you will define, prioritize, and drive delivery of infrastructure platform capabilities that enable high-performance application hosting across TJX. You will own a strategic, multi-team product backlog spanning enterprise platforms and technologies such as Oracle, mainframe, VMware, cloud, and data center services, ensuring alignment with PIE strategy, delivery priorities, and enterprise objectives. This role partners closely with engineering teams, PIE leadership, security, operations, vendors, and business stakeholders to balance strategic roadmaps with operational needs, manage cross-domain dependencies, and deliver measurable business and technology outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Own and manage a strategic infrastructure product backlog across multiple teams, ensuring priorities are aligned to enterprise outcomes, PIE strategy, governance, and operational needs. 
Translate business and technology objectives into clear features, user stories, enablers, acceptance criteria, and measurable delivery outcomes. 
Partner with engineering, security, operations, vendors, and business stakeholders to define roadmaps, manage dependencies, and drive delivery through sprint and PI cycles. 
Prioritize infrastructure investments based on reliability, scalability, resiliency, security, compliance, performance, cost, and business impact. 
Define success measures and key performance indicators for platform capabilities, track delivery and adoption, and use operational, financial, and customer insights to guide backlog decisions and demonstrate business value. 
Lead and support platform modernization initiatives across Oracle, mainframe, VMware, cloud, and data center environments, including modernization roadmaps, platform migrations, upgrades, automation, technology lifecycle management, and retirement of legacy infrastructure. 

Minimum Qualifications

7+ years of experience as a Product Owner or in a similar product, platform, or delivery leadership role within infrastructure, platform engineering, or enterprise technology environments. 
Proven experience managing complex infrastructure or platform backlogs, translating strategic objectives into prioritized roadmaps and measurable outcomes. 
Product ownership & Backlog management(Oracle Product, Mainframe, AIX, ControlN) 
Strong knowledge of Agile frameworks and practices, including Scrum and SAFe, with experience using tools such as Jira, Jira Align, and Confluence. 
Experience defining, prioritizing, and refining user stories, features, and enablers with clear acceptance criteria and technical requirements. 
Strong understanding of infrastructure domains such as cloud platforms, compute, storage, databases, middleware, networking, enterprise application hosting, and established enterprise platforms including Oracle, mainframe, and VMware products. 
Experience working in enterprise IT delivery environments, including governance, architecture review processes, security requirements, and structured operating models. 
Demonstrated ability to manage dependencies and coordinate delivery across infrastructure, engineering, security, operations, and vendor teams. 
Strong analytical, critical thinking, facilitation, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. 
Self-driven and adaptable professional with strong situational awareness and the ability to proactively identify risks, resolve impediments, and support informed decision-making. 

Preferred Qualifications

Product Owner or Product Management certification, such as SAFe POPM or CSPO. 
Deep understanding of enterprise infrastructure domains, including cloud services, compute, storage, networking, middleware, databases, disaster recovery, and data center operations.

About The/Nudge

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.

Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.

Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.

About The Insight Program

Who are we solving for?

We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.

What are we solving for?

Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.

For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.

Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.

With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.

Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.

Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.

Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.

Work with the product team to develop automations for operations teams

Work with a high level of rigour - especially in implementing development and DevOps best practices

What’s in it for you?

Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile & Digital Marketing | Enterprise AI | Customer Care AI & Technology | Enterprise Technology Modernization

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

India Hybrid: Bengaluru

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from our office in Bengaluru(2 to 3 times/ week). Our office culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.

The Opportunity

Robotics foundation models need millions of hours of dense, real-world data—and simulation alone won't cut it. TELUS Digital is solving the Physical AI bottleneck, capturing highly calibrated, real-world data at scale across hundreds of devices to power the world's leading hyperscalers.

We are hiring a Group Product Manager for the Physical AI Robotics product team. You will own the tooling this runs on: capture applications, operator workflows, session management, review and QA, and customer delivery. You will work with the researchers consuming the data and the operators producing it, and the standards you set will carry into how the industry does this.

Your application will stand out if you are demonstrably curious and have side work projects to showcase.

Responsibilities

8-12 years in product management, including at least 2 in robotics, physical AI, AR/VR, autonomous systems, or data collection at scale.
Own the roadmap for robotics data collection, setting direction and driving execution across engineering, design, operations, quality, and solutions.
Assess demand for new capture modalities, then define the collection model, hardware, and tooling.
Work with engineering and design on the operator experience: onboarding, task guidance, in-session feedback, error states, review workflows. Operators work one-handed, in motion, wearing a headset, or against a clock.
Build prototypes and write the specs. Requirements and user stories that hold up under engineering review.
Translate customer model requirements into collection designs, and evolving research into quality standards for egocentric data: pose accuracy, sync tolerance, occlusion handling, annotation schema, acceptance criteria.
Spend time with collectors, session leads, and reviewers. When data underperforms in training, trace it back to the capture design or the tooling that produced it.
Represent the product directly to hyperscaler and robotics foundation model teams, and bring their constraints back into the roadmap.
Optimize for yield per session, rejection rate, cost per usable hour, capture-to-delivery time, and operator retention.
Champion pilots as the default way to test a change. Small cohort, clear hypothesis, fixed window. Scale what works and stop what does not.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems) or equivalent experience..
Technical depth to hold a real conversation with a research team.
Direct experience with one or more of: egocentric or wearable data capture, teleoperation systems, robot data pipelines, multi-sensor collection rigs or similar setups
Experience defining product vision and roadmaps in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Hands-on robotics background. Robotics, ML engineer on embodied models, teleoperation engineer, or similar.
Familiarity with imitation learning, VLA models, or manipulation policy training, and the data those methods need.
Experience managing distributed human operations, including crowd or contractor workforces.
You have shipped something physical and understand calibration, sensor sync, and coordinate frames, and how they fail.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

Job Title: Executive Product Owner - Enterprise Knowledge Fabric

Business & Team:

The Enterprise Knowledge Domain is a newly established capability and a foundational pillar of the Group's artificial intelligence strategy. The team will define how organisational knowledge is structured, governed, connected and made available across the enterprise. It will work closely with engineering, architecture, data, scientific and business communities to create trusted knowledge foundations that support enterprise search, knowledge discovery and intelligent systems.

Within the domain, the Knowledge Fabric team builds and operates the federated context layer that connects these foundations to people and AI agents, and the Product Owner makes sure it is adopted and delivers value.

Impact and Contribution:

As Exec Product Owner for the Knowledge Fabric, you will own the fabric as a platform product. You will set the roadmap and prioritise the backlog across the context layer, retrieval and MCP services, knowledge controls, and the consumption experience for AI agents and the harnesses they run in, including Agents.CBA, CommbankOS, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and OpenAI Codex.

You will onboard the teams building enterprise agents, user agents and user-defined agents, and make sure the fabric meets their needs for relevance, speed, security and cost. You will define and track platform measures such as retrieval latency, relevance, token cost and entitlement conformance, and coordinate closely with the Chief Data Office, Chief AI Office and End User Experience teams to bring use cases and domains live on the Knowledge Fabric.

You are a platform product leader who can make a complex technical capability simple, valuable and easy for other teams to adopt.

The Knowledge Fabric is building world-leading knowledge management capabilities for our AI-powered colleagues and agents. Together, we will make trusted, permission-aware knowledge available to the AI agents that need it, through a single, consistent retrieval point.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Own the product vision, roadmap and prioritised backlog for the Knowledge Fabric platform. Drive product exploration (e.g. using design thinking and analytics) and formulate hypotheses to validate product strategy / design.
Translate consumer and architecture needs into clear features and acceptance criteria for the context layer, retrieval and MCP services, and knowledge controls.
Accountable for end-to-end value delivery and product lifecycle management (including managing requirements lifecycle, production deployment and release day coordination and sign off).
Assess and implement build vs buy decisions to enable platform and capability build

Lead the onboarding of consuming agent teams across multiple harnesses, with clear documentation, service expectations and support. 
Define and report platform KPIs, including latency, relevance, token cost, availability and entitlement conformance.
Work with the Chief Engineer to balance new capability, reliability, security and technical debt.
Ensure entitlements, fine-grained permissions and agent-specific access controls are reflected in product requirements and evidenced for risk stakeholders.
Coordinate roadmaps and dependencies with the Chief Data Office, Chief AI Office, End User Experience and the Knowledge Domain products.
Track and report progress in bringing use cases and domains live on the Knowledge Fabric. Manage the squad’s performance to defined objectives including OKR tracking, etc.

Essential Skills:

Have owned technical platform, API or data products used by other engineering teams.
Product strategy, vision setting, roadmap creation, and outcome-based prioritisation.
Understand how AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, graph network and LLM applications consume context, and what makes retrieval good.
Ability to assess and implement build vs buy decisions to enable platform and capability build.
Strong stakeholder engagement and product-thinking skills to translate business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products.

Use data and metrics to make product decisions and demonstrate value.

Build trusted working relationships with engineers, architects, risk partners and business teams.
Ideally bring experience in Model Context Protocol, agent platforms, search or data platforms, identity and access management, or cost optimisation for AI workloads.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
About Sanofi

At Sanofi, we're chasing the miracles of science to improve people's lives. We're an AI-driven biopharma company, leveraging cutting-edge technology and data to dramatically reduce the time from molecule discovery to delivering life-changing medicines to patients. Our ambition is bold: harness artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, and modern data platforms to revolutionize how we discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver healthcare solutions globally.

Our Team: Process Enablement Platforms

The Process Enablement Platforms team within Digital Tech is at the heart of Sanofi's digital transformation. We design, build, and operate the foundational technology platforms that enable seamless business processes across our 70+ manufacturing sites, clinical facilities, laboratories, and corporate locations in over 50 countries. Our mission is to unlock value through intelligent automation, data-driven insights, and world-class platform engineering.

We're responsible for core platforms and products that sustain Digital Technologies and part of Business Processes, covering ServiceNow, Configuration Management Database (CMDB), IT Operations Management (ITOM), Asset and Hardware Management, and the data infrastructure that powers AI-assisted IT Service Management. We don't just maintain platform, we architect the future of how Sanofi manages its technology landscape, ensuring every asset, configuration item, and service relationship is discoverable, traceable, and optimized for automation and AI consumption.

Role Overview

As Product Owner Platforms Configurations and Data Management, you will be a technical leader and hands-on architect responsible for evolving Sanofi's CMDB, Discovery, and configuration data ecosystem into an AI-ready, data-centric foundation. This is not a traditional ServiceNow administration role, this is a strategic technical leadership position that bridges platform engineering, data management, AI integration, and DevOps.

You will lead a team of developers, drive technical excellence, and champion the transformation from configuration management to intelligent data operations. You'll work at the intersection of ServiceNow, Snowflake, Generative AI, and modern data platforms, building integrations via APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP), harmonizing data across systems, and implementing automation that challenges the status quo.

This role demands a proactive problem-solver who can code, architect, mentor, and lead, someone equally comfortable designing and implementing data models, writing scripts, configuring ServiceNow Discovery and Service Mappings, and collaborating with AI engineers to build next-generation capabilities.

Main Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Development

Lead the design, development, and optimization of ServiceNow CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, and ITOM capabilities
Architect and implement data integrations between ServiceNow, Snowflake, and enterprise data platforms using REST/GraphQL APIs, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and application-to-application (A2A) patterns
Develop automation scripts and workflows using JavaScript, Python, or other scripting languages to enhance platform capabilities and data quality
Design and maintain data structures, schemas, and harmonization logic to ensure consistency across configuration, asset, and infrastructure data
Leverage Generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, GPT models) and AI algorithms to automate discovery, classification, relationship mapping, and anomaly detection
Implement DevOps practices for platform development, including CI/CD pipelines, version control, and automated deployment across development, test, and production environments

CMDB & Data Management Excellence

Own the strategy and execution of CMDB maturity, ensuring alignment with Common Service Data Model (CSDM) standards
Drive automated discovery and service mapping across hybrid cloud, on-premises, and SaaS environments
Establish data quality frameworks, KPIs, and governance processes to maintain high-integrity configuration and asset data
Technically and processually lead Software Asset Management (SAM) and Hardware Asset Management (HAM) initiatives, ensuring compliance and optimization
Define and implement data harmonization strategies to integrate CMDB data with Snowflake, data lakes, and analytics platforms

Product & Roadmap Ownership

Define and prioritize the product roadmap for Platforms Configurations and Data Management in collaboration with stakeholders
Manage the full product lifecycle: ideation, development, deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, IT Strategy, and business process owners to align platform capabilities with strategic initiatives
Evaluate emerging technologies and methodologies (AI/ML, DataOps, AIOps) and integrate them into the platform strategy

Team Leadership & Collaboration

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of developers and data specialists, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning
Organize and prioritize team workload, remove blockers, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions
Act as a technical point of contact and subject matter expert for CMDB, Discovery, ITOM, and data management
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Infrastructure, Operations, Security, Compliance, and AI/Data Science teams
Drive change management initiatives, challenging existing processes and championing data-driven, automated approaches

About You

Required Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field
Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with CMDB, including automated Discovery, Service Mapping, and asset management in complex, global environments
ServiceNow Expertise: Deep knowledge of ServiceNow ITOM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, and CSDM implementation
Data & Integration Skills: Proven experience with data platforms (e.g., Snowflake), API development (REST, GraphQL), data harmonization, and integration patterns (MCP, A2A)
Development Proficiency: Coding skills in JavaScript, Python, or similar scripting languages; proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation
DevOps Knowledge: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and automated deployment practices
Software & Asset Management: Hands-on experience with SAM and HAM processes, tools, and compliance frameworks
Industry Standards: Solid understanding of CSDM, ITIL, and IT asset management best practices
Agile Methodology: Experience working in Agile environments with product management principles (roadmap definition, backlog prioritization, sprint planning)

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced Education: Postgraduate degree or certification in AI, Data Science, Technology Architecture, or related field
AI & Analytics: Experience with Generative AI tools, machine learning algorithms, and AI-assisted automation
Cloud Platforms: Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP infrastructure and cloud-native discovery tools
Advanced ServiceNow: ServiceNow certifications (CIS-Discovery, CIS-ITOM, CIS-SAM) or equivalent expertise
Data Engineering: Experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and modern data stack technologies

Leadership Competencies

Proactive & Innovative: Self-starter who anticipates challenges, proposes solutions, and drives continuous improvement
Problem-Solving & Analytical Thinking: Ability to diagnose complex technical and data issues and architect scalable solutions
Communication & Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Collaboration & Teamwork: Proven ability to work effectively in global, cross-functional teams across time zones and cultures
Mentorship & Development: Passion for coaching and developing team members, fostering technical growth and accountability

About Tripstack

Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining.

Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform - giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non-partner, low-cost and full-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost-effective API.

Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily.

Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection.

For more information, visit:

www.tripstack.com

www.etraveligroup.com

The role

As a Product Owner at Tripstack, you'll report into a Product Manager serving as an operational leader and product strategist for your portfolio within the Content Acquisition team.

Define, monitor, and proactively manage operational KPIs: uptime, latency, booking failures, error rates, conversion impact, and portfolio risks
Act as primary operational escalation point for airline-related issues, coordinating rapidly across engineering, product teams, and external airline partners

Cross-Functional Coordination & Priority Management

Facilitate resource planning and allocation decisions with your engineering team; identify constraints and trade-offs
Manage the balance between competing priorities (new feature development, production support, incident response, and ad-hoc requests)
Define and communicate clear priorities to engineering teams - including what gets deprioritized and why
Coordinate all team standups, sprint planning, ROMs (Rough Order of Magnitude reviews), and alignment meetings
Track dependencies, blockers, and risks; escalate appropriately and coordinate cross-team resolution

At GSK, the Chief Patient Officer (CPO) organization is one of three strategic pillars of the company – the independent medical and scientific partner to R&D and Commercial. Medical’s vision is to embed the patient voice and external insights into product strategy and evidence generation, shape medical practice through trusted, non-promotional scientific engagement, and deliver measurable health impact for patients at scale.

This is your chance to build the enterprise AI Context Layer for GSK Medical – the trusted, connected foundation that turns data and content from across the medical planning framework into measurable value. As Associate Director Product Owner, Medical Data Products, you will own the data products and context layer spanning Data Generation, Scientific Communications, Medical Information, Publications and Channel Engagement, including Medical Science Liaison (MSL) interactions, non-personal channels, advisory boards and other external engagement activities.

You will join the Medical Cx and Data team – responsible for product management across Medical Cx and measurement, medical analytics and medical content – as a strategic business leader enabled by technology: accountable for outcomes, not just delivery, and the go-to leader and trusted advisor for medical data and AI context.

Working alongside the Medical Measurement Product Owner, Medical Digital & Tech Engineering and Architecture, and partners across Medical Affairs, Enterprise Data & AI, Commercial and Digital & Tech, you will act as the voice of the customer for Global Medical Teams (GMTs) and Local Operating Companies (LOCs) – co-creating data-driven products that reduce time-to-insight, demonstrate the impact of external engagement and help teams act with confidence. Your work will build the trusted, connected and compliant data foundation that powers analytics, GenAI and agentic solutions.

We are looking for a senior data product leader with 8 to 10+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise cloud data platforms, with expertise in data modelling, lakehouse architecture, data integration and governance. You have experience transforming varied source data into canonical (standardized) data models and building governed, reusable data products, with Azure/Databricks experience and a practical understanding of data enrichment and AI/machine learning (ML) data architectures.

About CODE Orange

You’ll build your data products on GSK’s CODE Orange Platform, our enterprise data and analytics platform hosted on Microsoft Azure and GCP. As the core data ecosystem for every GSK business unit and function, it delivers clean, connected data through a unified, trusted, reusable and compliant data lifecycle. Shared standards for governance, role-based access, zero-trust security and auditing protect sensitive data while enabling safe reuse of data across GSK.

What You Will Do

Set an outcome-focused vision

Own the strategy, roadmap and value-based backlog for the Medical AI Context Layer and the data generation, content and channel data products that feed it – co-created with the business, sequenced across the medical planning framework and aligned to GSK’s strategic priorities.

Build the enterprise Medical AI Context Layer

Define and deliver a governed semantic layer – shared medical data ontology, business glossary, knowledge graph and metadata – that links medical objectives, tactics, evidence, content, engagement and outcomes across the medical planning framework, so analytics, GenAI and agentic solutions draw on one trusted, consistent source of medical context.

Drive business value

Champion the customer

Act as the voice of GMTs and LOCs through continuous user research, turning their pain points into an actionable, user-centric backlog.

Define, validate and own success

Set success metrics up front, prove value through proofs of value (POVs) before scaling, and track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as adoption, data quality and user satisfaction.

Evangelize and lead change

Lead change management, demos and training to drive enterprise-wide adoption and data literacy.

Own architecture and canonical models

Oversee data ingestion end-to-end and the target canonical/conformed data model connecting engagement data to GSK Medical data – balancing technical debt against feature delivery.

Establish governance by design

Oversee the data lake governance and framework – access models, schemas, classification, lineage, metadata, quality and storage standards aligned to CODE Orange – partnering with platform, security and data-owner teams and building GxP (regulated good-practice quality standards) and data protection in from the start.

Hold partners to outcomes

Align platforms, engineering teams and vendors around shared outcomes, connecting data across functions and managing dependencies through to completion.

Work AI-first

Use approved AI tools to accelerate discovery and backlog trade-offs – keeping AI in support of decisions, not replacing them.

Future-proof the ecosystem

Ensure data assets are structured, scalable and of high enough quality to power GenAI, predictive analytics and agentic workflows.

Experience leading cross-functional teams, partners and vendors without direct line management.

Domain focus: Security products for Data Security and Cloud/SaaS Security.

Job Purpose: 

End-to-end product owner for the Data Security and Cloud/SaaS security tool domains. You run the full product lifecycle: translating threat intelligence and compliance requirements into capability use cases, coordinating with Security Architecture on solution design, leading vendor evaluation, tracking investment value against regulatory and threat coverage, and driving decommission decisions.

About the team:

Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles.

What makes this role different. Your controls sit directly on regulated personal and clinical data, so a DLP policy change is a privacy decision as well as a security one and you will defend the roadmap to the Data Protection Office and to GxP quality as often as to the CISO. The threat driver is identity rather than perimeter — OAuth consent abuse, over-permissioned service principals and token theft against SaaS tenants — which is why CIEM entitlement reduction and SSPM drift sit ahead of new detection content. You own the product and the investment; Data Security Architecture owns the standards.

Key responsibilities:

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for the Data Security and Cloud/SaaS security tool domains.
Translate data security threat intelligence and compliance requirements into capability use cases.
Coordinate with Security Architecture on solution design, bringing the product and commercial view to their technical one.
Own a one to three year roadmap of investments and retirements aligned to data protection regulation including GDPR and GxP, and to cloud adoption patterns across GSK.
Lead vendor evaluation for data security and cloud/SaaS tooling.
Manage vendor delivery and SLA performance for the platforms in scope.
Track investment value against regulatory and threat coverage rather than delivery milestones alone.
Own adoption as a coverage figure — the share of the sanctioned SaaS estate under SSPM, and the share of regulated data stores labelled and under Microsoft Purview policy — and act when a business unit opts out.
Drive decommission and consolidation decisions across the product set.
Run the product governance forum and keep decisions and rationale traceable for audit.
Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
Coach domain analysts and peers in product management practice, and prove value on a contained scope before scaling a capability across the estate.

15+ years in cyber security in a regulated environment — domain focus: security products for Data Security and Cloud/SaaS Security

Working in parallel with the Security Solution Engineering squad for Data Security and Cloud/SaaS Security — aligning use cases and roadmaps to build, test and vendor handover plans
Product ownership of AI data security controls — DLP and classification for GenAI and copilots, AI-SPM and protection of data flowing into LLMs

Portfolio analytics and ROI modelling — including automated dashboards

You'll own these flows end-to-end, treat them as products to be improved rather than systems to be

maintained, and be accountable for the metrics that show they're working — reachability of support,

resolution quality, and a smooth experience even when things go wrong.

What You'll Do

Own the post-order journey end-to-end — order tracking, cancellations, returns and refunds,

and order care — and set the roadmap, balancing quick wins (e.g., real-time tracking updates)

with longer-term bets (e.g., predictive self-service).

Make customer support reachable and effective: improve discoverability of help across key

journeys, strengthen self-service and automation, and ensure clean escalation to a human

agent when needed.

Reduce avoidable contacts (WISMO, status checks) by fixing root-cause friction in tracking and

communication — without making support harder to reach.

Raise resolution quality, measured by repeat contacts, reopens, and post-resolution satisfaction

— not just the volume of cases closed.

Monitor behavioural analytics regularly, spot abnormal changes, and turn insights into a

prioritised set of product fixes.

Partner across Engineering, Design, Customer Support Operations, Logistics, and Finance to

ship improvements and align on SLAs, policies, and delivery realities.

What We're Looking For

3–4+ years in a product role, ideally in e-commerce, marketplaces, or consumer tech.
Experience owning customer-facing journeys or post-order / order-management / customer-

support flows.

Hands-on with data — comfortable with SQL and analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Looker,

Tableau) to frame hypotheses, run experiments, and measure impact.

A systems thinker who maps complex end-to-end flows and finds the highest-leverage fixes.
Customer-obsessed, with strong written communication and the ability to influence cross-

functional teams without authority.

Nice to Have

Exposure to support tooling (Zendesk, Gladly, or similar), conversational automation / chatbots,

and returns or logistics platforms.

Familiarity with India's e-commerce dynamics — COD, regional cohorts, and delivery realities.

About Purplle

Purplle is one of India's leading beauty e-commerce platforms, with 30M+ users and one of the most

diverse beauty catalogs in the country. We're building the operating system for beauty — connecting

consumers, brands, and beauty professionals in one ecosystem. This role owns the moment of truth:

what happens after the order, where customer trust is won or kept.

About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.

In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will serve as a senior Products leader driving Teradata’s AI product management strategy across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata integrates AI/ML technologies into our enterprise-scale data and analytics platforms. 

Your impact will be shaping how customers harness Teradata Cloud and data warehouse capabilities through AI-driven insights, automation, and intelligent applications. You will set the roadmap for embedding AI into mission-critical workloads, balancing innovation with performance, governance, and compliance. 

Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions optimized for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, unlocking measurable customer value while ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency of AI workloads. 

Who You Will Work With

On our team, we collaborate with engineering, cloud infrastructure, data science, UX, and governance functions to bring next-generation AI capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of AI initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives. 

This role reports to the SVP of Product Management and will partner closely with product engineering and platform leaders worldwide. You will act as the strategic AI product leader for Teradata, influencing global product direction.

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

Role Overview

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.
We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.
With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

Key Responsibilities
Product Vision and Strategy
Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.

Product Execution and Delivery
Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.

Using AI in How You Work
We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.
Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.

Team Leadership
Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.

Customer and Commercial Engagement
Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.

Cross-Functional Alignment
Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.

Qualifications and Experience
12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.
Real familiarity with process mining concepts: how event logs work, what conformance checking involves, how process discovery surfaces insights, and what makes process KPIs meaningful to an enterprise buyer.

Set vision & strategy
