Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

Job Description

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.

Every day, Gracenote ingests data for over 100,000 channels and hundreds of streaming catalogs worldwide. It arrives through thousands of partner feeds covering linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and program metadata, in every format imaginable and changing constantly. That data powers entertainment discovery for the world's top cable, OTT, CE and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.

We are hiring a Sr. Product Manager II to own the Single Ingest Platform, the system that gets all of this data into Gracenote. Based in our Bengaluru engineering center, you will report to our Director of Product Management, Data Ingest and Delivery, and work alongside our Data Delivery Product Manager. Together you own how data enters and leaves our AI-driven metadata factory.

This is a software platform role, and the platform is a service. Teams downstream decide what to do with the data once it lands. Your job is to make sure every source is set up fast, every field we need is captured correctly, and every change reaches the platform in minutes. Speed and accuracy at scale are the whole game.

It is also a hands-on role. You will write specs yourself, work directly with engineers and Data Architects, and query the data to answer your own questions. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work, and who sees AI as the way to run thousands of feeds without thousands of manual fixes.

Responsibilities

Own the product vision, roadmap and delivery for the Single Ingest Platform across linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and every other source type our datasets depend on.

Own the speed and accuracy of getting partner data into Gracenote, from onboarding new sources to processing every update.

Drive AI innovation so ingest scales to new sources, markets and metadata types with greater speed and efficiency, without adding manual processes.

Ensure the platform is monitored for performance and breaks, so issues are caught and resolved before they affect downstream teams.

Run ingest as a service, translating the needs of Dataset Product Managers, metadata factory teams and Delivery into a prioritized roadmap.

Define and publish the platform's service levels and key metrics for speed, accuracy, reliability and cost, and use them to drive decisions.

Work effectively across a globally distributed organization, with strong async written communication, disciplined documentation, and willingness to flex hours for overlap with US and EU stakeholders.

Qualifications

6+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years on platform, data or data integration products.

Hands-on experience with data ingestion or integration at scale: onboarding external sources, handling format and schema changes, and monitoring data flows.

Has applied AI or ML inside a product, not only for personal productivity. Examples include extraction, classification, anomaly detection or schema mapping. Can reason about confidence, error rates and when a human needs to step in.

Actively uses LLMs in day-to-day product work to speed up analysis, automate repetitive PM tasks and make better decisions. Be prepared to walk through concrete examples in the interview.

Demonstrated appetite for hands-on IC work at a senior level. Comfortable with XML, JSON, SQL and REST APIs, and able to write or LLM-assist your own Python or SQL scripts to answer product questions.

Runs a product on a small set of input and output metrics, and delivers predictably against commitments in a structured, milestone-driven development process.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proven ability to influence stakeholders across geographies and time zones.

Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Experience with TV and entertainment metadata, EPG data or content supply chains.

Familiarity with industry metadata and feed standards such as CableLabs ADI, TV-Anytime, or MovieLabs MEC and Avails.

Experience with near-real-time or event-driven data pipelines.

Experience building partner-facing source specifications or self-service onboarding tools.

Experience partnering with Data Architects to shape complex business data into coherent, extensible, scalable structures.

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

A diverse and inclusive organization, we support a healthy work/life balance and are constantly looking for new ways to help the well-being of our people. We support a flexible schedule and are 100% performance and result-oriented.

At Openprovider, we're not just a company; we're a mission-driven team dedicated to transforming the domain industry. We believe in providing a trusted digital identity to every business.

Our innovative approach is reshaping the industry from a traditional transactional model to a more customer-centric, subscription-based approach. We pay subscriptions for music, newspapers, and movies - why should domains be any different?

Our vision is to build a place where curious, self-driven people do their best work together, to deliver on our mission: a reliable, free, and secure online world for every customer we serve. Our world is changing fast, especially with AI, and we see that as an opportunity to stay ahead of change, shape it and create more value for our customers.

Our values

Be a wolf, not a sheep: we value the entrepreneurial spirit in everyone.
Knowledge equals power: we are constantly hungry to learn, for ourselves and our customers.
Enjoy what you do and do what you enjoy: we want work to be something you look forward to.
Quality results in quantity: we care about excellence and attention to detail.
TEAM, Together everyone achieves more: collaboration is how we get our best results.
Come join us on our journey to create a trusted digital world.

About the role

Openprovider's domain portfolio is about far more than registrations. As our Product Manager for Domains & DNS, you will grow what we earn from it, while keeping compliance sound and our resellers' trust high.

You will report to our Director Product and work as part of the Domains squad, alongside Engineering, Domain Operations, Sales, Support, Marketing and Finance.

Key responsibilities

Lead TLD integrations and accreditations end to end, using AI-led execution: build the business case, support registry contracting, deliver the technical integration, implement business policies and compliance, launch and hand over to Domain Operations, and migrate TLDs off upstream suppliers.

Maintain the integration roadmap, prioritised by domains under management at stake and margin uplift, and measure each migrated TLD's margin against its business case.

Own the aftermarket product, including reseller tooling that makes it easy for our resellers to list and sell names, and fast, reliable transfers after each sale.

Own parking monetisation for eligible domains, covering provider performance, page-content standards and reseller revenue share.

Run our expiring domains program (auctions, drop-catch, backorders, DAX), within each registry's rules and ICANN policy.

Act as product owner of the registry automation pipeline: own its requirements, roadmap and quality measurement, agreeing the roadmap with Domain Operations every quarter.

Support the Director Product and Lead PM on the reseller platform and module roadmaps through discovery and clear specifications for assigned items.

Equip Sales, Support and Marketing for every integration change, with a changelog, an internal FAQ and a Support briefing for each release.

Take an active part in agile delivery: grooming, sprint planning, stand-ups and retros for the Domains squad, keeping your Jira items sprint-ready and accurate.

What we are looking for

What you bring

TLD and registry knowledge: you understand gTLD and ccTLD registry models, accreditation processes and regional policy specifics.

Domain systems and EPP: in-depth understanding of DNS, EPP and registry-side processes.

Domain policy literacy: you can apply ICANN policies (ERRP, Transfer Policy, DNS abuse obligations) and registry-specific expiry rules to product design.

Aftermarket and monetization economics: you understand marketplace dynamics, parking yield, auction mechanics and reseller revenue-share models.

Role Overview

Valor PayTech is hiring a Technical Product Manager to own the internal software development lifecycle for our Valor Gateway and Portal — the system of record that powers the entire Credit card processing, Payment Gateway, POS Terminals, SWITCH processing, ECOM Channel, Virtual terminal including ACH capability, and ISVs support. This is a hands-on, in-the-weeds role for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, process, and engineering execution.

You will report directly to the Senior Technical Product Manager and act as the operational and technical backbone of the Gateway’s roadmap — translating business priorities into clear, complete engineering requirements, managing sprint execution, and ensuring releases are delivered with quality and on schedule. Above all, this role owns the discipline of getting analysis right the first time: before a change reaches engineering, you are accountable for enumerating its full impact across the platform, so that what we build is consistent, complete, and free of the gaps that surface late in production.

This role does not require coding ability, but candidates with hands-on technical fluency (SQL, scripting, API / data literacy) will be considered a strong asset given the complexity of the systems involved.

What We’re Looking For

Four qualities define success in this role:

A Self-Starter and Owner — You take end-to-end ownership of your platform’s SDLC without waiting to be directed. You drive backlog, analysis, and releases forward, chase down open questions across teams, and treat every gap between intent and delivery as yours to close.

Technically Fluent — You are comfortable in the details of a complex payments platform — transaction flows, data models, integrations, and configuration — and can hold a credible technical conversation with engineers and QA. You reason about systems, not just features.

Rigorous and Complete — You do not stop at the happy path. Before a change is committed, you systematically map its full impact surface — every transaction type, user persona, device population, credential form, processing feature, integration rail, and configuration state it could touch — so nothing is silently left behind. Completeness of analysis is the single most important thing this role protects.

A Strong Executor and Communicator — You run disciplined agile ceremonies, write specifications engineering can build against without guessing, and communicate clearly with a US-based team — turning business and compliance needs into precise, unambiguous requirements.

End-to-end SDLC management for Valor Gateway and Portal — backlog grooming, sprint planning, release coordination, and go-live sign-off, working closely with engineering leads and QA.

Project estimation and resource planning, partnering with the Senior Technical Product Manager on scoping, prioritization, and developer-day forecasting.

Release documentation, including change logs, workflow enhancement specs, and cross-processor integration notes.

Own phase one of the SDLC — analysis and requirements gathering — as the point where quality is decided. For every change, enumerate the complete impact surface before engineering commits. Facilitate pre-commitment reviews with engineering and QA — a shared walkthrough of scope and impact before build begins.

Translate business and compliance requirements into detailed technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering can execute against without ambiguity.

Platform Domain: Valor Payment Gateway and ISV Project

Understanding Valor Payment Gateway capabilities and work towards offering them for the ISVs
Handling ISVs requirements, lining up for work
Prioritize based on the feasibility and the market value

Senior Product Manager — KYC Platform

Build the onboarding backbone that powers every credit product PayU Finance owns.

ABOUT PAYU FINANCE INDIA

PayU Finance India Limited is one of India's fastest-growing digital lending businesses, operating at the intersection of payments, credit, and technology. Through our flagship consumer product LazyPay and a rapidly expanding suite of merchant lending solutions, we serve millions of Indians with instant, responsible credit — making financial access simple, fair, and digital-first.

We are building the credit infrastructure for the next 500 million Indians. As a regulated NBFC backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest technology investors, we combine the agility of a startup with the governance of a regulated financial institution. Our teams solve hard problems in underwriting, platform engineering, compliance, and product — at scale, in real time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Senior Product Manager for KYC Platform at PayU Finance, you will own the end-to-end Know Your Customer (KYC) infrastructure that underpins every lending product we operate — LazyPay consumer credit, merchant lending, BNPL, co-lending, and future lines of business. This is a platform role, not a product feature role. You will think in systems: designing scalable, partner-agnostic KYC journeys that can be configured, extended, and reused across business units. You will work closely with Compliance, Legal, Engineering, Data, and external partners including KYC bureaus, video-KYC vendors, DigiLocker, UIDAI, and banking correspondents. You will set the gold standard for compliant, frictionless onboarding at PayU Finance.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Define and own the KYC Platform roadmap: design a modular, API-first KYC platform that serves all internal business units as internal consumers — eliminating duplication and enabling faster product launches.
Drive platform thinking: abstract KYC flows into reusable components (identity verification, liveness, document parsing, de-dup, risk flagging) and define clear platform contracts for product teams to build on.
Lead partner integration strategy: evaluate, onboard, and manage integrations with KYC vendors (CKYC, video-KYC, DigiLocker, UIDAI, PAN validation, face-match), negotiate SLAs, and own fallback logic.
Translate regulatory requirements into product specs: work alongside Compliance and Legal to convert RBI, PMLA, and FATF guidelines into product requirements — including re-KYC cycles, audit trail design, and data retention policies.
Build with data: define KYC funnel metrics, drop-off analytics, and fraud signals. Use data to reduce onboarding friction while maintaining regulatory thresholds. Continuously A/B test and iterate on the onboarding journey.
Enable developer experience: define clear API specifications, documentation, and sandbox environments so product and engineering teams across PayU Finance can self-serve on KYC without ad-hoc requests.
Plan for scale and longevity: architect KYC flows that can handle 10x volume, support new product lines (UPI credit, co-lending, embedded finance), and adapt to evolving RBI regulations without re-engineering from scratch.
Drive governance: own the KYC health dashboard — approval rates, STP rates, failure categorisation, re-KYC compliance, audit readiness — and present to senior leadership and regulators.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Platform product experience: 6–9 years in product management with at least 2–3 years owning a platform or infrastructure product — ideally in fintech, payments, or financial services.
Regulated entity experience: hands-on experience working within an RBI-regulated NBFC, bank, or payment aggregator — you understand what compliance means when there is a penalty for getting it wrong.
Technical depth: you can read API documentation, review a system design, and hold your own in an engineering discussion. You understand OAuth flows, webhook architectures, and data pipelines.
Data-driven mindset: you define success with metrics before you build. You are comfortable running SQL queries, interpreting funnel analytics, and building the business case from data.
Partner management: you have experience evaluating and onboarding third-party vendors, writing integration requirement documents, and managing SLA accountability.
Long-term systems thinking: you do not build for the next quarter — you design for the next three years. You document architectural decisions and think about backward compatibility, versioning, and deprecation.
Communication: you can write a one-pager that makes a compliance officer and an engineer agree on priorities. You communicate clearly, escalate appropriately, and drive alignment without authority.

GOOD TO HAVE

Experience in KYC/AML domain — CKYC, V-CIP, DigiLocker, UIDAI API integrations
Knowledge of lending workflows: loan origination, credit bureau pulls, underwriting triggers
Exposure to co-lending or white-label lending platforms
Familiarity with PMLA, RBI Master Directions on KYC (2016, as updated), and FATF guidelines
Experience with identity fraud detection, liveness check providers, or device intelligence

WHY PAYU FINANCE?

Own a platform product that will directly power India's next wave of digital credit — from consumer to merchant to embedded finance
Work at the intersection of product, compliance, and engineering in one of India's most complex regulatory environments
Build from the ground up — this role has significant greenfield opportunity to set the architecture, not just maintain it
Be part of a Prosus-backed, profitable business with the scale of a large company and the decision-making speed of a startup

The App and Ecosystem Trust (AET) team ensures safe, secure, and trustworthy experiences across our global app ecosystem. As the Product Manager for Mokka, you will take the lead on driving the overall strategy and tactical execution of our next-generation review infrastructure. Partner with Operations and Policy teams to design intelligent human-in-the-loop review interfaces, leveraging generative AI assistants to speed up analyst workflows and reduce manual cognitive load.

You will work closely with clients, business stakeholders, UI/UX designers, developers, QA engineers, and technical teams to ensure the successful conceptualisation, development, deployment, and continuous enhancement of software products.

Atlas is the agentic operating system that powers it all.

About the role

The best person for this role finds the marketing stack interesting in its own right: how marketers plan, create, optimize, and measure, and how an agentic system can change all of it. What you will own

Own a core surface of Atlas end to end, from discovery and definition through launch and iteration.
Write crisp product specs that identify the problem, set goals, and define success metrics so design and engineering can build with clarity.

Work hand in hand with engineering, design, data science, and customer success to deliver outcomes, not just features.

What you bring to the table

You have built B2B products. You have several years of product management experience, typically five or more, with real depth shipping B2B software.

You are excited about mar-tech. You find marketing technology and the marketing ecosystem genuinely interesting, and you want to build the tools that marketers and growth teams rely on.

Why this role matters

We are WisdomAI.

We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.

WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.

We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.

About WisdomAI

WisdomAI is on a mission to make working with data delightful. We empower businesses to unlock insights, drive innovation, and make data-driven decisions at scale. Join our rapidly growing team and be a part of a company that is shaping the future of enterprise data. We are a fast-paced, early-stage startup, currently ~30 people and growing.

The Role: A Builder, An Empath, and An Executor

This is not a traditional Product Manager position; it is a dynamic, hands-on function built for the age of AI-native product development. We are a build-first company that values execution and rapid iteration over lengthy documentation.

At WisdomAI, the Product Manager acts as a catalyst for collective intelligence, empowering engineers and designers to propose and build, keenly capture customer feedback, and continuously strive for improvement. This role requires a minimum of 4+ years of relevant experience and a deep balance of technical understanding and customer empathy.

Core Responsibilities

The PM role serves as the glue that connects the customer's needs, the market's demands, and our team's creative and technical capabilities.

Customer Empathy and Data Mastery
Cultivate deep customer empathy by spending time with prospects and users, observing workflows, and understanding their business context. 
Translate customer pain points into clear and actionable problem statements for the development team. 
Leverage your technical and data understanding to evaluate product performance, interpret complex analytics, and inform strategic decisions. 
Proactively track qualitative and quantitative feedback by monitoring support channels, listening to sales calls, and checking in with customer-facing teams. 
Technical Depth and Execution Orientation
Guide the team in choosing the right development approach for the task at hand (PM-first, Design-first, or Dev-first), relying on your technical understanding of our platform. 
Define the problem and its constraints, allowing engineers to write robust solution proposals. 
Maintain a relentless execution oriented focus, seeing yourself as an extension of the development team, unblocking them and consistently following through on commitments to drive features to launch. 
Work effectively in our fast-paced environment, balancing immediate user needs with long-term strategic goals. 
Strategic Communication
Facilitate discussions, lead brainstorms, and articulate a compelling product vision to align the entire organization. 
Act as a product evangelist, collaborating with sales, marketing, and customer success to clearly articulate the product’s value. 
Proactively close the feedback loop, ensuring insights from users and the market are constantly flowing back into the development process. 

What You'll Bring: Qualifications

4+ years of experience in Product Management, specifically within B2B SaaS, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related AI-native platforms. 
Proven track record of successful product delivery and strategic execution in a fast-paced environment. 
Demonstrated technical and data understanding—you must be comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, model performance, and architectural trade-offs with customers and engineers. 
Deeply rooted customer empathy and proficiency in interpreting user analytics and business metrics to guide product strategy. 
Strong collaborative and stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

Our CRAFT

CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.

C — Customer trust. Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.

R — Relentless on outcomes. We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.

A — Authenticity. We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.

F — First principles, grounded in reality. We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.

T — Transparency. We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.

Equal opportunity employer

WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities. 
For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram. 
About Cloud Secure Edge
Cloud Secure Edge (CSE) is SonicWall’s cloud-delivered Security Service Edge (SSE) platform that provides enterprise-grade Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), VPN-as-a-Service, Secure Web Gateway (SWG), and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) capabilities. CSE enables organizations to enforce least-privilege access policies across managed and unmanaged devices, continuously verifying user identity, device posture, and contextual signals before granting access to private applications, SaaS resources, and internet destinations. This is a high-growth, strategically critical product line at the center of SonicWall’s SASE transformation.
The Role
We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help shape and drive SonicWall Cloud Secure Edge. In this role, you will connect engineering, design, sales, marketing, and customer success—translating market needs and customer insights into product direction. You will operate at the intersection of deep technical understanding and sharp commercial instinct, influencing the platform’s evolution to deliver measurable security outcomes for SonicWall customers and partners.
Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Strategy & Roadmap
Influence and help define the Cloud Secure Edge product vision and strategy; own the execution of the multi-quarter roadmap aligned with SonicWall’s SASE and Zero Trust go-to-market objectives.
Prioritize features and capabilities based on customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and engineering feasibility.
Develop and present business cases for new investments to executive leadership, including TAM analysis, win/loss data, and projected impact on ARR.
Technical Product Ownership
Partner closely with engineering leadership to define requirements, write detailed specifications, and make informed trade-off decisions on scope, architecture, and delivery timelines.
Drive integration strategy across SonicWall’s security portfolio, including firewalls, endpoint agents, and threat intelligence services.
Ensure extensibility for MSP automation workflows and third-party integrations (SIEM, SOAR, IdP).
Evaluate and influence platform architecture decisions related to multi-tenancy, scalability, and cloud-native deployment models.
Zero Trust & SASE Domain Leadership
Serve as the internal subject matter expert on ZTNA, SSE, and SASE frameworks, educating cross-functional teams and informing competitive positioning.
Monitor and analyze the competitive landscape (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma, Cloudflare, Netskope) to identify differentiation opportunities and parity gaps.
Translate regulatory and compliance trends (NIST Zero Trust Architecture, CISA guidelines) into actionable product requirements.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Go-to-Market
Collaborate with Product Marketing to develop positioning, messaging, competitive battle cards, and sales enablement content.
Work directly with strategic customers and MSP partners to validate product direction, conduct design-partner programs, and gather feedback.
Support sales engineering teams with technical deep-dives, RFP responses, and proof-of-concept engagements.
Define and track product success metrics including adoption, activation, retention, NPS, and ARR contribution.
Required Qualifications
5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on network security, cloud security, or identity/access management products.
Deep working knowledge of ZTNA, SASE, SSE, SWG, CASB, and/or VPN technologies and their underlying architectures.
Proven track record of shipping cloud-native or SaaS products at scale, with experience managing multi-tenant platforms.
Strong technical fluency: ability to engage with engineering teams on API design, microservices architecture, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Experience working with channel and MSP partner ecosystems in the cybersecurity space.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to C-level stakeholders..
Preferred Qualifications
Experience at a cybersecurity vendor in the SASE or SSE market (e.g., Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks, Cloudflare, Netskope, Fortinet).
Familiarity with identity providers (Okta, Azure AD, Ping) and their integration patterns with ZTNA platforms.
Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or relevant cloud/security credentials.
Experience with agile product development methodologies and tools (Jira, Aha!, Productboard).
Background in data-driven product management with proficiency in analytics platforms (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo).
AI fluency and demonstrated ability to prototype with AI tools: comfortable leveraging LLMs, copilots, and generative AI to accelerate research, ideation, spec writing, and rapid prototyping of product concepts.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for

You will own product areas within Managed Payments, Circle’s regulated payments infrastructure that enables PSPs, financial institutions, banks, and enterprises to use stablecoin-powered payment rails without operating crypto infrastructure themselves. You will define and evolve product capabilities that support managed pay-ins, payouts, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management across stablecoin and fiat endpoints. Working closely with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will translate complex customer and business needs into clear product priorities, lead cross-functional execution, and deliver measurable improvements to how customers move money across geographies and payment rails.

What you'll work on

Own the roadmap for product areas across managed pay-ins, payouts, fiat endpoints, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management, aligning priorities with customer needs and Circle’s goals.
Define and launch capabilities that expand Managed Payments across Circle’s regulated hubs, including new entities, corridors, payout methods, and geographic coverage.
Shape simple, reliable customer experiences for accepting funds, converting value, and disbursing globally across stablecoin and fiat rails, including integrations with CPN and other Circle systems.
Improve customer and operator workflows across onboarding, account setup, transaction visibility, reporting, exception handling, reconciliation, refunds, RFIs, and bulk payments.
Use customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify friction, prioritize investments, and measure improvements in reliability, efficiency, adoption, and customer experience.
Evaluate opportunities to support new payment rails, payout use cases, and digital assets based on customer demand, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and business priorities.
Lead complex cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, BD, and Product, navigating technical and business trade-offs and driving alignment from definition through launch.

What you'll bring to Circle

Core requirements

4+ years of relevant experience, including product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, or similarly complex B2B products.
Experience owning product vision, roadmaps, and execution for B2B capabilities such as payments, pay-ins, payouts, settlement, treasury infrastructure, APIs, or financial operations.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex cross-functional initiatives spanning Engineering and partners such as Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, or commercial teams.
Strong analytical and technical fluency, with experience using customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.
Track record of delivering measurable improvements to customer experience, product adoption, operational efficiency, reliability, or business performance.
Ability to evaluate technical and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and translate complex requirements into clear product priorities and execution plans.

Preferred Requirements

Knowledge of cross-border payments, PSP infrastructure, settlement systems, correspondent banking, or other payment network concepts.
Familiarity with stablecoins, blockchain-based financial infrastructure, or crypto-enabled payment systems.
Experience with enterprise APIs, payment networks, or compliance-forward systems involving payment lifecycle states, reconciliation, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or SLAs.

Why this role matters

Managed Payments is a core part of Circle’s strategy to make stablecoin-powered payments accessible to businesses beyond crypto-native customers. Customers increasingly need complete payment programs that allow them to accept funds, manage balances, convert across assets, and disburse globally without assembling wallets, banking partners, liquidity providers, compliance systems, and payout networks themselves. As Senior Product Manager, you will help turn that complexity into an integrated customer experience and scale Managed Payments into a reliable, global, enterprise-grade product.

Strong software engineering, system architecture, and technical decision-making capabilities.

What Makes This Opportunity Different?

Job Title: Technical Product Manager

Function/Department: Technology

Experience: 15–20 Years

Location: Hyderabad

Role Overview

Position Summary:

As Technical Product Manager you own a product area of the platform end to end: the problem, the outcome, the spec, the quality bar and the release. You know the architecture, data and AI well enough to make real trade-offs with engineers, and you are close enough to underwriting and operations to know which trade-offs matter. Within the platform strategy and portfolio priorities set by platform leadership, you decide what gets built in your area, in what order, and how we will know it worked. You work as a peer with TPMs in the US and India, each owning a different area of the same platform.

In Hyderabad, this role's center of gravity is engineering proximity. You own a product area of the platform, and you sit with the squads that build it. You make sure what ships in your area is specified precisely, evaluated honestly, released cleanly for users in every region, and moves the outcomes it was built for.

Key Responsibilities

Product area ownership: Own the roadmap, backlog and outcome measures for your area within the platform strategy. Make the scope and priority calls, keep the backlog ready two sprints ahead, and answer engineers' questions the same day. 
Business partnership: Work directly with underwriters, operations users and business SMEs on field definitions, rules, accuracy targets and ground truth for your area. Bring regional needs into your roadmap firsthand. 
Specification: Write stories engineers build from without coming back with questions: acceptance criteria as Given/When/Then scenarios, API contracts, event flows, data models, and explicit non-functional requirements. 
Evaluation and ground truth: Build and maintain the golden datasets and evaluation runs for your area. Analyse misses field by field, decide whether the fix is configuration, rules, prompt or model, and turn reviewer corrections into training and evaluation signal. 
Simplest workable path: Rules first, then deterministic tools, then a single model call, and an agent only when the step below fails. Hold the line on cost, latency, explainability and human escalation points. 
Release readiness: Own the readiness gate: acceptance scenarios met, evaluation thresholds passed, regression scope covered by business risk, performance, resilience and access control verified. Validate key functionality in UAT and production yourself. Track predictability, flow and escaped defects, and run retrospectives that change something. 
Global users: Coordinate UAT and rollout with users in North America, EMEA, APAC and LATAM. Publish release notes in business value, not ticket numbers. 
Build with AI: Prototype workflows and screens, analyse evaluation output, and read code and logs to answer your own questions. Show a working prototype, not just a slide. 

Technical Skills

Overall experience of 15+ Years in product, engineering or business analysis roles, including 4+ years as a product manager on platform, data or AI products, with shipped outcomes you can quantify. 
Experience owning a product roadmap and making prioritization calls with business stakeholders, not only managing a backlog. 
Hands-on experience with LLM- or ML-based products: evaluation design, precision/recall trade-offs, confidence thresholds, drift, human-in-the-loop review. 
Specs and acceptance criteria engineers build directly from; comfort with API contracts, event flows, data models and JSON schemas. 
Working SQL and enough Python to analyse data and evaluation output yourself. 
Comfort in the engineering toolchain: code, logs and test results. 
Daily use of AI assistants and coding tools in your own product work. 
Clear writing: one page that moves a decision, for engineers and executives alike. 
Regular overlap with US Eastern and European working hours. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, business or a related field, or equivalent experience. 

Nice To Have

Commercial P&C insurance: submission intake, clearance, underwriting workbenches, rating or policy administration. 
Intelligent document processing or extraction platforms, ontologies or knowledge graphs, canonical data models. 
Cloud platforms (Azure preferred), event streaming, workflow orchestration. 
Prior hands-on experience as an engineer, data scientist or business analyst. 
Agile delivery at scale in a regulated enterprise, across time zones.

You’ll collaborate with engineering and platform teams to manage dependencies, accelerate delivery, and ensure consistency across products. Own the Product and AI Lifecycle: Partner with engineering and data science to design, test, and launch production-ready AI features and models.
Define Success Metrics: Establish and track KPIs for product and AI performance, adoption, and business impact to guide continuous improvement.
Ensure Data Quality: Collaborate with PMs to build ground-truth datasets and evaluate ML/AI feature quality using quantitative and qualitative signals.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with UX, platform, and domain teams to ensure consistent, contextual AI experiences across the procurement suite.
Drive Market Alignment: Partner with Product Marketing to articulate product and AI vision, differentiation, and customer value for go-to-market success.

Belong

We are part of the SAP Ariba Product Management organization. Our mission is to be the single front-door for end users to simplify their work and automate business workflows. Job Description

QAD is looking for a senior product leader to own and advance our Procure-to-Pay and Supplier Relationship Management product strategy for manufacturers.

This role will lead the end-to-end product vision for supplier-facing workflows across sourcing, supplier onboarding, supplier collaboration, purchase order execution, supplier risk, procurement automation, invoice collaboration, and AI-powered decisioning. The objective is to build a modern, workflow-led procurement suite that helps manufacturers improve supply continuity, reduce supplier risk, control material costs, and automate manual procurement work.

This is not a traditional module-owner role. We are looking for a product leader who can think across the full manufacturing procurement workflow, connect SRM with ERP execution, and define how AI agents can help procurement teams move from reactive follow-up to proactive supplier and supply-chain decisioning.

The role will work closely with engineering, AI, platform, sales, services, customer success, and executive leadership to shape the roadmap, commercial packaging, customer adoption, and long-term product differentiation.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Procure-to-Pay and Supplier Intelligence Product Strategy

Define the product vision and roadmap for QAD’s Procure-to-Pay, SRM, supplier collaboration, and supplier intelligence capabilities.
Build a clear product strategy that connects SRM, sourcing, supplier management, PO collaboration, invoice workflows, ERP execution, and AI agents.
Identify the highest-value manufacturing procurement use cases, including supplier delay handling, supplier risk management, sourcing optimization, purchase order change management, and supplier performance improvement.
Translate customer pain points into differentiated product capabilities and commercially compelling offerings.
Partner with GTM teams to position SRM and Procure-to-Pay as a strategic workflow suite for manufacturers.

Lead End-to-End Workflow Product Management

Own the complete Source/Procure-to-Pay workflow from supplier discovery and onboarding through sourcing, PO execution, supplier collaboration, receiving, invoice matching, and supplier performance.
Work across ERP, SRM, procurement, supply chain, quality, finance, and AI teams to ensure the workflow is connected end to end.
Identify where procurement users experience friction, manual work, poor visibility, or delayed decisions, and turn those into roadmap priorities.
Create clear product requirements, workflow maps, customer journeys, and measurable business outcomes.
Drive alignment between workflow needs, platform capabilities, integrations, data model, and user experience.

Build AI Agent And Decision Service Capabilities

Define how AI agents should support procurement users across sourcing, supplier collaboration, exception handling, risk monitoring, and decision support.
Identify agent use cases that can reduce manual follow-up, improve supplier responsiveness, recommend alternatives, and accelerate procurement decisions.
Partner with AI and data teams to define the context, permissions, guardrails, workflows, and approval paths required for safe agent execution.
Build capabilities that move from insight to recommendation to governed action.
Help define procurement-related Decision Services, starting with high-value use cases such as supplier delay handling and supplier risk response.

Drive Customer and Market Understanding

Spend significant time with manufacturing customers, procurement leaders, supply chain leaders, finance leaders, and suppliers to understand real-world workflows.
Develop a strong point of view on direct materials procurement, supplier collaboration, supplier quality, risk, and cost management.
Understand competitive offerings across SRM, source-to-pay, direct procurement, supplier collaboration, and procurement orchestration.
Use customer feedback, win/loss insights, product analytics, and market research to shape roadmap priorities.
Partner with sales and customer success to improve adoption, attach, retention, and expansion.

Partner Across the Business

Work with engineering to deliver scalable, reliable, and configurable product capabilities.
Work with platform and integration teams to ensure procurement workflows connect cleanly with ERP, finance, supplier, and third-party systems.
Work with sales and marketing to create clear messaging, packaging, demos, and value stories.
Work with services and customer success to simplify implementation and accelerate customer outcomes.
Provide executive-level visibility into roadmap, adoption, risks, and investment priorities.

What Success Looks Like

Clear product strategy and roadmap for Procure-to-Pay, SRM, supplier collaboration, and AI agents.
Prioritized set of high-value procurement workflows and Decision Services.
Strong alignment across product, engineering, AI, sales, services, and customer success.
Customer-validated use cases for supplier delay handling, supplier risk, sourcing, and PO collaboration.
Clear commercial positioning for SRM and Procure-to-Pay in manufacturing accounts.

In The First 12 Months, Success Will Include

About This Role

The/Nudge is building its own technology products to run the organisation better and to deliver programmes at scale. These include internal platforms our 400+ team members use day to day, and tools that support our programme and field teams. We build fast and in-house, using AI-assisted development tools and LLMs.

You will work closely with leadership, programme teams, strategy and operations teams, and with the engineers who build our products. This role suits someone who wants hands-on product ownership early in their career, in an organisation where technology directly serves social impact.

What will you do?

Discover the problem: Work with internal teams and end users to understand their workflows and pain points through interviews, observation, feedback and usage data. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements.
Define the product: Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories and acceptance criteria. Make sure every feature has a clear purpose, scope and measure of success.
Prioritise the roadmap: Maintain the product backlog and roadmap. Weigh user impact, effort, risk and organisational priorities, and explain trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
Build with engineering and AI: Work hands-on with developers, interns and AI-assisted development tools to design, build and iterate on features. Translate requirements into precise, well-scoped instructions.
Test before release: Plan and run user acceptance testing, coordinate beta testers, and track bugs and fixes through to closure. Protect live products from regressions.
Launch and drive adoption: Plan rollouts, write launch communications, run demos and training sessions, and create user guides so that products are actually used.
Measure what matters: Define and track product metrics such as adoption, usage and user satisfaction. Use the data to decide what to build, fix or retire next.

Grow the product practice: Help bring a product-first, AI-first way of working to new initiatives as The/Nudge builds more products in the future.

The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.

Accountabilities


Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product & its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization’s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements. 
Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.
Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully. 
Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog. 
Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy. 
Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience. 
Acceptance Criteria Definition & Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value. 
Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives. 
Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on-going readiness and 'run' activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals. 
Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions.


Assistant Vice President Expectations


To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

About the Company

At ZillOut, we build the operating layer behind how India goes out. Nightlife, dining, live events. Fast-moving spaces with real transactions happening every minute.

Whether it’s clubs, sundowners, dinner with friends, chasing cocktails, cafés, or concerts, one AI-enabled System Delivers Smarter Operations, Leakproof Transactions, Faster Event & Entry management, World’s First Digital Cover, Smooth POS & Ordering, Branded Ticketing & Reservation Platform.

About the Role

We're looking for an Associate Product Manager to join ZillOut's Product team. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, QA, Operations, and customers to understand real-world problems and help build scalable solutions for the hospitality and F&B industry.

Roles & Responsibilities

Company Overview

Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.

Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.

We are looking for a talented individual contributor to join a cross-functional product team responsible for integrating the Order & Portfolio Management System with the broader platform ecosystem and building new O/PMS features, with a focus on seamless trade lifecycle workflows from order creation through to position synchronization, reconciliation, and post-trade processing.

What You'll Do

Own features from concept to delivery across the trade lifecycle, producing roadmaps and feature specifications through domain deep-dives and requirements gathering for order workflows, FIX connectivity, allocation logic, and portfolio analytics.
Articulate product value propositions drawing on knowledge of order routing, execution management, portfolio construction, and position keeping.
Partner with engineers, architects, and platform partners to translate specs into product, bridging trading desk workflows and back-office accounting while coordinating timelines, dependencies, and deliverables across integration workstreams.
Build comprehensive test cases covering order routing, execution, position synchronization, data mapping, exception handling, and end-to-end integration.
Conduct competitor analysis across the OMS/PMS/EMS landscape.

What You'll Need

8+ years in front, middle, and/or back-office; 4+ years in product management.
2+ years of direct experience working with OMS and/or PMS platforms, covering order creation, routing, execution, allocation, and settlement.
Familiarity with how OMS/PMS platforms interact with execution venues, prime brokers, fund administrators, and accounting engines.
Experience collaborating with engineers in an agile environment.
Ability to manage multiple workstreams with diligence.
Graduate degree in software engineering, finance, or a related quantitative field.

Arcesium's Personal Data Privacy Notice for Candidates is linked here.

Title: Product Manager, Alternative Investments

About BetaNXT

BetaNXT is a leading provider of frictionless wealth management infrastructure, real-time data solutions, and an enhanced advisor experience. We invest in platforms, products, and partnerships to accelerate growth for the ecosystem we serve. Our connective approach empowers our clients to deliver a comprehensive, end-to-end advisor and investor experience.

BetaNXT is a premier provider of technology, data, and operations as services to a rich client base of wealth managers, institutional wealth firms, and digital brokers. It is comprised of three industry-leading businesses which, combined, provide end-to-end solutions across the investment lifecycle.

Overview Of The Product Manager, Alternative Investments

The Product Manager, Alternative Investments serves as the product and subject matter expert for the firm's retail alternative investment solutions within the Pooled Asset Solutions team. This role is responsible for defining product capabilities, performing detailed business and technical analysis, and delivering clear functional requirements that support scalable back-office solutions for broker-dealers, retirement recordkeepers, and asset managers. The ideal candidate is comfortable working hands-on in an Agile environment, partnering closely with engineering and clients to translate complex operational workflows into high-quality software solutions while advancing the firm's product and partnership strategy.

Duties And Responsibilities Of The Product Manager, Alternative Investments

Monitor and assess evolving needs in the alternative investment space to identify new and evolving opportunities for current and future products.
Define product vision and contribute to the BetaNXT Alternative Investments roadmap, support system development and remediation initiatives to ensure process improvement.
Design and document product solutions, including BRDs, use cases, workflows, and gap analyses. 
Develop and maintain deep expertise in retail alternative investments, including an understanding of the various industry partners (InvestCloud Private Markets Network, Corastone, SS&C AltServ, CAIS, DTCC AIP) with which BetaNXT integrates.
Work closely with development teams in an agile environment to drive high-quality, iterative delivery of features to production.
Drive business testing and validation of use cases; support the QA process through to product releases.
Build and maintain positive client relationships, manage client-specific change requests, and support Client Services on complex alternative investment issues.
Assist in product feature definition for sales and marketing, work with the Project Management Office to track milestones, and manage delivery expectations.


Skills And Experience Of The Product Manager, Alternative Investments

Minimum of 8 to 12 years of relevant experience
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required
Prior experience at or supporting firms providing alternative investments to broker-dealers, custodians, or wealth managers. Candidates with experience in mutual funds are also encouraged to apply.
Extensive knowledge of retail alternative investment products, operations, and distribution workflows, including private equity, private credit, hedge funds, non-traded REITs, and interval funds, and the industry ecosystem for these products (e.g., DTCC AIP, InvestCloud Private Markets Network, CAIS, SS&C AltServ).
Solid understanding of product lifecycle management and agile methodologies
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills; ability to work independently and structure complex problems clearly.
Proficient with Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint), Jira, Confluence


Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation package commensurate with experience and market location including full benefits offering and PTO. Minimum salary of $125,000 plus bonus opportunities and other incentives.

The Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Product Management - Manager, you will lead the charge in developing innovative software solutions that drive digital transformation and enhance business performance. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will combine technical experience with creative thinking to deliver software products that revolutionize industries and provide exceptional user experiences. This role involves designing, coding, and testing applications that meet the evolving needs of clients.

As a Manager, you will enhance your leadership style by motivating, developing, and inspiring your team to deliver quality results. You will be responsible for coaching and leveraging team members' unique strengths to meet client expectations. With your growing business acumen, you will play a crucial role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values meaningfully. Embracing technology and innovation, you will enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.

In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will also address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members, and other stakeholders, while upholding professional and technical standards.

Responsibilities

Leading the development and implementation of innovative software solutions to drive digital transformation
Managing and mentoring teams to enhance their skills and deliver quality software products
Designing, coding, and testing applications using programming languages such as Java, Python, and C#.NET
Overseeing the application of software development methodologies and lifecycle management
Collaborating with stakeholders to analyze business requirements and translate them into technical specifications
Utilizing API management and microservices to enhance software integration and functionality
Conducting code reviews and quality assurance testing to maintain software standards
Implementing continuous integration and delivery practices to streamline software deployment
Encouraging the adoption of AI-human collaboration and digital tooling to improve software development processes
Addressing and resolving conflicts or issues within the team and with clients to maintain project timelines and deliverables

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 8 years of experience
Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

Strong product fundamentals & product sense — owns a product surface end-to-end: discovery, roadmap, prioritization, launch, iteration.
Can defend why this problem, this quarter.
6+ years in product management, including a zero-to-one product.
Requirements and stakeholder craft — elicits needs from business and technical stakeholders, writes clear PRDs and acceptance criteria, and manages senior stakeholders and clients with honesty and calibration.
Hands-on with AI tools in their own workflow — has used AI-assisted tooling to produce working prototypes, wireframes, or internal tools themselves. - Practical understanding of how AI products behave knows outputs are probabilistic, has thought about how to tell whether a model's answers are actually good, and can talk sensibly about accuracy, cost, latency, and where AI is the wrong tool.

Domain expertise— financial services, healthcare, energy, manufacturing, public sector.

Excelling in client management and delivering impactful messages

Job Description – Associate Product Manager, Repayments & Collections
About CreditSea

CreditSea is an RBI-registered, digital-first NBFC operating at scale. We are building technology-led lending experiences that make borrowing simple, seamless and accessible for customers.

As we scale our lending business, we are focused on improving repayment experiences, increasing repayment efficiency and building robust systems to support collections operations.

The Role

We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to own and improve the end-to-end repayment experience.

The primary objective of this role is to make repayments seamless and convenient for customers while improving repayment success rates and collections efficiency.

You will work across customer-facing repayment journeys, payment integrations, reminders and collections-related product capabilities. The role requires a strong understanding of lending repayment cycles, payment mechanisms and collections metrics, along with the ability to drive execution across multiple stakeholders.

Works closely with: Collections, Finance, Engineering, Data & Analytics teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Repayment Journeys & Payment Integrations

Own and improve end-to-end repayment journeys across payment modes, including UPI, AutoPay/e-NACH, UPI AutoPay and other relevant payment mechanisms.
Improve repayment success rates by identifying friction across payment initiation, authentication, mandate registration, payment failures and retries.
Work with payment gateways, banks and external partners to improve payment reliability and success rates.
Enable flexible repayment options, including part-payments, early repayments and other customer-friendly repayment mechanisms.
Ensure accurate and seamless integration of repayment systems with internal lending platforms.

2. Repayment Experience & Customer Engagement

Build and optimise repayment reminders and nudges across channels such as WhatsApp, SMS, calls and app notifications.
Improve customer visibility into outstanding dues, repayment schedules, payment status and transaction history.
Identify opportunities to simplify repayment journeys and reduce failed or delayed payments.
Work on customer communication and self-service capabilities to reduce repayment-related friction.
Ensure a consistent repayment experience across different customer touchpoints.

3. Collections Product Capabilities

Develop a strong understanding of collections workflows, repayment cycles and delinquency management.
Work closely with Collections teams to improve product capabilities supporting early collections and overdue recovery.
Track and optimise key metrics such as repayment success rates, bounce rates, DPD buckets, roll rates and collection efficiency.
Build product capabilities that support more effective collection interventions and improve repayment behaviour.
Translate operational challenges and collections requirements into scalable product solutions.

4. Product Execution & Stakeholder Management

Work closely with Engineering, Design, Collections, Finance and other stakeholders to define requirements and drive initiatives end-to-end.
Translate business and operational requirements into clear product specifications, user stories and execution plans.
Prioritise initiatives based on customer experience, business impact, operational efficiency and implementation effort.
Coordinate with external payment partners and service providers for integrations and issue resolution. 
Drive testing, releases and post-launch monitoring to ensure product improvements deliver measurable outcomes.

What We're Looking For

2-4 years of Prior experience building or managing repayment journeys in a digital lending, fintech, payments or banking environment.
Hands-on experience with repayment mechanisms such as UPI, e-NACH, AutoPay, payment gateways and mandate management.
Strong understanding of lending collections processes and metrics, including bounce rates, DPD buckets, roll rates and collection efficiency.
Experience working on customer-facing repayment journeys and payment integrations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to identify problems and measure product impact.
Strong stakeholder management and execution skills, with the ability to coordinate across multiple teams and drive initiatives independently.

Good to Have

Prior experience in a digital lending company, NBFC, bank or fintech.
Familiarity with loan management systems (LMS), repayment allocation, reconciliation and delinquency management.
Experience working with payment aggregators, banking partners and payment infrastructure providers.
Exposure to collections automation, customer communication platforms and digital collections channels.
Understanding of customer repayment behaviour across different DPD buckets. 

Why Join CreditSea?

Build and own: Take ownership of critical repayment journeys and payment integrations.

Business impact: Work on products that directly influence repayment rates, portfolio quality and collections efficiency.

Ownership and visibility: Work closely with business and technology leadership and drive initiatives across multiple functions.

Opportunity to grow: Play an important role in building scalable repayment technology as CreditSea grows.

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. The Finance Accounting team builds the accounting foundation behind Rippling’s Finance products. We help customers turn the activity happening across spend, procurement, reimbursements, and other finance workflows into accurate, auditable data in their ERP.

This is a high-leverage product area where accounting infrastructure, ERP connectivity, and AI automation meet. The team’s work spans the full lifecycle of financial data: helping customers configure accounting rules, validate transactions before they post, recover when syncs fail, and ultimately close their books with more confidence and less manual work.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Product Lead to lead Finance Accounting at Rippling. You will own the accountant experience across Rippling’s Finance products and help define the future of accounting automation on top of Rippling’s platform.

Your mandate spans two important problems. First, you will build the accounting infrastructure, workflows, and ERP integrations required for Rippling to serve complex enterprise Finance customers. Second, you will help create a new generation of AI-powered accounting workflows that automate manual close work — from validating transaction coding and configuration readiness, to recovering failed syncs, reconciling activity, and preparing adjustments.

Partner deeply with engineering and design to turn complex accounting and integration problems into intuitive, reliable product experiences.

Strong customer instincts and a willingness to learn detailed accounting workflows firsthand. 
High ownership. You should be comfortable setting direction and making decisions in a fast-moving environment. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Have owned technical platform, API or data products used by other engineering teams.
Product strategy, vision setting, roadmap creation, and outcome-based prioritisation.
Understand how AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, graph network and LLM applications consume context, and what makes retrieval good.
Ability to assess and implement build vs buy decisions to enable platform and capability build.
Strong stakeholder engagement and product-thinking skills to translate business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products.

Build trusted working relationships with engineers, architects, risk partners and business teams.
Ideally bring experience in Model Context Protocol, agent platforms, search or data platforms, identity and access management, or cost optimisation for AI workloads.
