Director, CTI Commercial India, Tech@Lilly

Note: Roles are posted at the lowest level of a band. Employees hired into banded positions transfer at their current level, despite the level indicated in the posting.

Role Overview

The Technical Product Manager (TPM) owns the product vision, roadmap, prioritization and value realization for Lilly USA Commercial Sales data and analytics products. The role translates the needs of Sales Operations, field leadership and commercial teams into trusted, reusable data products and analytical capabilities that improve field effectiveness, customer engagement and business decision-making.

This individual-contributor role combines strong Commercial Sales stakeholder partnership with formal product management accountability. It moves beyond demand intake and status coordination to owning product outcomes, roadmap decisions, prioritization, adoption and measurable business value.

The TPM owns the Sales vertical product direction and business outcomes while partnering with platform Product Owners, Data Architects, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, engineering, quality and compliance teams that retain accountability for their respective platform, architecture and delivery responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

Product vision, strategy and roadmap

Define and communicate a multi-quarter data-product vision and roadmap for Commercial Sales, aligned with Commercial Unit priorities and the broader Data & AI strategy.
Translate business problems such as field effectiveness, targeting and customer engagement into validated product opportunities, data requirements and measurable outcomes.
Prioritize the roadmap and backlog using business value, urgency, strategic alignment, effort, risk, compliance, capacity and dependency trade-offs; make and defend scope decisions with leadership.
Maintain a transparent roadmap, release outlook and product lifecycle plan, clearly communicating changes in priorities, capacity, funding or dependencies.
Align the Sales roadmap with reusable enterprise capabilities, platform roadmaps and relevant AI innovation initiatives before approving vertical-specific development.


Product discovery and data-product definition

Lead structured discovery with field users, Sales Operations, reporting teams to understand decisions, workflows, unmet needs and pain points before defining solutions.
Validate problems and proposed product concepts through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, data analysis, usability testing and field feedback.
Define the business contract for each Sales data product, including intended consumers, decision use cases, product grain, key identifiers, business definitions, source systems, refresh expectations, quality thresholds, access requirements and service expectations, in partnership with the Business Analyst and Data Architect.
Maintain a clear product catalogue covering product purpose, business owner, product owner, consumers, lifecycle status, dependencies, service expectations and adoption measures.


End-to-end product delivery and acceptance

Own product outcomes from validated opportunity through production adoption, including scope, prioritization, release decisions, enablement and post-launch value tracking.
Own product priorities, backlog ordering and timely scope decisions; partner with the Business Analyst to translate outcomes into epics, features, user stories, data requirements and acceptance criteria.
Partner with the Scrum Master so planning refinement, reviews and delivery ceremonies support product priorities and timely decisions.
Work with data engineers, analysts, ML engineers, quality teams and architects to resolve product questions and make informed value, usability, risk and sequencing trade-offs.
Establish business acceptance criteria, coordinate UAT with authorized Sales stakeholders and secure business sign-off before release.
Ensure critical Sales measures are reconciled across source systems, data products and consuming reports before production adoption.

We are building Atlas, Pepper's agentic operating system, and we want a product leader who has built a company before to take it from 0 to 1 and then 1 to 10.

About Pepper

Pepper is the Agentic Organic Growth System that drives outcomes. Today's fastest-growing companies trust Pepper to drive growth via SEO and AI-search, combining strategy, AI agents, and embedded expert operators. We drive content-led growth for 2,500+ industry leaders, including Amazon, Google, Unilever, Atlassian, HSBC, Instacart, ITC, and Xiaomi.

We are organic growth infrastructure for the AI era. AI search rewrote the rules of discovery, SEO tools did not catch up, and agencies did not reskill. Pepper was built for this new layer, where strategy, agents, and operators work as one system, and where we own outcomes rather than just dashboards or deliverables. Atlas is the agentic operating system that powers it all.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Product Lead to own the AI and agentic product surface within Atlas, driving product development from concept to launch inside a fast-paced, customer-obsessed organization.

This is a 0 to 1 and 1 to 10 role. You will take new product surfaces from a blank page to a first shipped version, then scale the ones that work. The ambition is long-term and transformational, but the cadence is fast. We want someone who thinks sharply, ships quickly, and iterates in tight loops.

It is also a change management and transformation role as much as a product role. You will work very closely with our services teams and their operational workflows, encoding how expert work actually gets done into product. We need someone who understands Service as a Software thinking, where software and agents transform how a service is delivered, and who is not conventionally tied to building only pure SaaS products.

This role is based out of Pepper's Mumbai office in Andheri East and is on-site.

What you will own

Drive product development for the AI and agentic surface of Atlas from concept to launch, with strong written communication of product concepts and updates.
Lead the definition and design of core experiences for the Atlas Super Agent and the Agentic Workflow Builder.
Write crisp product specs that identify the problem, set goals, and define success metrics so design and engineering can build with clarity.
Encode the craft of expert SEO and GEO operators into product: AI workflows, agents, and automations that make good work repeatable.
Work hand in hand with services teams to translate real operational workflows into scalable product, and drive the change management that adoption requires.
Deconstruct complex problems with technical depth and a steady diet of product usage data to inform the roadmap.
Practice build versus buy, and partner with third parties where integrations add scalable functionality faster.

What you bring to the table

We care more about what you have built and owned than about a strict year count.

You have been a founder. You have founded or co-founded a software company and played a hybrid role across its technical and business sides.
You have done 0 to 1 and 1 to 10. You have launched enterprise products, SaaS or services, and scaled the ones that worked.
You know B2B and the US market. You have built B2B products and worked closely with US customers, and you understand how enterprise buyers and marketing teams there evaluate, adopt, and expect to be supported.
You think beyond pure SaaS. You understand Service as a Software thinking and are comfortable building product around services, workflows, and the change management that transformation requires.
You move fast and think sharply. You ship quickly, iterate in tight loops, and stay scrappy when the situation calls for it.
You are technical enough. You have strong familiarity with APIs, authentication, and integrations, and have built enterprise products that required third-party integrations.
You deconstruct complexity. You break down hard problems, spot patterns, and take a data-driven approach to solutions.
You write and persuade well. You write clearly about product concepts and plans, and you lead through clarity and conviction, not authority.
You work shoulder to shoulder. You are at home with data science, engineering, design, and customer success, and you build real relationships with customers and stakeholders.

Why this role matters

Most product roles add features to a finished category. This one helps define a new one. Atlas is the bet that organic growth becomes an agentic system: deep enough in craft that a general model cannot match it, and intelligent enough that a super agent can operate it.
If you have built a company before, want to build again without starting from zero on everything, and want to ship fast against a genuinely large idea, this is the seat.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced product leader to drive the strategy and development of technology-enabled learning products. The role will focus on understanding user needs, shaping product experiences, defining roadmaps and validating innovations through research and data. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the individual will translate insights into scalable, user-centric products that improve learning experiences and outcomes.


Responsibilities
1. Product Strategy, Discovery & Problem Framing
  • Lead product discovery and problem definition, drawing on user research, programme insights and field realities.
  • Identify user needs, pain points, constraints and opportunities across learners, educators and other stakeholders.
  • Conduct user interviews, stakeholder consultations and field immersions to validate problem statements.
  • Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into clear product opportunities and solution directions.
  • Ensure product strategy is aligned with organisational priorities, user needs and intended learning outcomes.
2. Product Experience & Journey Ownership
  • Own end-to-end user journeys, from exploration and decision-making to learning and career transitions.
  • Define experience principles, product flows and interaction requirements across digital platforms and supporting touchpoints.
  • Work closely with UX and Learning Experience Design teams to create intuitive, engaging and accessible experiences.
  • Identify friction points affecting user engagement, retention, completion and learning outcomes.
  • Champion learner- and educator-centric design, particularly for users in low-resource and diverse learning environments.
3. Product Definition & Execution
  • Translate product opportunities into clear product requirements, PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Define feature scope, expected outcomes, dependencies and success measures.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Design teams to assess feasibility and ensure effective product delivery.
  • Guide teams through product trade-offs while maintaining focus on user value and strategic priorities.
  • Ensure alignment between product requirements, content experiences, technology and programme implementation.
4. Product Roadmap & Prioritisation
  • Develop and manage the product roadmap in alignment with strategic objectives and user needs.
  • Prioritise initiatives based on user value, learning outcomes, organisational priorities and evidence from research and experimentation.
  • Balance immediate product improvements with long-term product vision and scalability.
  • Continuously review and refine priorities based on user behaviour, performance data and emerging insights.
  • Build stakeholder alignment around product direction, timelines, priorities and trade-offs.
5. Product Analytics, Experimentation & Validation
  • Partner with Analytics and Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) teams to define product success metrics, behavioural indicators and learning outcomes.
  • Drive data-informed product decisions through user behaviour analysis, feedback and performance insights.
  • Design and oversee A/B testing, usability studies, pilots and other product experiments.
  • Establish hypotheses, validation criteria and measurement frameworks for new features and initiatives.
  • Interpret experiment findings and translate them into actionable product recommendations.
  • Identify whether challenges are related to product design, content quality or implementation, and use evidence to determine appropriate interventions.
6. Innovation & Product Governance
  • Lead product-related contributions to innovation frameworks, validation processes and stage-gate reviews.
  • Define MVP assumptions, learning questions and validation criteria for new product opportunities.
  • Work with Programme, Product Operations, Analytics and Knowledge Management teams to assess and validate innovations.
  • Use evidence from pilots and experiments to determine whether initiatives should be scaled, refined, redesigned or discontinued.
  • Contribute to portfolio reviews, innovation assessments and strategic product decisions.
  • Ensure that product innovations are supported by clear adoption, engagement, learning and impact measures.
7. Experience Quality & Continuous Improvement
  • Establish and maintain standards for usability, accessibility, consistency and overall product experience.
  • Monitor product health indicators and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Work with Design, Engineering and Learning Experience Design teams to improve product quality and user satisfaction.
  • Ensure product experiences remain simple, relevant and effective across different user groups and operating contexts.
8. Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  • Provide strategic direction and functional leadership across product experience initiatives.
  • Build strong working relationships with cross-functional teams, senior stakeholders and external partners.
  • Facilitate collaboration between Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics and Programme teams.
  • Drive clarity, accountability and alignment in complex and evolving product environments.
  • Mentor team members and contribute to building a culture of user-centricity, experimentation and evidence-based decision-making.


Required Experience & Skills
  • 6+ years of relevant experience in product management or product development, preferably within learning applications, EdTech or digital learning platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience in product discovery, product strategy, UX-driven development and end-to-end product ownership.
  • Strong understanding of user research methodologies, journey mapping, problem framing and experience design.
  • Experience designing, conducting and interpreting A/B tests, usability studies, pilots and product validation experiments.
  • Proven ability to take products, features or innovations from concept through validation, iteration and scale.
  • Experience developing product roadmaps, defining requirements, writing PRDs and prioritising product initiatives.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use behavioural, engagement and learning data to inform product decisions.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across Design, Learning Experience Design, Analytics, Engineering and Programme functions.
  • Ability to distinguish between product, content and implementation challenges through research and evidence.
  • Familiarity with MVP development, innovation frameworks, experimentation methodologies and stage-gate processes.
  • Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities and drive outcomes in dynamic environments.
  • Prior experience in education, skilling, employability, youth development or social impact is preferred.

At ideaForge Technology, we are pioneering the future of autonomous flight. Role Summary

As an Assistant Product Manager (APM) / Product Manager (PM) for the Small Hybrid Verticals portfolio within the Switch UAV family, you will own the product lifecycle, strategy, and market performance for this critical product line. You will report to the Senior Product Manager and operate as a leader within the product management function, bridging customer demand (defense, paramilitary, state agencies) with engineering capability, manufacturing constraints, and regulatory certification requirements.

This role blends strategic product development with hands-on execution across requirements, regulatory alignment (DGCA, FCC, BlueUAS Certification), business planning, and cross-functional team leadership. You will drive the product roadmap from market research through production at scale, managing trade-offs between performance, cost, compliance, and customer needs.

Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership

 Develop and execute the multi-year product roadmap for Small Hybrid Verticals. Define product variants, performance tiers, and feature evolution across the Switch family.  Drive business cases for new initiatives (new variants, payload integrations, airframe configurations). Forecast revenue, unit economics, and market penetration for roadmap milestones.

Customer & Market Intelligence

 Support sales and business development teams with tender responses, feature positioning documents, and pricing justification. Participate in customer demonstrations and technical discussions to validate requirements.

Regulatory Certification & Compliance Leadership

 Own the regulatory certification pathway for Small Hybrid Verticals through DGCA Type Certification and international regulatory bodies (FAA, EASA, etc.). Coordinate with certification teams, external agencies, and technology partners.

 Manage dependencies with external regulatory bodies and escalate blockers to senior leadership.

Cross-Functional Program Leadership

 Lead integrated product development programs with hardware (airframe, propulsion, avionics), electronics, software, and manufacturing teams. Facilitate requirements clarity, dependency tracking, and milestone achievement.

 Chair product review meetings, design reviews, and launch readiness gates. Escalate technical risks and resolve trade-offs between cost, performance, and timeline.

 Mentor junior product team members and interns. Provide guidance on requirements gathering, market analysis, and business case development.

Cost, Pricing & Business Performance

 Define pricing strategy and margin targets in alignment with MoD procurement patterns, competitive positioning, and profitability objectives.

 Track product P&L, unit economics, and market performance against forecast. Provide monthly/quarterly business reviews to senior leadership.

Go-to-Market & Launch Strategy

 Collaborate with sales, marketing, and customer success to prepare launch materials, data sheets, video content, and training documentation.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Product Manager for Data Integrations, you'll help GitLab's analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) agents see beyond the data held in GitLab. You'll decide which external systems connect to the Data Insights Platform and Orbit, which integrations come first, and how their data fits into shared models.

Engineering teams plan work, track incidents, monitor production, and manage security findings across different tools. Your challenge is to bring that context together with GitLab's code, merge requests, pipelines, deployments, and vulnerabilities. You'll shape a consistent approach that gives customers a trustworthy picture they can query, report on, and use with agents, rather than another set of disconnected data sources.

This role is based in Bangalore, India. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there.

What you'll do
Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context.
Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together.
Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence.
Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering.
Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities.
Help shape integration pricing and packaging as the product area matures.
Use AI coding agents and GitLab to explore data, prototype integrations, and document the intended experience.
What you'll bring
Product management experience, with the ability to connect customer needs to priorities and make trade-offs with incomplete information.
Strong knowledge of the software development and operations (DevOps) ecosystem, including how planning, security, observability, and IT service management tools fit into engineering workflows.
A working understanding of data integration, ETL, and data transformation, including how data from different systems maps to a common model. You don't need a background as a data engineer.
Comfort using AI tools for prototyping and documentation as part of your product work.
Clear communication about customer problems, close collaboration with engineering, and a habit of using data to evaluate adoption.
Experience with integration products, data models, or value stream analytics is helpful, but isn't required.
About the team

We're part of GitLab's Core Data Products organization, which focuses on insights, analytics, and data-driven decision-making. You'll report to the Vice President of Product Management and join as our third product manager, focused on Data Integrations. You'll work alongside a Principal Product Manager responsible for the Data Insights Platform and dashboards, and a Product Manager focused on Orbit.

GitLab is all-remote, with asynchronous collaboration across regions. Transparency, written communication, and clear decisions are central to how we work. This role has the Bangalore location and in-person requirements described above.

We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented *Product Manager* to lead the strategy, functional design, and development of our ERP and enterprise software products.

* Identify product gaps, improvement opportunities, and process inefficiencies.
* Prioritize product features and development backlogs based on business value, customer needs, and technical feasibility.
* Ensure consistency across different ERP modules and product functionalities.

2. ERP Functional Design & Business Process Management

* Understand and define business processes across ERP modules such as Finance, Accounting, Sales, Procurement, Inventory, HR, CRM, and Operations.

RoaDo helps shippers and logistics teams run domestic and cross-border freight on one connected platform. As a Product Manager, you'll take charge of one area of that platform. Depending on business needs at the time you join, it could be load planning, carrier sourcing and spot bidding, shipment visibility, our AI-driven control tower, digital proof of delivery, freight billing, or our export-import (EXIM) workflows. You'll partner with engineers, operations teams, and enterprise clients to turn real logistics problems into products that deliver clear business results.

Your Responsibilities

* Set the product direction and quarterly priorities for your area, and see them through to delivery

* Take full ownership of how users get work done in your module, from first sketch to everyday adoption

* Strengthen how RoaDo connects with the outside world: client ERPs, transporter systems, GPS and telematics devices, shipping lines, forwarders, customs brokers, and port terminals

* Give customers a single view of their international shipments, from factory gate to port, across the sea or air leg, and on to final delivery

* Spend regular time with exporters, importers, transporters, forwarders, and finance teams to find where work breaks down and decide what to fix first

* Write detailed requirement documents that leave little room for interpretation, and stay close to the engineering team through each sprint

* Choose the right success measures, such as usage, turnaround time, port dwell, and cost per shipment, and report on them consistently

What We're Looking For

* 3 to 5 years in product management, including at least 2 years running a B2B software product with full accountability

* Solid knowledge of road freight in India, both full-truckload and part-load, including how loads are planned, how transporters are selected, how trips are tracked, and how freight bills are settled

* Practical understanding of the truckload lifecycle: placing orders with transporters, monitoring trip milestones, handling waiting charges, and closing payments

* Good knowledge of export-import operations, including space booking, container handling at CFS and ICD, port movement, customs filing, and coordination with shipping lines and forwarders

* Comfort with core trade documents and terms such as Bill of Lading, Shipping Bill, Bill of Entry, Incoterms, and demurrage and detention charges

* Experience with exception alerts, live visibility, or control-tower style products will set you apart

* Able to read API docs and work through integration details with engineers, including GPS and SIM-based tracking, container tracking feeds, webhooks, and ERP connections

* A data-driven mindset: you can estimate the size of a problem, pick the metric that matters, and build a persuasive case from numbers

* Strong written communication and the ability to align engineering and business teams around a spec

* You think about how AI can change what our product does for customers, such as reading trade documents automatically or predicting delays, and not only how it speeds up building

Bonus Points

Role - Senior Product Manager, Fleet Management Systems (FMS)
Location - GGN

About the Role
Delhivery's freight network operates across thousands of vehicles, vendors, customers, and trips every day. Orion and our Fleet Management Systems sit at the center of this ecosystem—connecting demand creation, supply allocation, procurement, trip execution, tracking, documentation, and financial closure.
As Senior Product Manager for FMS, you will own products that make freight operations faster, more automated, and more efficient. You will work at the intersection of customers, operations, supply, engineering, data, and AI—simplifying complex workflows and progressively moving them from manual coordination to intelligent, system-driven execution.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complicated operational problems and turning them into scalable products.

What You Will Do
Own the roadmap, not just the backlog — Define product strategy and roadmap across freight and fleet workflows from demand/indent creation and supply-demand matching to trip execution, tracking, documentation, and closure. Define clear business and product KPIs and own outcomes.
Automate operations using AI — Identify workflows currently dependent on calls, emails, WhatsApp, spreadsheets, or manual decision-making and redesign them using AI agents, workflow automation, and intelligent recommendations.
Go deep into freight operations — Understand how customers raise demand, how supply teams source vehicles, how vendors bid and allocate capacity, and how trips are executed on ground. Spend time with operations, vendors, drivers, and customers to understand where systems diverge from reality.
Drive measurable operational outcomes — Use data to identify bottlenecks and measure improvements in metrics such as turnaround time, automation/adoption, vehicle placement, tracking compliance, vendor performance, and operational productivity.
Build for scale and reliability — Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to design systems that can handle complex workflows, integrations, real-time events, and large transaction volumes without creating operational fragility.
Drive execution across teams — Work closely with engineering, operations, supply, business, finance, and external partners. Navigate competing priorities, make trade-offs, and take initiatives from problem discovery through rollout and adoption.

What You Bring
4+ years of product management experience, preferably in logistics, supply chain, fleet management, marketplaces, B2B platforms, or a fast-paced internet company.
Strong product fundamentals with demonstrated ability to take ambiguous operational problems, structure them, quantify their impact, and translate them into scalable products.
Strong operational instinct—you are comfortable understanding workflows on the ground rather than designing products only from meeting rooms.
Hands-on SQL and data skills—you should be comfortable pulling and analysing your own data, building funnels, identifying failure patterns, and using data to challenge assumptions.
Practical fluency with modern AI tooling—LLMs, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, RAG, and AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar environments.
Strong systems thinking. You can reason across workflows involving customers, vendors, vehicles, drivers, payments, documents, APIs, and multiple internal systems rather than optimizing one screen in isolation.
Ability to influence across teams without relying on authority and to drive adoption after the product has shipped.

Why This Role
Freight operations have traditionally depended heavily on people coordinating through calls, messages, spreadsheets, and fragmented systems. At Delhivery's scale, the opportunity is to fundamentally change that.
FMS is evolving from a system that records freight operations into a platform that can increasingly understand demand, recommend decisions, automate coordination, and manage execution.
This role gives you the opportunity to build that transformation at scale—combining logistics, marketplaces, data, and AI to redefine how freight moves.

About The Position

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager - Endpoint Security Cloud Platform to be part of making that happen.

Position Overview

The Senior Product Manager, Endpoint Security Cloud Platform will own the cloud backend capabilities that underpin Arctic Wolf’s Endpoint Security portfolio, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, and agent lifecycle management. Based in Bangalore, India, this is a technical, product-facing role that partners closely with Engineering and Architecture to define requirements, make product decisions, and deliver at scale. The role will be central to two of the team’s most significant initiatives: defining the cloud side of our unified agent strategy, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into a single agent and a single cloud; and planning and executing the migration of several million endpoints from one cloud backend to another.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership – Cloud Platform

Own the product definition, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for Endpoint Security cloud backend capabilities, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, multi-tenancy, and agent lifecycle management (deployment, upgrade, and health).
Translate Endpoint Security strategy into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, partnering with Engineering and Architecture on system design, data flows, APIs, and technical trade-offs.

Partner with UX to define administrator and operator workflows that are simple, scalable, and consistent across the Endpoint Security portfolio.

Agent Consolidation & Cloud Migration

Plan and drive the migration of several million endpoints between cloud backends, including migration strategy, phasing, rollback and risk mitigation, customer and partner impact, and success criteria.
Work with Engineering, Managed Services, Support, and Customer Success to ensure migrations are seamless for customers, partners, and security analysts.

Experience & Expertise

Company Background

Azuga, a Bridgestone company, is a leading global connected vehicle platform, helping customers turn data from vehicles and drivers into intelligence that improves operations and safety while reducing cost and risk. Azuga provides innovative end-to-end fleet solutions for commercial fleets, government agencies, insurance companies, and integrated software partners, through a comprehensive approach of hardware technology, fleet management applications, video telematics, and data analytics. All with a white glove customer experience.

Team Culture

We are a mission-driven team committed to remaining the fastest growing fleet management solution in the industry. We are a group of builders and doers — building the foundations of a results-oriented product team to deliver amazing experiences for our customers. We are a team with a strong commitment to customer-driven innovation, data-based decision making, and a bias for learning through experimentation.

Summary

Data is at the core of what Azuga does — every device in the field generates a continuous stream of signals that our customers depend on to run safer, smarter fleets. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Data, Analytics & AI to own the strategy and roadmap for how we collect, process, model, and surface that intelligence across the platform — and to help lead our emerging AI program from early initiative into a core platform capability.

This is a rare hybrid role. You will need to be equally comfortable in a technical conversation about data pipelines and model outputs as you are in a boardroom discussion about business outcomes and strategic direction. You will translate between two worlds — turning ambiguous business problems into clear technical requirements, and turning complex data and AI capabilities into intuitive, high-impact product experiences. You will work closely with engineering, data science, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership alike.

What You’ll Own

Data Ingestion & Pipeline Integrity

Own product requirements for how vehicle signals and driver events are collected, validated, and processed — from hardware in the field through to the data layer.
Define standards for data quality, completeness, and reliability in partnership with Engineering and Data Engineering, and ensure the infrastructure scales as fleet size and signal diversity grow.
Analytics & Insights Products

Own the roadmap for Azuga’s fleet analytics surfaces — dashboards, reports, trend analysis, and alert-driven insights — ensuring they are accurate, fast, and genuinely useful to fleet managers.
Define and evolve the metrics layer: what gets measured, how it’s calculated, and how it maps to customer outcomes like safety, efficiency, and cost reduction.
AI Program — Vision & Execution

Help lead Azuga’s AI program as it matures from a set of experiments into a standardized platform capability — owning the vision, roadmap, and delivery framework that makes AI a reliable, scalable part of the product.
Establish the infrastructure, data access patterns, and UX standards that allow AI features to be built and iterated consistently across the platform.
Define and track leading indicators of AI program health — such as recommendation acceptance rates and feature engagement — to measure real-world impact and guide investment decisions.
Serve as the product interface for data science and ML initiatives: framing problem statements, scoping features around model outputs, and ensuring AI-driven capabilities are explainable, trustworthy, and tied to measurable customer value.
Data APIs & Cross-Functional Translation

Define product requirements for external data APIs, ensuring Azuga’s data is accessible and reliable for partners and integrated software vendors.
Act as the connective tissue between technical and non-technical stakeholders — synthesizing inputs from Sales, Support, and executive leadership into a coherent product direction, and producing clear, detailed requirements that engineering teams can execute without ambiguity.
Key Responsibilities

Define and drive the data, analytics, and AI product roadmap, balancing near-term customer pain points against longer-term platform investment.
Lead product discovery across customer segments, translating feedback, usage data, and support escalations into prioritized requirements.
Write rigorous product requirements and user stories; partner with engineering and data science through the full development lifecycle.
Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership — communicating clearly and managing expectations proactively.
Establish and monitor KPIs for data quality, analytics engagement, AI feature adoption, and API reliability.
Lead go-to-market planning and enablement for new analytics and AI feature launches.
Qualifications

5+ years of product management experience, with meaningful focus on data, analytics, or AI/ML products in B2B SaaS environments.
Demonstrated ability to translate between business requirements and technical specifications — comfortable in a data engineering standup and a Sales QBR in the same day.
Working fluency with data concepts: pipelines, schemas, APIs, event-driven architectures, and data quality frameworks. You don’t need to code, but you need to reason about tradeoffs at the technical level.
Experience working directly with data science or ML teams — defining problem statements, scoping features around model outputs, and making those outputs useful to end users.
High attention to detail — you write requirements that leave nothing ambiguous, and you catch the inconsistency others miss.
Excellent communicator with a track record of earning trust with engineers, data scientists, and executive stakeholders alike.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
Nice to Have

Background in fleet management, telematics, connected devices, or mobility/transportation.
Hands-on experience with BI platform product development (Looker, Tableau, or similar).
Familiarity with IoT data architectures, streaming pipelines, or AI-assisted prototyping workflows.
Join us at Azuga

This is a high-impact role at a company where data is the product and AI is the next frontier. You will own a domain that touches every fleet customer we serve and help shape how intelligence gets woven into everything Azuga does. If you find equal satisfaction in a cleanly defined schema and a well-told customer story — and thrive connecting those two things — we would love to hear from you.

Execution & Delivery
Write crisp PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable the engineering and design teams to build effectively.
Partner with engineering leads to scope, plan, and deliver features on time with high quality.
Own the sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release management processes for your pod.

Data, Metrics & Growth
Define and track key product metrics (DAU/MAU, retention, watch time, engagement rate, conversion) and own performance dashboards.
Use data to drive product decisions, identify growth levers, and course-correct where needed.
Drive experimentation culture — design, launch, and analyse A/B tests to optimise product experiences.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, Content, Marketing, and Business teams to deliver cohesive product experiences.
Communicate product plans, progress, and results clearly to leadership and cross-functional partners.
Act as the voice of the user within the team and consistently advocate for user-centric decisions.

What We're Looking For
Must-Have Qualifications
6–9 years of product management experience, preferably in a consumer internet, OTT, media, or entertainment product.
Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with SQL, product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Firebase, or similar), and deriving actionable insights from data.
Experience writing detailed PRDs and working in agile development environments.
Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and drive cross-functional alignment.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills — ability to present complex ideas simply and persuasively.
Strong ownership mindset with the ability to self-manage and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

Good-to-Have
Prior experience with video streaming platforms, OTT products, content recommendation systems, or creator economy tools.
Exposure to personalisation, ML-driven features, or recommendation algorithms is a strong plus.
Familiarity with monetisation models — AVOD, SVOD, in-app purchases, or creator revenue sharing.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; MBA from a premier institution is a plus.
Experience working in a high-growth startup environment.

Traits That Will Make You Exceptional
You are deeply curious about what users want and even more curious about why.
You treat data as a compass, not a crutch — you know when to trust the numbers and when to trust your instincts.
You are a strong communicator who can inspire a team around a vision and also get into the weeds with engineers when needed.
You move fast without breaking things — you know how to ship iteratively and learn quickly.
You are passionate about storytelling, content, and the future of entertainment in India.

What We Offer
An opportunity to shape the product experience of a rapidly growing digital entertainment platform.
A collaborative, creative, and fast-moving work environment with passionate colleagues.
Competitive compensation, performance-linked bonuses, and ESOPs.
Direct access to leadership and a culture that values product thinking at every level.
Significant career growth opportunities as Story TV scales its audience and product portfolio.

Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.

Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.

It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.

Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.

In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.

About The Role

Nium moves billions in payments every month for some of the world’s most demanding companies — banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms operating across 100+ countries. We built that on fiat rails. The next layer is digital currency: stablecoins, on/off-ramps, and card products that let customers spend, settle, and move value in USDC as naturally as they do in dollars or euros.

We’re hiring a Staff PM – Digital Assets to own that build. Not the strategy document — the actual product. If you’ve shipped a stablecoin wallet, a crypto-funded card, or a fiat-to-digital conversion flow and you understand what it takes to get that through compliance, engineering, and go-live in a regulated environment, this is your rol

Responsibilities

Own stablecoin-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it
Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line
Design and ship on/off-ramp flows — fiat-to-digital and digital-to-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience
Drive stablecoin-based cross-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production-grade
Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy
Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal


Requirements

7+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required
You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck
Strong payments foundation — cross-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it
Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no-go decisions
Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against
Comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign-off


How We’ll Measure Success

Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins + payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin-funded card products
On/off-ramp conversion rate and time-to-settlement
Time-to-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product


What We Offer At Nium

We Value Performance: Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.

We Care for Our Employees: The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our year-end shut down. We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).

We Upskill Ourselves: We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.

We Celebrate Together: We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!

We Thrive with Diversity: Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.

Beware of recruitment scams: Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites. Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

About Bureau

Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.

Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.

Why Bureau?

Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.

About the Role: Senior Product Manager - Credit Risk

You'll own Bureau's credit product line: the signals, scores and decisioning tools lenders use to approve, price and monitor borrowers.

This is a builder's seat. You've shipped credit products from the lender's side; now you'll turn that judgment into products hundreds of lenders use.
What you ship will shape how millions of people in India and beyond get access to credit.

What you’ll be doing

Own the credit signals roadmap. Pick the next signals to build, from alternative data and behavioural patterns to fraud indicators that predict credit risk.
Go deep with lenders. Learn how banks, NBFCs and fintechs underwrite and collect, and turn their pain into product.
Build across the credit lifecycle. Onboarding, underwriting, limits, early warnings and collections.
Partner with data science. Define what a great signal looks like and take models from experiment to production.
Ship, scale and prove impact. Launch API-first products and track approval rates, delinquency and fraud loss.
Win with GTM and compliance. Help sales pitch and price credit deals, and keep products aligned with RBI and data protection rules.

What You’ll Bring

Must have
5–8 years in product, at PM or Senior PM level, owning products end to end.
Consumer-side credit experience at a lender, NBFC, credit fintech or BNPL player, building and scaling products in India or globally.
Hands-on with signals: bureau data, alternative data, risk scores or fraud indicators used to make better decisions.
Data fluency. You can question a Gini or KS number and pull your own insights with SQL.
Clear communication with a CRO, an engineer and a salesperson alike.

Good to have
You've built or productised a credit score, risk model or decisioning engine.
You've worked with India's credit stack: bureaus, Account Aggregator, UPI or GST data.
You've sold data or risk tools to lenders on the B2B side.

We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to join our global Digital Experience team, where innovation knows no borders. This team owns and scales whitelabel e-commerce and post-booking servicing products for leading global airline partners. It bridges complex backend capabilities with modern digital storefronts to deliver seamless traveler journeys. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.

As a Lead Product Manager, you will drive the strategy, evolution and operational excellence of our Digital Experience (DX) and Digital Experience Check-In (DXCI) products across SabreSonic and SabreMosaic platforms. You will guide technical execution, lead agile scrum backlogs and support global clients as they transition toward modern Offer & Order retailing. This role requires strong technical depth, cross-functional leadership and the ability to align global stakeholders to deliver high-impact enterprise software solutions.

What You'll Do

Drive product vision, strategy and detailed roadmaps for Digital Experience across SabreSonic and SabreMosaic initiatives.
Manage investment decisions, scoping and priority backlogs for scrum teams while writing user stories and defining acceptance criteria.
Collaborate closely with engineering teams to provide technical guidance, deliver scalable architectural solutions and maintain product quality.
Engage directly with global customer touchpoints, focus groups and industry events to gather market insights and shape product direction.
Lead product evolution as clients transition from legacy workflows toward modern Offer & Order retailing architectures.
Analyze and resolve technical escalations and maintenance issues alongside commercial and delivery teams to ensure operational stability.
Deliver product demonstrations for internal leadership and external global clients to showcase upcoming capabilities and enhancements.

What You'll Bring

Required qualifications

Minimum 8 years of experience in technical product management owning complex e-commerce platforms, enterprise SaaS or high-scale digital solutions.
Proven track record in market-facing roles, engaging directly with clients and partners to define requirements and influence product strategy.
Strong technical and data-oriented mindset with demonstrated ability to bridge backend system architecture and front-end user experiences.
Success leading cross-functional execution and backlog refinement within agile software development environments.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to articulate complex technical concepts to senior stakeholders.
Strong organizational discipline with a history of managing multiple complex projects and competing priorities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience with airline reservation or travel management technology platforms and retailing trends.

Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
Experience building products for emerging markets, next billion users, or optimizing app performance for memory-constrained/low-end Android devices.
Experience launching mobile consumer products at scale with a focus on product growth, user funnels or acquisition.
Experience with growth product management, consumer mobile apps, referral ingress, push notification systems, or onboarding conversion.
Understanding of mobile app architecture, client-server latency optimization, Operating System (OS) permissions (e.g., location/notifications), and API/SDK integrations.

About The Job

Geo's mission is to help people explore and navigate the real world wherever they are. We want to make real-world exploration and navigation seamless, intelligent, and universally accessible to all users across every hardware tier and network condition globally. At Google Maps' scale of 2B+ monthly active users, even fractional improvements in funnel conversion, latency, or feature discoverability generate massive, world-scale impact.

As a Product Manager, you will help drive Maps' reach towards 3B monthly active users (MAUs). You will join the International Growth team, with a focus on growing Android Maps (aka aGMM) Reach by creating new and improving existing acquisition and re-activation flywheels. You will drive sustainable, high-velocity user growth and engagement across top Android growth markets (including US, India, Indonesia, Brazil, Vietnam etc) while systematically eliminating friction in the user journey. The team operates at the intersection of product intuition, deep data analytics, and rigorous experimentation.

Responsibilities

Own the multi-quarter strategy and tactical execution plan for global Android Google Mobile Maps (aGMM) MAU growth, daily visits, and users on Google Maps.
Conduct funnel analyses to pinpoint drop-offs, churn drivers, and user cohorts.
Design, launch, and analyze high-velocity A/B tests and causal holdback experiments to validate product hypotheses.
Partner with engineering to streamline app startup latency, payload footprints, and first-interaction times on entry-tier devices.
Partner closely with dedicated Engineering teams, Data Science/Analytics, UX Design, Research, Legal, and Product Marketing across geographies.


Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

About Refold AI

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

What you'll do:

Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours? 
You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
You will define what learning looks like at the system level. 
How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end. 
When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer. 

What we're looking for:

You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code. 
You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream. 
You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product. 
You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build. 
You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made

Experience

5+ years in product in the B2B software industry
At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool. 
Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
Degree from a top-tier institution, or hands-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

About This Role

We are building a durable execution process engine – a platform that bridges enterprise workflow automation and intelligent agent orchestration. This is a zero-to-one product launch from concept to market.

You will lead the product strategy and execution for one of three interconnected pillars in the platform (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents). Working alongside peer PMs and reporting to the Group PM, you'll own the complete customer journey: from defining what we build, to shipping it, to ensuring it lands with users.

This role is for a PM who has shipped complex, multi-layer platform products before and who thrives in the tension between technical ambition and customer reality.

The Product Vision

A durable execution engine that scales from developer laptops to enterprise clouds, bringing workflow automation, intelligent agents, and real-time data integration into one coherent platform.

Modern enterprises are stuck. Legacy workflow systems are rigid and don't integrate with AI. Code-first pipelines (Airflow, Temporal) give developers freedom but leave business analysts behind. We're building the bridge.

Our Platform Will

Work for multiple personas – Business analysts author visually, engineers deploy as code, operators observe in real time. No translation layer needed.
Treat AI as native – Intelligent agents aren't bolted on; they're first-class actors in the process execution model with full auditability and compliance guardrails.
Connect everything – Data from any source (APIs, databases, message queues, cloud services) flows naturally through your processes without custom plumbing.
Build toward Horizon's sophistication – Our long-term ambition is to deliver agentic orchestration depth comparable to the best-in-class products in the market.


The result: enterprises can automate complex work faster, with more control, and with confidence that their processes will execute reliably at scale.

What You'll Own

Strategic ownership

Define the product roadmap for Workflows & Orchestration – what customers need, what moves the needle, what builds defensible value
Make the hard calls: what ships in MVP, what is post-launch, what never ships
Own the competitive positioning – position durable processes as a first-class pillar of an integrated platform, not a standalone point solution
Shape both pro-code and no-code experiences – own SDKs, CLI, and visual editor consistency; documentation and learning paths across both personas


Execution leadership

Lead cross-functional alignment (eng, design, marketing, sales) on priorities and milestones
Conduct customer discovery: who are we building for, what problems do they have, what's blocking adoption
Make data-driven decisions: usage patterns, customer feedback, performance metrics all inform direction
Unblock ambiguity: when technical direction isn't clear, you synthesize information and move forward decisively


Partnership with peer PMs

You're not alone – work collaboratively with two peer IC PMs who own the Data Connectors and AI Agents pillars
Establish clear integration points and contract boundaries so all three pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents) work together seamlessly
Escalate only real conflicts up to the Group PM; resolve most decisions at your level


We're Looking For

Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following

Complex infrastructure or platform products

Enterprise workflow or automation systems
Products that span multiple user personas (business analysts, developers, operators)
Products that required deep technical integration
Zero-to-one launches where you shaped initial product-market fit.


Core capabilities

Technical fluency – You read code, understand architecture constraints, and can have a real conversation with engineers about feasibility and tradeoffs. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one.
Customer obsession with realism – You spend time with users, but you're not a feature-request transcriber. You synthesize what they need from what they say.
Decisiveness under ambiguity – You make calls with incomplete information. You're comfortable killing ideas you love if data suggests they won't work.
Communication across layers – You talk to engineers about latency budgets, to customers about compliance, to executives about roadmap priorities. Different audiences, same honesty.
Systems thinking – You see how pieces connect. Developer SDKs influence adoption patterns. Pricing models influence feature prioritization. You optimize for the system, not the local maximum.
AI native – You’re using LLMs as part of your product workflow and can adapt to any tool easily. We currently use Claude Code and Cursor.


Nice to have

5+ years of relevant experience as a Product Manager, with a strong focus on platform products.
Exposure to workflow engines, BPM systems, or process orchestration platforms (Camunda, Zeebe, Airflow, Temporal).
Experience with enterprise compliance requirements (SOC 2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA) and how they shape product architecture.
Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS scaling challenges and tradeoffs
Previous zero-to-one product launch where you defined the initial MVP and shaped early-stage product-market fit.
Experience building features using LLMs (it can be a hobby project).

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Company Description:
Huru is a licensed financial services provider regulated by the Central Bank of the UAE, focused on smart, secure, and seamless money management. Designed for people living in the UAE and beyond, Huru offers quick account opening, a free digital Visa card, and convenient bill payments and transfers. The platform enables users to access micro finance for emergencies, send money home, and manage UAE transfers with ease. With features like saving pots and intuitive budgeting tools, Huru supports users in building better financial habits. The company is committed to making everyday financial life easier, safer, and smarter for a diverse customer base.

Role Overview:
Every Huru user — whether it's a construction worker sending money home or an employer paying a hundred staff on time — touches a payment rail at the moment that matters most to them. Aani, Open Finance, and our Payment Gateway aren't back-office plumbing at Huru; they're the raw material for some of the most impactful, front-facing features we can build.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take these rails and turn them into products people actually feel — instant transfers that land in seconds, bill payments that just work, and Open Finance-powered experiences that make Huru smarter about the people it serves. You'll decide not just whether a rail works, but what it becomes in the hands of a blue-collar worker checking their balance on a shared phone, or an HR manager processing payroll on a deadline.
This role also includes turning payments into a real revenue line — local and international bill payments and recharges — built for a segment that's rarely offered anything this convenient before.
Candidates with hands-on UAE fintech experience (Aani, RPSCS, Open Finance) or India's UPI/BBPS ecosystem are strongly preferred — the rail concepts translate directly, and we want someone who's already seen what "exciting" looks like when a rail becomes a feature people love.

What you'll Actually Build:
Aani, reimagined as user experience
Design how instant P2P and P2A payments feel inside the Huru app for retail users — split bills with roommates, pay a shopkeeper, send money to another worker, all settling in real time.
On the employer side, explore how Aani can power same-day salary top-ups, urgent vendor payouts, or instant corporate-to-worker disbursements that don't wait for a batch cycle.
Own the trade-offs between speed, cost, and reliability — and translate those into UX decisions users never have to think about.

Open Finance, as a workflow — not a compliance checkbox
Prototype what Open Finance unlocks for a worker with thin credit history: consent-based data sharing that could power faster salary advances, smarter savings nudges, or simpler onboarding.
On the employer side, imagine how consented data-sharing could streamline reconciliation, payroll funding checks, or credit decisions for corporate lending.
Partner with Compliance to figure out what's possible within UAE's evolving Open Finance framework — and be the person translating "what's regulatorily allowed" into "what's genuinely useful"

Bills, recharges & payments as a business you build
Own the end-to-end experience for local and international bill payments and mobile/data recharges — this segment pays these bills every week; make it the easiest and most trusted way to do it.
Build revenue mechanics — auto-pay, reminders, cashback, partner incentives — that turn a one-time payment into a recurring, revenue-generating habit.
Source and manage biller/aggregator partnerships that expand what users can pay for, directly inside Huru.

The rail underneath it all
Own the Payment Gateway that quietly connects all of the above — retail spend, employer disbursement, bill settlement — making sure it's fast, reliable, and cost-efficient enough to support everything you're building on top of it.

Key Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end Aani experience roadmap across both retail and employer surfaces — from network integration through to the feature the user actually taps.
Prototype and validate Open Finance-powered use cases (credit, savings, reconciliation, onboarding) ahead of and alongside the UAE's regulatory rollout.
Build and own the bill-payment/recharge business line — partner sourcing, pricing, and the engagement mechanics that drive repeat revenue.
Own the underlying Payment Gateway relationship — uptime, cost, and reliability — as the infrastructure your front-facing features depend on.
Define and track the KPIs that matter for both sides of this role: feature adoption and repeat usage on the front end; transaction success rate, cost per transaction, and rail uptime on the back end.
Partner with Legal/Compliance to stay within CBUAE's RPSCS and SVF frameworks while pushing what's possible for users.
Work with the Retail and B2B Product Leads to sequence which user-facing rail features ship first, given shared engineering capacity.

Requirements
5+ years in Product Management, ideally with experience shipping user-facing features built on a payment rail, PG, or UPI-equivalent system — not just maintaining the rail itself.
UAE fintech experience strongly preferred — Aani, RPSCS, or UAE Open Finance exposure is a real advantage; India's UPI/BBPS ecosystem experience is equally relevant given the structural overlap.
A track record of turning infrastructure into a feature users notice — you can point to something you built that people actually talked about, not just a rail that worked.
Experience building a bill-payment or recharge line as a revenue driver.
Comfortable moving between two altitudes in the same week — a rail reliability conversation with engineering, and a UX conversation about how a payment confirmation screen should feel.
Data-driven and curious about people: you're as interested in why a worker checks their balance five times a day as you are in the transaction success rate behind it.

Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

We are looking for a Product Manager to help evolve our e-commerce platform across emerging markets, starting with the East Asia Pacific (EAP). Based in India, you will help guide regional platform rollouts, enhance digital consumer experiences, and contribute to the growth of our e-commerce channel in emerging markets. Given the geographically diverse ecosystem, we are looking for a professional who succeeds in ambiguity with experience setting ecommerce strategies and roadmaps for several markets and cultures.

As part of the Global Product Management team, and reporting to the Emerging Markets Expansion Director, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality digital commerce experiences that meet local market needs and align with global standards. You will help ship the right customer experience across the end-to-end online shopping journey. You will help shape the way in which people work with our digital shopping experience in the East Asia Pacific region, including Southeast Asia, North Asia, and Australia- New Zealand.

About The Job

E-Commerce Platform Execution

Analyze consumer feedback and usage metrics to identify key consumer pain points 
Co-develop the product vision, Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), own the roadmap for your product area, and work closely with the stakeholders in the region, including Technical Product Manager, Solutions Architect, and the Business teams in the region. You will oversee the execution of the roadmap. 
Track results towards Goals by managing success metrics through tools, with an understanding of drivers and detractors. 
Identify the controllable input metrics for your product area to achieve sustainable growth.
Help define the AB Test backlog and building A/B testing plans. Use insights to inform product enhancements. 
Present product plans, benefits and results to senior leadership, partners, external partners and other large audiences. 
Excel in collecting consumer data, internal data, external benchmarks, and our data. 
Assess external options (Shopify Apps) to allow certain features and capabilities required to enhance our site experience.

Collaboration

Work with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, and commercial teams to provide cohesive product solutions.
Track important ecommerce metrics and contribute to product roadmap updates based on evolving business and consumer needs. 
Communicate progress and updates to partners across regions and departments. 
Partner with Engineering to track performance of our sites and prioritise resolution of issues. 

Shopify Rollout & Implementation

Represent Product and Site Experience during the Shopify implementations in select markets, working with System Integrators (SIs) and local teams to ensure delivery.
Manage daily project activities, including tracking progress, resolving issues, and ensuring readiness for go-live. 
Provide support for training and documentation to ensure smooth adoption by local teams. 

About You

7+ years of experience in product management. E-commerce or consumer-facing digital products experience is good to have.
Consumer-centric mindset.
Experience supporting digital commerce rollouts in emerging or complex markets. 
Familiarity with Shopify or similar platforms and experience working with third-party tools and integrations.
