Role: Principal / Lead Product Manager – Data as a Service 
Location: Noida, India
Experience Level: 13–19+ years total experience (minimum 6+ years in Product Management with prior experience in Data Management)

Role Summary
We are seeking a visionary, technically strong, and outcome-oriented Product Manager – Data as a Service to spearhead the evolution of our enterprise data ecosystem. In this role, the person will lead the shift from traditional, centralized data pipelines to Data as a Service—treating internal and external data assets, semantic models, feature stores, and analytical views as high-value, discoverable, consumable, and SLA-governed AI Native Data Services.

As Product Manager, you will not simply automate existing analytical workflows; your role will be to completely reimagine the end-to-end organization experience of data discovery, consumption, governance, and exploration through Classic, Generative and Agentic AI.

You must possess a strong blend of technical understanding of Data Offerings and Product Management excellence within established software/SaaS product companies, having guided complex platforms from concept to widespread enterprise adoption

Key Responsibilities & Core Focus Areas

A. Strategic Product Definition & Specification Lifecycle (MRD, PRD, FSRD)
Overall Revenues and P&L: As the Product Leader for Data-as-a-Service, you will manage the overall revenue numbers from the offering, including profitability, customer adoption and technology frameworks.
Define the Strategy for our offering, including market potential, HCLTech Pulse play, market analysis (including customer and competition), productization, packaging and life cycle management
Market Needs Analysis: Conduct quantitative market sizing, competitive benchmarking, user persona segmentation (Cross-functional CXOs, including CDOs, CIOs, CDAO and others), and identify market opportunities for Data-as-a-Service monetization and operational acceleration.
Product Requirements Document (PRD): Define high-impact product roadmaps, problem statements, user journeys, measurable acceptance criteria, and success metrics (SLAs, SLOs, TTVs – Time to Value). Embed enterprise grade security, controls, lineage tracking and regulatory compliance as default.
Functional & System Requirements Document (FSRD): Author granular functional specifications, interface definitions, API/SDK designs, schema contracts, event stream definitions, metadata topologies, and system integration workflows in close collaboration with Lead Data Architects and Engineering Managers.
Product Discovery & Evangelism: Lead iterative customer/internal discovery engagements, alpha/beta pilot programs, user feedback synthesis, and launch enablement.
Manage Data Stack Complexity and Governance: Ensure that the overall offering adheres to various customer segment / solution KPIs, including data management and quality, compliance, governance and transparency.
AI-Native Product Innovation: Deliver balance between scale, costs and performance. In addition, eliminate traditional SQL / Dashboard friction by introducing conversational discovery, visual lineage graphs, multi-modal semantic search, proactive alerting, and autonomous exploratory data analysis (EDA).

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

Required Experience
Total Professional Experience: 12 to 19+ years of demonstrable success in Product management, Data & AI technology.
Product Management Experience: Minimum 6+ years of formal Product Management experience within modern product-centric software companies (SaaS/Enterprise B2B/Data Platform companies).
Technical Heritage in Data Management: Proven track record having worked hands-on as a Data Engineer, Big Data Architect, or Software Engineer in early career stages. Deep foundational empathy for data pipeline bottlenecks, schema migrations, orchestration, and compute/storage tradeoffs.
AI-Native Product Track Record: Prior experience designing, launching, and scaling customer facing products incorporating AI/ML capabilities, specifically including Generative AI and Agentic systems.

Preferred & "Good to Have" Technology Experience

Strong practical familiarity with the following platforms and toolchains is highly advantageous:

Cloud Platforms (Hyperscalers): Proven experience operating in or building products on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, or Amazon Web Services (AWS).
Modern Cloud Data Warehouses & Lakehouses: In-depth knowledge of Databricks (Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables), Snowflake (Data Cloud, Snowpark, Cortex), and Google BigQuery (GBQ).
Enterprise AI, LLMs & Foundation Models: Experience leveraging managed AI platforms such as Google Cloud Vertex AI, foundational model families including Gemini (Pro, Flash) and open-weights Large Language Models (LLMs), as well as enterprise LLMOps, vector search, and fine-tuning ecosystems.

Soft Skills & Leadership Attributes
Executive Presence & Cross-Functional Influence: Ability to align C-level executives, Data Scientists, and Business Executives on a unified data vision.
First-Principles Problem Solver: Obsessed with breaking down opaque, chaotic data architectures into modular, elegant, productized services.
Customer-Centric UX Sensibility: Instinctive drive to shield users from underlying architectural complexity through intuitive, delight-driven interface paradigms.

At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold “what if.” 

What if your ideas could ignite global innovation?

Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career. 

Here, how we empower our people is extraordinary: Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and Cigna Healthy Workforce honours three years running — and what we build is world-class: recognized as CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024 — evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next”. 

In a world where you can be anything, Be Infoblox. 

Product Manager 

We have an opportunity for a Product Manager to join our Products team in Bangalore, reporting to our Director, Product Management. In this role, you will help shape the automation and cloud operations experience across the Infoblox product portfolio. You will focus on capabilities that help customers automate deployment, configuration, integration, and lifecycle operations using modern infrastructure and automation tools such as REST APIs, Ansible, Terraform, AI-driven workflows, and public cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and GCP.

This role is ideal for a product manager who is passionate about DevOps, CloudOps, platform automation, AI-enabled operations, and improving how customers operationalize products at scale. You are also expected to actively leverage AI tools and AI-driven workflows as part of your day-to-day product management practice, including research, synthesis, requirements development, prioritization, and cross-functional execution.

Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do

Partner closely with engineering and UX to define, refine, and deliver automation-focused features and workflows.

Contribute to product specifications, user stories, use cases, and backlog prioritization for automation-related initiatives. 
Leverage AI tools and AI-driven workflows in day-to-day product management activities, including market and customer research, synthesis, drafting requirements, prioritization support, and cross-functional collaboration. 
Own the success of the features and capabilities you help build, maintain, and deliver. 

Be Prepared — What You Bring

1–3 years of related product management experience, or equivalent experience in technical product ownership, solutions engineering, DevOps, CloudOps, AI-enabled platform operations, or technical program roles. 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or a related technical field. 
Familiarity with SaaS products, cloud-managed platforms, and AI-enabled product capabilities is a plus. 
Working knowledge of automation and infrastructure technologies such as REST APIs, Ansible, Terraform, CI/CD workflows, scripting-driven operational models, and practical AI applications such as copilots, intelligent workflow automation, or LLM-powered operational use cases. 
Familiarity with public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, including awareness of their evolving AI service ecosystems. 
Demonstrated willingness and ability to use AI tools and AI-assisted workflows as part of everyday work. 
Understanding of how customers deploy, integrate, and operate infrastructure and services in enterprise, hybrid, and cloud environments. 
Ability to actively listen to customers, identify root problems, and make data-informed decisions, even when data is incomplete. 
Ability to partner with cross-functional teams such as engineering, marketing, UX, support, and architecture across the full product lifecycle. 
Ability to capture and clearly articulate customer problems, then translate those into product strategy, requirements, and prioritization. 
Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
Strong initiative, comfort working independently, and willingness to learn quickly in a fast-moving environment. 
Passion for ownership, innovation, and improving the customer experience through automation and operational simplicity. 

Be Successful — Your Path 

First 90 Days:

Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals. 

Six Months:

Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Infoblox products, their features, and how customers automate and operate them. 
Deliver clear product specifications, user stories, and scenarios that define customer needs and automation requirements. 
Participate in user-centric design and agile planning processes. 
Become a fully engaged member of the Product Management, UX, Architecture, and Engineering teams. 
Help drive backlog definition and prioritization for automation and CloudOps capabilities. 

One Year: 

Be a key contributor to the roadmap and strategy for DevOps / CloudOps automation initiatives across the portfolio. 
Help drive the creation and prioritization of product requirements in partnership with other Product Managers and cross-functional teams. 
Contribute meaningfully to agile release planning and execution for automation-related product investments. 
Establish yourself as a go-to product partner for cross-portfolio automation needs. 

Belong— Your Community

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here. 

Be Rewarded — Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong

Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options 
Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops 
Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy 
Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations 
Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match 
We practice pay transparency and reward performance. Offers reflect role location, internal equity, experience, skills, education, and certifications 

Ready to Be the Difference?

Strong data fluency — able to define metrics, work with usage data, and drive product decisions from evidence, not intuition alone.
Technical literacy: comfortable engaging with engineering on API design, integrations, and system architecture trade-offs.
Basic understanding of deployments, release branches, Cloud Servers etc
Proven ability to write structured, detailed PRDs and work in an agile delivery environment.
Ability to work both hands-on and guiding the team members to pull-up the complex products. 
Hands-on practitioner of AI tools — uses LLMs, AI research tools, and automation to work faster and smarter, not just aware of them.

Nice to Have

Prior experience in healthcare, healthtech, or dental-adjacent domains with working knowledge of US dental workflows — scheduling, charting, billing, insurance claims, treatment planning.
Exposure to dental integrations: imaging platforms (Dexis, Carestream), labs, e-prescribing, or clearinghouses.
Familiarity with dental industry standards: ADA/CDT codes, insurance eligibility, ERA/EOB processing, and HIPAA compliance in product design.
Experience incorporating AI/ML features into clinical or administrative workflows — smart scheduling, AI-assisted charting, revenue cycle automation.

Preferred Educational Background

Bachelor's or Master's degree from IITs, IIMs, BITS, or equivalent top-tier institutions.
Strong academic foundation in engineering, computer science, or business — domain curiosity and first-principles thinking matter more than the exact degree.

Mstack is a tech-enabled specialty chemicals company that runs global sourcing, sales, logistics and finance on its own platforms. The Product team builds and runs SalesStack, ProcureStack and LogiStack, and integrates them with our ERP (Microsoft Dynamics Business Central).
We are now moving manual, high-volume work - supplier and customer emails, follow-up calls, document generation, invoice posting - to AI agents and automated workflows. This role sits at the centre of that shift.

What you'll do: core product management
User research: spend time with sales, procurement, logistics and finance users; run interviews, shadow workflows and turn what you see into clear problem statements.
Problem definition: size the problem with data (time lost, cost, error rates, revenue at risk) and decide what is worth solving now.
Solutioning: explore options, weigh trade-offs, and pick the simplest solution that moves the metric - software, AI agent, automation or process change.
PRDs: write crisp PRDs with goals, non-goals, user flows, edge cases, success metrics and acceptance criteria that engineering can build from.
UI/UX: create wireframes and flows in Figma (or prototype directly with AI tools) and review designs for usability.
Delivery: work with engineering through sprints, unblock decisions, groom the backlog and own release quality.
GTM and adoption: plan rollout, train users, write release notes and track adoption until the feature is actually used.
Ownership: own one or more product areas end to end, with metrics you report on to leadership.

What you'll do: AI, agents and automation
Spot AI opportunities: find repetitive, rules-heavy or communication-heavy work across teams and judge where AI is the right tool and where it isn't.
Design agentic workflows: define what an agent does, which tools and data it uses, where a human approves, and how it fails safely — for email, voice and document-based workflows.
Prototype fast: build working prototypes and internal tools yourself using tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, n8n or Zapier before asking engineering to build at scale.
Spec AI features well: write PRDs that cover prompts, context, evaluation sets, accuracy targets, guardrails, cost per run and human-in-the-loop design.
Measure AI quality: set up evals and monitoring so we know when an agent is right, wrong or drifting.
Raise the team's AI bar: share what works, help other teams use AI in their daily work, and keep up with new models and tools.

Must-haves
1-3 years of product management experience (PM, APM or a PM internship that led to owning a product).
Has shipped at least one product or feature end to end, with measurable results you can explain.
Has built something real with AI - an agent, an automation, an internal tool or an AI feature in production - and can walk through how it works.
Hands-on with modern AI tools (LLM APIs or chat tools, AI coding tools, no-code automation platforms) and uses them in daily work.
Working understanding of LLM concepts: prompting, context and retrieval, tool calling, hallucinations, evaluation, latency and cost.
Comfortable with data: SQL basics, funnels, dashboards, and A/B or before-after analysis.
Clear written communication - PRDs, updates and decisions that others can act on without a meeting.
High ownership and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving team.

Nice-to-haves
Engineering degree or a technical background; can read code and API docs.
Experience with B2B, operations-heavy, supply chain, logistics or fintech products.
Built voice agents, AI IVRs, email agents or document-extraction (OCR/LLM) workflows.
Experience with ERP or CRM integrations (e.g., Business Central, Zoho, Salesforce).
Familiarity with agent frameworks or orchestration tools (e.g., LangGraph, n8n, MCP, Claude Agent SDK).
A public portfolio: side projects, GitHub, blog or demos of things you've built.

What success looks like:
30 days
Learned the business and our platforms; shadowed users in at least 3 teams; shipped one small improvement or automation.
60 days
Owned a product area; written and shipped at least one PRD; prototyped one AI workflow and validated it with real users.
90 days
Launched an AI agent or automation to production with a clear metric (hours saved, cost cut, cycle time or error rate) and a plan to scale it.

Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. We enable your best to power our future.

Job Description

Gracenote, the content data division of Nielsen, powers innovative entertainment experiences for leading media companies worldwide. Our advanced entertainment metadata and connected IDs enable seamless content navigation and discovery, helping consumers connect to the content they love and explore new favorites. With a global presence, Gracenote delivers both global and localized video, audio, automotive & sports content solutions across the Americas, Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Some of the biggest names who trust Gracenote are Jio, Amazon, NBC, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Samsung, Sony etc. Our metadata entertainment solutions have a global footprint of 80+ countries, 100K+ channels and catalogs, 70+ sports and 100M+ music tracks, all across 35 languages.

We are seeking a product manager to help deliver a new AI-based platform powering a new family of Instream Video Intelligence (ISVI) products. As Product Manager, you'll be responsible for coordinating the platform roadmap, and delivery of new technologies that leverage Vision Language Models (VLMs) and related GenAI video technologies. You will work with a team of product experts in their field, and report to Gracenote’s SVP of Product.

Gracenote AI is an exciting new growth vector for Gracenote. This role will be hugely impactful in shaping commercial strategy, product strategy, and pricing to mature our VLM-based products in a rapidly-evolving technological landscape, and will play a significant role in how Gracenote helps the world's largest CTV apps and platforms power search and discovery.

The ideal candidate excels at product coordination and delivery, and will contribute directly to the success of these emergent products. This role requires a practitioner with a solutions-oriented mindset who understands the potential of VLM technology in the entertainment metadata industry and can execute to fruition.

Responsibilities

Own the Gracenote ISVI platform roadmap. Define and deliver LLM and Grounding products and platforms that anticipate the needs of the entertainment industry, with a specific focus on Video and Sports in Connected Television (CTV).
Work with a team of talented product managers, sharing knowledge, and aligning Gracenote’s expertise in entertainment metadata with the rapidly evolving capabilities of vision language models, coordinating deliverables and timing with your Product counterparts in the US.
Collaborate with internal cross-functional stakeholders and external partners to evangelize and articulate Gracenote’s AI vision and strategy.
Coordinate with Engineering colleagues and counterparts to ensure development resources are aligned with product priorities; collaborate with engineering, data science, UX, commercial, and external partners to deliver exceptional products.
Engage with customers to understand their problems and ensure we are building products with strong commercial potential.

Qualifications

5+ years experience leading technology product teams.

Demonstrated and detailed knowledge of the capability, potential, and pitfalls of language models and probabilistic technologies.

Applied experience in creating products that leverage language models to address domain-specific use cases, ideally employing large-scale, authoritative datasets.

Strong executive disposition and communication skills, with the ability to build trust in evolving data and technology environments.

Preferred: Experience in understanding and overcoming the business and technical challenges of the CTV/entertainment metadata space.

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. What We're Looking For

A professional who is equally comfortable discussing customer experiences, analyzing conversion funnels, defining product strategy, and working alongside engineers to bring impactful products to market.

Key Responsibilities

Drive activation and early engagement through dispatch tracking, first-transaction campaigns and welcome benefits.

Product Manager | TrustStack | Mumbai

Function: Product – TrustStack

Level: Product Manager 2

Location: Mumbai

At IDfy, TrustStack isn't a back-end utility — it's the trust and data platform that sits underneath every IDfy product. It verifies people and businesses against authoritative sources, reads and checks documents, confirms that a face is real and belongs to the right person, and detects fraud and tampering. Every IDfy product, and hundreds of banks, NBFCs, and fintechs, rely on it every day.

This role owns the roadmap for a set of areas within TrustStack and takes them to their next stage — from what to build and why, to how it reaches customers and whether it moved the needle. You'll spend real time with clients, lead Engineering, DevOps, and Data Science without formal authority, and build prototypes yourself when that's the fastest way to an answer. This is an individual-contributor role: hands-on, high ownership, high impact.

What You'll Own

You'll own the roadmap and outcomes for areas within TrustStack, matched to your strengths:

Fraud Intelligence — detecting fraud and tampering across documents, faces, and identities, and turning those signals into products clients rely on
AI-Native Access — making our capabilities easy for developers, partner platforms, and AI agents to discover and use
Model Quality & Reliability — knowing how our models and data sources perform in production, and acting before a client feels a problem
Document Intelligence — helping clients and internal teams read, understand, and verify any document faster
Global Coverage — taking capabilities to new markets and cross-border use cases, and building geography-specific capabilities

We're The Right Match If You

Have a B.Tech from a Tier-1 engineering institute (IIT / NIT / BITS)
Have 4–5 years of experience, with hands-on product management on technical, integration-heavy, or data-centric B2B products — developer platforms, data infrastructure, ML-powered products, or B2B SaaS (product and consulting backgrounds both welcome)
Have worked on implementing GenAI or agentic models — and have built something with AI tools yourself: a prototype, an internal tool, an agent, or a script you actually used. Bring it to the interview.
Are strongly analytical — comfortable crunching data, working with SQL, logs, dashboards, and model evaluation metrics, and making a call from evidence
Have built 0→1, or genuinely want to — you're comfortable starting from a blank page and shaping the answer
Have high agency and a bias for action — you'd rather ship a version on Friday and learn than debate it for a month, and you can show us examples
Speak Engineering, DevOps, and Data Science fluently — engineers trust your judgement on integrations, data pipelines, and trade-offs
Are client-facing by instinct — you can run a discovery session with a client team and present a roadmap to its leadership with equal ease
Have led without authority — you've rallied engineers and data scientists who didn't report to you around a shared deadline and outcome
Write clearly — your specs, updates, and decision notes are short, sharp, and actually get read

Bonus Points If You've

Worked on B2B integrations (at any point in your career — not necessarily in your current role)
Built or shipped work in identity verification, fraud, risk, or fintech for banks and NBFCs
Worked closely with ML teams on model evaluation, monitoring, or releases
Had a founding or early-stage startup stint, or worked as an engineer or data scientist before moving into product

What Your Day Would Look Like

Owning the roadmap — setting priorities for your areas, sequencing the work, defining success metrics and what "done" means, and defending trade-offs to leadership
Being in front of clients — leading discovery with clients and partners, joining integration reviews and escalations, and presenting new capabilities and roadmaps to client teams
Turning ambiguity into action — breaking a fuzzy opportunity into a quick MVP, followed by an enterprise-grade plan with milestones, owners, and dates, then driving it week by week
Prototyping before you spec — using AI coding tools to build a working prototype, demo, or dashboard and putting it in front of a client or engineer before writing a long document
Going deep on model and product performance — instrumenting metrics, evaluating precision, recall, drift, and latency, and making data-driven trade-offs between accuracy, speed, and cost
Leading cross-functionally — aligning Engineering, Data Science/ML, DevOps, Sales, Legal, and InfoSec teams that don't report to you, without letting anyone become a bottleneck
Shipping and measuring — taking features from idea to production to adoption, and tracking whether what you shipped moved the goal
Wearing the other hats — drafting the pricing note, the launch one-pager, the security questionnaire response, or the demo when no one else will

Why IDfy

Because this is where trust is built with data. At IDfy, you'll work on:

Problems that don't have answers yet — fraud intelligence and AI-native trust infrastructure for financial services, across India and Asia
Real scale from day one — your work runs under every IDfy product and inside the journeys of banks, NBFCs, and fintechs
A strong technical bench — dedicated Engineering and Data Science teams
Ownership, not tickets — you own outcomes end-to-end, with room to make mistakes along the way
AI-native ways of working — we prototype with AI tools every day and expect you to push that further

jobs.sourceTitle: Principal Product Manager, Data & AI Platforms ( Hybrid in Bangalore )
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Principal Product Manager, Data & AI Platforms

As a Principal Product Manager, Data & AI Platforms at Smartsheet, you will serve as a visionary leader, responsible for the strategic direction and execution of our foundational data ecosystem. You will treat our data and AI infrastructure as a premier product, ensuring it is of high quality, architected for massive scale, and directly aligned with Smartsheet’s mission-critical business and advanced AI objectives. This is a high-impact role that bridges engineering excellence with measurable business value, driving the democratization of data and the enablement of advanced AI capabilities across the global organization.

You Will

Drive Strategic Alignment: Lead the alignment of data governance and AI-driven use cases across Engineering, Product, and Business organizations to ensure unified goals, rigorous prioritization, and clear scoping of platform capabilities.
Lead Product Lifecycle: Manage both inbound (requirements gathering, strategic roadmap definition) and outbound (internal/external evangelism, community engagement, customer feedback loops) product management for the data and AI platform.
Own the Execution Roadmap: Define and drive the execution roadmap for critical data platform features, including the enablement of AI capabilities, streamlined data ingestion/onboarding, and foundational data vision initiatives.
Champion Governance & Quality: Own the business-stakeholder perspective for data quality and governance, ensuring the platform provides reliable, secure, and compliant data assets for all consumers.
Deliver High-Quality Requirements: Provide a continuous stream of detailed requirements with clear, measurable acceptance criteria, demonstrating a deep understanding of both upstream data source complexities and downstream end-user consumption needs.
Engage Stakeholders Extensively: Partner with cross-functional executive leaders to inform platform roadmaps and ensure the data strategy remains strategically aligned with Smartsheet’s overall product and business platform goals.
Act as a Data Ambassador: Represent the data and AI platform's capabilities internally and externally, clearly communicating the value proposition of features related to data retention, security, compliance, reliability, and integrity.
Provide Mentorship: Offer informal leadership and mentorship to Engineering and Product team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and collaborative delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Data as a Product (DaaP): Evangelize and implement a "Data as a Product" mindset, shifting the organization from reactive data requests to a self-service, scalable, and visionary data platform.
AI Enablement: Partner closely with AI and Engineering teams to integrate AI-driven use cases into the core data fabric, ensuring the platform robustly supports advanced machine learning, predictive analytics, and process automation.
Infrastructure Strategy: Leverage a strong, current understanding of Data Lakes, Data Mesh principles, Medallion Architecture, and modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake) to guide the technical evolution of Smartsheet’s data architecture.
Data Integrity & Semantic Impact: Define and manage the semantic layer and data integrity practices to ensure data is accurate, fresh, and trusted across all business units.
Compliance & Ethics: Establish and automate robust data governance standards, including metadata management and strict privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, SOC2), while maintaining engineering velocity.

Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 8+ years of experience in Product Management, with a significant and proven focus on AI & data infrastructure, core backend platforms, or high-scale technical SaaS products.

Description

Product Manager

Requirements

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on Product Manager to own, innovate, and scale a key WFM product line. This role is for a true product creator, someone who combines deep domain knowledge in workforce management with the commercial mindset and execution needed to bring innovative, high-impact products to market.

You will own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from shaping vision and strategy to driving successful launches, adoption, and ongoing growth. You will engage directly with strategic customers, partners, and cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that solve real-world challenges in contact centres and complex enterprise environments.

Key Responsibilities

– Own the WFM Product Vision & Strategy:

Develop, articulate, and execute a compelling vision and strategic roadmap for the WFM product line, aligned to customer needs, market trends, and company goals.

– Drive Full Product Lifecycle:

Lead the end-to-end process from market discovery and concept validation through launch, adoption, and scaling. Measure success against business outcomes (growth, adoption, customer satisfaction, retention).


Be the Customer and Market Expert:


Deeply understand contact centre and workforce management domains. Identify emerging needs, market shifts, and technology trends to create differentiated offerings.


Product Creation & Innovation:


Identify new product opportunities, develop business cases, and lead ideation, design, and MVP/prototype delivery. Take a hands-on approach to both strategy and execution.


Strategic Stakeholder Engagement:


Act as the product ambassador with key customers (including enterprise and strategic accounts), executive sponsors, and partners. Gather high-level feedback and incorporate it into roadmap decisions.

– Go-to-Market Ownership

Work closely with commercial, customer success, and marketing teams to define go-to-market, pricing, and enablement.

– Cross-functional Leadership:

Collaborate with engineering, UX, QA, support, and operations to deliver high-quality products on time and to specification. Champion a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.


Own the strategy, roadmap, and business case for WFM Request Management covering the full request lifecycle — submission, validation, approval, and write-back to the schedule — for time off, shift swaps, shift bids, overtime and voluntary time off, schedule changes, availability updates, and fully configurable custom request types.


– Drive deep capability definition across request rules and eligibility criteria, quotas and allotments, accrual and balance validation, multi-level and hierarchical approval workflows, auto-approval and auto-decline logic, waitlists, blackout periods, notifications, and audit history — balancing employee flexibility with operational coverage and adherence.

– Act as the recognized domain expert on request management dependencies with Scheduling, Forecasting, Time & Attendance, and Mobile/self-service, partnering with peer PMs to sequence cross-product work and resolve conflicting requirements.


Lead discovery and validation with customers, advisory councils, and EAP/beta programs; write clear requirements and acceptance criteria, prioritize the backlog with engineering and UX, and make defensible trade-offs on scope, quality, and timing.
Own launch and adoption outcomes — enablement, demos, positioning, and release communications for Sales, Services, and Support — and instrument success metrics such as self-service adoption, auto-approval rates, approval turnaround time, and supervisor time saved


Job responsibilities

Experience & Skills

Must-have:

– 7 years in product management (ideally SaaS/enterprise), with a strong track record of launching and scaling B2B workforce management, contact centre, or enterprise SaaS products.

– 5+ years of direct WFM, scheduling, or real-time analyst experience (preferably in a contact centre environment), with hands-on familiarity with WFM platforms ( NICE, Verint, Assembled, etc.).

– Proven experience managing the end-to-end product lifecycle, driving commercial outcomes (including pricing, EAP, and GTM).

– Deep understanding of key WFM metrics (adherence, shrinkage, occupancy, schedule optimisation, forecast variance).

– Proven ability to create, launch, and grow new products or major features, not just incremental delivery or backlog management.

– Demonstrated strategic and commercial acumen, including business case development, go-to-market, and revenue/growth responsibility.

– Experience engaging directly with executive-level customers, strategic partners, and cross-functional teams.

– Strong technical understanding of SaaS, cloud ecosystems, and the software delivery lifecycle.

– Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to have:

– Experience with global product delivery in multi-site teams.

– Experience as a contact centre workforce planner or in a management role managing planning/forecasting teams.

– Exposure to AI/ML, automation, and analytics in workforce management.

– Experience in complex B2B software environments.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related) or equivalent practical experience.

What we offer

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Manager, Product Management

Manager, Product Management – Data and AI Platform

WHO IS MASTERCARD?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Overview

Mastercard is building a cloud-native data platform to power next-generation, data-driven solutions and services. This platform will deliver a data mesh architecture, advanced technologies, and processes that enable Mastercard to scale and innovate at speed.

We are seeking a seasoned Product Manager to join our Data and AI Platform team. In this role, you will own the product lifecycle—from shaping strategy and defining the roadmap to partnering with engineering for execution. You will collaborate across internal teams and external partners to deliver impactful solutions that align with Mastercard’s vision for Data and AI.

What You’ll Do

Define and execute the product roadmap for our Data and AI platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
Lead product development through the full lifecycle—from ideation to launch—driving innovation and measurable outcomes.
Collaborate closely with engineering teams, participating in technical discussions and leading requirement workshops.
Use data-driven insights to identify performance challenges, prioritize features, and optimize product adoption and revenue.
Partner with security, compliance, and legal teams to ensure vendor solutions meet Mastercard standards.
Drive cross-functional engagement and stakeholder alignment across multiple initiatives.


What You Bring

Several years of experience designing and managing data platform solutions for SaaS businesses, with expertise in multi-tenant architectures and analytics.
Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, and familiarity with AI/ML platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake (preferred).

Proven track record as a Product Owner in Agile environments, with strong backlog management and prioritization skills.
Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels.
Deep understanding of the Data and AI platform landscape, architectural patterns, and emerging technologies.
Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action, ownership, and agility in a fast-paced environment.


Why Join Us?

At Mastercard, you’ll work on cutting-edge data and AI initiatives that shape the future of payments and digital commerce. You’ll have the opportunity to innovate at scale, collaborate with world-class teams, and make a global impact.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

About Phenom and the Agents team

Phenom builds the AI talent platform that large enterprises use to hire, onboard and grow their people. The Agents team builds the AI agents that do hiring work end to end: the Sourcing Agent, the Intake Agent, outreach and candidate-fraud detection, along with the platform products that power them.

Our bet is goal-driven hiring. A hiring manager states an outcome, such as "20 qualified ICU nurses in Dallas this quarter", and agents work backwards through intake, sourcing and outreach to deliver it. These agents run inside Phenom and inside the tools recruiters and managers already use, connected through open standards like MCP and agent-to-agent protocols.

The work is high-stakes: agents act on candidate data and influence employment decisions for some of the largest employers in healthcare, retail and financial services.

About The Role

You will own a portfolio of products end to end: what they do, how well they do it, and whether customers get the hiring outcomes they paid for. The role is one part platform product manager and one part forward-deployed builder. You will define how our agents are designed, evaluated and governed, and you will also sit with enterprise customers to map their hiring workflows, demo working agents, and see deployments through to steady state.

You may also own the platform products these agents depend on, such as the hiring ontology, sourcing and data collection, document intelligence, and the hiring-data pipelines that feed reinforcement learning. A great agent is only as good as the data, structure and feedback loops beneath it.

We want someone who builds, not someone who only manages a roadmap. You prototype with coding agents before writing a spec, you write your own evals, and you can explain exactly why an agent failed on a real customer's data.

Location: Hyderabad, India, working closely with customers worldwide, sales and leadership

What You'll Do

Own an agent

Own the vision, roadmap and outcomes for an agent (for example, sourcing, intake or fraud), from problem definition through launch, adoption and iteration.

Define each agent's job in outcome terms: what goal it accepts, what it is allowed to do on its own, and when it hands back to a recruiter or hiring manager.

Own the metrics that prove agents work, such as goal-fulfilment rate, qualified candidates delivered, time to first qualified slate and recruiter acceptance, and report them in weekly business reviews.

Own the platform products that power agents

Own one or more shared platform products that agents build on, for example:

Hiring ontology: the structured model of skills, roles, credentials and requirements that agents reason over.

Sourcing and data collection: how candidate and job data is acquired, enriched, deduplicated and kept fresh, with consent and provenance tracked.

Document intelligence: parsing and understanding resumes, job descriptions, credentials and onboarding documents.

Hiring-data RL pipelines: turning recruiter decisions, candidate responses and hiring outcomes into governed training and reinforcement-learning signals that make agents better over time.

Treat each platform product as a product: define its internal and external customers, roadmap, quality metrics and service levels.

Decide what belongs in the shared platform and what belongs inside a single agent, so new agents reuse capabilities instead of rebuilding them.

Set the quality bar with evals

Build and maintain evaluation sets drawn from real customer workflows, and decide what "good enough to ship" means for each agent.

Run regression, LLM-as-judge and human-review loops with engineering and data science, and turn failures into prioritised fixes.

Balance accuracy, latency and cost as models and prompts change.

Work forward-deployed with strategic customers

Lead discovery with enterprise talent-acquisition teams: map their hiring workflows, systems and constraints, and find where agents create the most value.

Build and present working agent demos that win over sceptical buyers, partnering with sales and solutions engineering on the technical win.

See deployments through hypercare to steady state, and handle escalations directly.

Turn what you learn in each deployment into reusable configurations, playbooks and platform features, so the tenth customer is faster than the first.

Must-have Requirements

4+ years in product management, and 8+ years combining PM with adjacent product-building roles (forward-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, product consulting, founder, customer success, sales, etc.). At least 1 of those years spent shipping LLM-powered products used in production.

Shipped agents, not just features. You have taken at least one AI agent or multi-step LLM workflow to real enterprise users, and can explain what broke in production and how you fixed it.

Evals fluency. You have designed evaluation sets, defined pass/fail criteria, and used evals to decide whether to ship.

Real technical depth. You understand tool calling, retrieval, orchestration, context management and the cost/latency trade-offs between models. You read API docs, and engineers trust your judgment in design reviews.

Hands-on builder. You use coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) regularly and prototype to test ideas before writing a PRD.

Enterprise customer skills. You have led discovery, mapped complex workflows and run demos with demanding B2B buyers, and you are comfortable owning escalations.

Outcome metrics. You define success as a business outcome, instrument it, and use the data to prioritise.

Clear writing and communication. You write crisp PRDs and POVs, and you explain technical AI concepts equally well to engineers, recruiters and executives.

Good-to-have Requirements

Talent-acquisition domain knowledge: ATS, recruiting CRM, sourcing, programmatic job ads, or high-volume and hourly hiring, especially in healthcare or retail.

Data and ML platform experience: ontologies or knowledge graphs, document parsing, data acquisition and enrichment, or feedback and RL pipelines that improve models from real-world outcomes.

Engineering or ML background: a computer science degree or prior work as a software or ML engineer.

Startup speed: time at a hyper-growth AI-native company, or running a 0-to-1 product inside a larger organisation.

Global collaboration: working from India with US enterprise customers and leadership across time zones.

Principal Product Manager - Agentic Investigation & Reliability Experiences

Sumo Logic is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead how engineers and operators investigate incidents, understand reliability risk, and act on their operational and security telemetry.

The observability category was built around collecting telemetry and giving people tools to navigate it: dashboards, queries, monitors, traces, and alerts. Customer expectations are now shifting. Teams don't just want more dashboards; they want help getting from a signal to a resolution, understanding what's broken, why, what's impacted, and what to do next. As AI agents move into production operations, this role owns how Sumo Logic brings intelligent, agent-assisted investigation and reliability workflows to customers, grounded in evidence, context, and enterprise governance.

This is a senior, high-ownership role. It requires genuine observability domain background. You should have lived in this space and understand how monitoring, troubleshooting, and reliability actually work, combined with the ambition to define a new category of experience on top of it.

What You Will Own

The current data experiences. Log Search, Live Tail, query and query optimization, Metrics Search, Tracing, Dashboards, and the data-experience UI. This is a live, revenue-generating product with real customers, and keeping it strong is part of the job. You own its health, roadmap, and competitiveness today while steering it toward an AI-native future, focusing new investment where it strengthens investigation, speed, and value for both new and power users.

The reliability and alerting surface. Monitors, Alerts, SLOs, Scheduled Searches, and the reliability workflows around them. You will own alerting accuracy, noise reduction, and operational health signals both as capabilities customers depend on today and as the foundation for more automated, agent-assisted detection and investigation.

The agentic investigation experience. You will define how a user moves from a search, a monitor, a dashboard, or an alert to likely cause faster, with supporting evidence. This means productizing investigation workflows that reason across logs, metrics, traces, monitors, dashboards, and related context, and evolving them from reactive troubleshooting toward more proactive detection over time.

What You Will Be Doing

Set the multi-quarter vision for Sumo Logic's investigation and reliability experiences, and turn it into a roadmap engineering can execute against.
Own the roadmap, health, and competitiveness of the current data and reliability product surfaces.
Define how search, metrics, tracing, dashboards, monitors, alerts, and SLOs evolve from human-navigated tools into more intuitive, AI-assisted experiences.
Productize investigation workflows that reason across telemetry and related operational context, and surface findings customers can act on.
Own alerting accuracy, noise reduction, and operational health signals.
Shape how skills, tools, and agents are built on top of the data surfaces, and ensure they respect enterprise controls such as RBAC, audit, cost limits, and approvals.
Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, performance, and reliability at enterprise scale.
Translate strategy into clear PRDs, proposals, user stories, acceptance criteria, and phased rollout plans.
Use telemetry to understand how customers search, investigate, and configure alerts, and where they hit friction, latency, false positives, or cost.
Create leadership-facing proposals that frame tradeoffs across customer demand, governance, performance, cost, and long-term architecture.

What You Bring

8+ years of product management experience with real observability or monitoring domain background. You have owned products in observability, monitoring, incident response, APM, or a closely adjacent operational-telemetry space. This is a hard requirement.
Deep, first-hand understanding of the observability surface area including logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, monitors, alerts, and SLOs, and of how engineers and operators actually investigate incidents and decide what to trust.
Proven ability to run a live, at-scale product, owning the roadmap, health, and competitiveness of shipping surfaces while driving a larger transformation.
A track record of owning broad, technically deep surfaces and setting direction that other teams build on.
Familiarity with how AI and agents are changing data interaction, including natural-language investigation, tools, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop action, or the ability to ramp quickly.
Strong technical instincts around query engines, time-series and trace data, and alerting systems, plus the judgment to know where an AI-assisted experience should replace a manual flow and where depth must stay.
Strong analytical skills and comfort using telemetry, dashboards, SQL, and usage data to understand adoption, friction, reliability, and cost.
Excellent communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write clear proposals, decision docs, PRDs, and acceptance criteria.
High ownership and drive to make progress across a large, ambiguous, fast-moving surface.

Must-Have Qualities

Runs today, builds tomorrow. Keeps a live product healthy and competitive while reinventing it, and knows what to sustain and what to rebuild.
Deep observability judgment. Understands search, metrics, tracing, and alerting well enough to make hard architecture and tradeoff calls with engineering.
Operator empathy. Knows what makes an alert trustworthy, an investigation fast, and a recommendation credible enough to act on.
Governance-minded. Treats RBAC, audit, cost, and approvals as part of the product.
Sets direction. Defines a vision for a broad area and rallies teams around it.
Analytical. Uses data to prioritize, validate, and refine decisions.
High drive and ownership. Pushes through ambiguity across a large surface and drives execution to conclusion.
Tradeoff thinker. Frames options and recommendations clearly for leadership.

Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

AI Governance is one of the fastest-emerging categories in enterprise software. The first Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for AI Governance Platforms was published this year, and OneTrust is named a Visionary in it.

OneTrust is looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the developer-facing products in our AI Governance solution to own it’s early success and growing adoption.

These products live within the AI development lifecycle an engineer already follows when it builds an AI system: writing prompts, wiring up retrieval and tools, evaluating what the system actually does, and deciding it is ready to ship. You own the governance tooling and checks that live at those steps, and the work is to turn governance requirements into controls a developer can implement and test.

You will define what we build, ship it with a dedicated engineering and design team, and prove it with measurable outcomes. You will work daily with Engineering, UX, and other Product Managers, and you will prototype and build with modern AI development tools.

Your Mission

Define and own the product strategy, roadmap, and packaging for OneTrust's developer-facing AI governance products 
Translate governance requirements into technical requirements, tests, and controls that developers can act on 
Own the developer experience end to end, including SDK design, APIs, documentation, samples, and CI/CD integration 
Set requirements earlier in the lifecycle carry into the build, and that signals from production carry back into future evaluations 
Work with design partners and early access customers to validate direction against real engineering teams 
Partner with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering, on positioning, launches, and the technical narrative 
Own the outcomes: developer adoption, integration depth, and the revenue and retention these products influence 

You Are

A hands-on product leader with a track record of strong product ownership and demonstrated product-led growth. You have shipped developer-facing products, and you are comfortable with ambiguity. You work well at speed, building for where the market is right now and revising as it moves.

Builder — You prototype. When a team is deciding on an API shape or an interaction, you open the tools and show them one. You are comfortable in a repo and an SDK. 
Developer empathy — You have built products where the user was an engineer, and you know adoption is won on time-to-first-integration, documentation, and good defaults. 
Collaborator — Most of what you own depends on work other teams are doing, and you spend as much time inside their plans as your own. You build alignment and confidence across other teams without having authority over them. 
Zero-to-one — You have taken new products from nothing to real customers and real revenue, knowing full well what it takes. 

Your Experience Includes

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience 
12+ years of product management experience in enterprise software, including end-to-end ownership of a technical product area 
Demonstrated success taking new products from concept to shipped, adopted, and generating revenue 
Strong working knowledge of the modern AI stack: LLMs and model providers, agents and tool calling, RAG pipelines, prompts, and their failure modes 
Familiarity with AI evaluation practice, including benchmarking, offline and online evaluation, red teaming, and safety testing 
Proven ability to partner deeply with Engineering, UX, Security, and Legal, and to earn technical credibility with senior engineers 
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate vision, create alignment, and represent new products credibly 

A Major Plus

Experience building developer tools or developer platforms — SDKs, APIs, CLIs, IDE extensions, CI/CD integrations, or testing frameworks — where engineers were your primary user 
Fluency using AI tools to build product: prototyping in code with coding agents, building your own evals, and shipping AI-assisted workflows 

Also Preferred

Hands-on experience with AI security or safety controls such as guardrails, prompt injection defenses, content filtering, or output validation 
Familiarity with AI regulations and frameworks such as the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001 
Experience with design partner programs, early access programs, or developer relations 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

OneTrust Careers on YouTube
@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Roles And Responsibilities

feasibility.

Comfortable with the economics of AI products - inference cost, latency trade-offs, model capability ceilings, evaluation rigor - well enough to make roadmap trade-offs without deferring every technical question to engineering.

Sharp prioritization discipline: you can say no to a well-articulated customer request, explain why, and offer a path forward that serves the underlying need without expanding scope.
Experience working in a platform-and-application product model: you understand the tension between shipping agent-specific features and investing in platform capabilities, and you make that trade-off deliberately.
Collaborative leadership style with an ability to influence without authority - across engineering, design, data science, sales, and compliance functions that each have their own priorities.
Familiarity with agentic AI concepts (tool use, retrieval, reasoning loops, guardrails, safety) at a level sufficient to write meaningful acceptance criteria and evaluate whether an implementation actually


meets the product intent.

Job Overview

Senior Product Manager, Data Platform

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our consumer data platform. We have a modern cloud lakehouse in place and are now building the consumer data foundation on top of it: a canonical data model, a consumer data warehouse, and one trusted source of data for analytics, data science, risk and finance teams.

You’ll own the roadmap from the start. You’ll decide which use cases to deliver first, define how core consumer entities are modeled, and make sure each new use case builds on shared data instead of one-off pipelines. You’ll work closely with data engineering, data architecture, analytics and risk teams.

This is not a dashboard-building role. You’ll own the data, definitions and metrics that dashboards, models and reports are built on.

What you’ll do in your first 12 months

Build a prioritized backlog of consumer data use cases with analytics, data science, risk and finance, and decide which 3–5 to deliver first.
Define canonical consumer entities, such as customer, account, transaction, fee, merchant, country and currency, so they mean the same thing across products.
Decide where products share a common model and where they need their own structures, and document the reasoning.
Define single, governed definitions for core consumer KPIs such as active customers, revenue per user, lifetime value and churn.
Write requirements engineers can build from: source-to-target mappings, grain, keys, history rules and data-quality checks.
Track adoption: which teams have moved to the new models, how much they’re being used, and how many metric discrepancies have been resolved.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or an MBA, or equivalent practical experience.
6+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years in a data product or risk data role.
Experience starting with many competing data requests, choosing the few to build first, defining an MVP, and explaining the trade-offs to stakeholders.
Experience working with engineering to deliver a data lake/lakehouse, data warehouse or shared data model used by multiple teams.
Experience bringing together inconsistent data from multiple source systems into common entities, keys and definitions.
Hands-on SQL: you can join across tables, profile data for nulls and duplicates, reconcile counts between systems, and check whether data supports a use case without waiting for an analyst.

Experience with payments risk data such as fraud, account takeover, KYC/AML or transaction monitoring signals.
Experience with modern cloud data platforms and tools, such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt or major cloud providers’ data services.

About CrazyNeon

CrazyNeon is a fast-growing e-commerce brand specializing in custom LED neon signs and other custom signage, selling to customers across the US and other international markets. It's owned and operated by Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd.

We're building the next generation of the custom signage buying experience — combining e-commerce, technology, design, automation, and AI.


About the role

We're looking for a Product Manager who's genuinely obsessed with the customer journey, conversion rates, and building better digital experiences.

This isn't a traditional PM role focused mainly on managing a software roadmap. You'll identify opportunities across the CrazyNeon website and customer journey, figure out why customers convert or drop off, test and ship improvements, and work closely with design, technology, marketing, sales, and operations to make them happen.

A meaningful part of the role is also forward-looking: exploring and building new AI-powered products and experiences that change how customers design, customize, buy, and interact with custom signage.

The ideal candidate combines e-commerce, CRO, product thinking, data analytics, technology, and AI — in one person.


What you'll do

1. E-commerce product management

  • Own and continuously improve the CrazyNeon digital customer journey, from landing page to purchase.
  • Identify friction points across product discovery, customization, pricing, artwork submission, design approval, checkout, and post-purchase.
  • Build and maintain a product roadmap based on business impact and customer needs.
  • Work with technology, design, marketing, sales, and operations to execute improvements.
  • Find opportunities to improve customer experience, revenue, average order value, and conversion.
  • Track competitor websites and emerging e-commerce experiences for ideas worth adapting.

2. Conversion rate optimization

CRO is a major part of this role.

  • Own the website's conversion optimization roadmap end to end.
  • Analyze the full funnel and pinpoint where and why customers drop off.
  • Use analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, customer feedback, and A/B testing to diagnose problems.
  • Turn findings into testable hypotheses, then design and prioritize experiments.
  • Partner with UI/UX and development to ship tests, measure results, and roll successful ones into permanent improvements.

Areas you'll optimize include: landing pages, product pages, product customization, pricing presentation, calls to action, trust signals, reviews and social proof, quote/inquiry flows, artwork upload, design approval, cart, checkout, lead-generation forms, and mobile experience.

Over time, you should develop a sharp, evidence-backed understanding of what actually makes a customer buy custom signage online — and keep improving that journey.

3. Data & analytics

  • Use data — not just intuition — to identify product and conversion opportunities.
  • Monitor conversion rate, revenue per visitor, average order value, add-to-cart rate, checkout conversion, lead-to-order conversion, customer acquisition cost, repeat purchase rate, funnel drop-off, and product-level performance.
  • Build dashboards and reports that keep the team honest about what's working.
  • Translate data into concrete, actionable product recommendations.
  • Set up measurement frameworks for every new launch or experiment.

4. Customer research

  • Build a deep understanding of CrazyNeon's customers and how they buy.
  • Mine customer inquiries, support conversations, sales feedback, reviews, and abandoned carts for product opportunities.
  • Run customer interviews and usability studies where useful.
  • Spot recurring problems that technology, automation, better UX, or new products could solve.
  • Turn customer problems into clear product requirements.

5. AI & new-age products

A key part of this role is identifying and building AI-powered products and experiences for CrazyNeon — and continuously exploring how AI can improve both the customer experience and internal operations.

Potential areas include:

  • AI-powered custom neon/sign designer and design generation
  • AI artwork analysis and preflight
  • AI-powered product recommendations, search, and discovery
  • AI-assisted quoting and configuration
  • AI-powered customer assistance and sales tools
  • AI-assisted artwork-to-production workflows
  • AI-powered personalization and customer mockup generation
  • Internal AI knowledge systems for employees

You'll be responsible for spotting high-value AI opportunities, evaluating new AI technologies and platforms, defining MVPs and requirements, working with developers, AI engineers, designers, and outside vendors, testing with real customers, measuring adoption and impact, and taking what works from prototype to production.

You don't need to be an AI engineer — but you should be technically curious, and comfortable understanding what modern AI can and can't actually do.

6. Product strategy & roadmap

  • Maintain a prioritized roadmap based on revenue impact, customer value, effort, and strategic importance.
  • Turn business problems into clear product requirements, briefs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Take products from idea MVP launch optimization, in step with engineering and design.
  • Set KPIs for every major initiative.

7. Experimentation & innovation

We want someone who's constantly asking: "What can we do differently?"

  • Track new e-commerce technologies and trends, and study companies doing e-commerce and AI well.
  • Identify technologies that could give CrazyNeon a real edge.
  • Prototype quickly, and test ideas before committing serious development resources.
  • Help build a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.

Must-have

  • Hands-on experience running conversion rate optimization programs.

Nice to have

Job Description:

We are looking for an Assistant General Manager / General Manager – Product Management to own BYLD Group's staffing product. The business is operations-heavy, with many internal and client stakeholders. You will use AI and automation to improve how the end-to-end staffing process runs, ship new features, and drive their adoption.
This role carries end-to-end ownership of product outcomes. You will work directly with business stakeholders, engineering and operations, and are expected to design AI-enabled workflows and architecture, prototype them hands-on, and see them through to launch.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Product ownership: Own the roadmap, prioritization and delivery for the staffing platform, balancing business impact, effort and urgency as priorities change.
AI and workflow architecture: Map the end-to-end staffing workflow, identify where AI and automation add the most value, and define how they are embedded into the platform architecture. Work with engineering on data flow, integrations, accuracy targets, fallbacks and human-in-the-loop checks.
Efficiency and automation: Set measurable targets (turnaround time, recruiter productivity, cost per placement), decide what to build, buy or automate with no-code tools, and prototype quickly before committing engineering time.
New features and adoption: Define and launch new features with operations users, track adoption, close the feedback loop, and retire what is not used.
Product opportunities: Identify gaps across client-facing, candidate-facing and internal workflows and turn them into prioritized, evidence-backed proposals.
Stakeholder management: Run a single intake and triage process for requests from operations, sales, delivery and leadership. Make trade-offs visible and communicate changes early.
Requirements and PRDs: Extract clear requirements from non-technical users and write PRDs that engineering can build against.
Sprint execution: Work with engineering to plan and run sprints, track scope, dependencies and timelines, and unblock issues as they arise.
Product operations: Own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the product function: backlog hygiene, release coordination and checklists, sprint reporting, and regular status updates to stakeholders. Standardize PRD, sprint and release templates so execution stays consistent as the team scales.
Metrics and reporting: Track operational efficiency and product metrics (sprint velocity, release health, feature adoption), analyse NPS, support tickets and feature requests, and report outcomes to leadership.
Design collaboration: Brief the in-house designer, review output against the original ask, and use AI design tools for mock-ups when design support is unavailable.
Tooling and onboarding: Own and maintain the product tooling stack (project management, design, analytics, feedback), keep its data clean, document processes

Proven ability to improve operational efficiency with AI and automation, with measurable results (hours saved, turnaround time reduced).

Hands-on builder: you create working automations, agents or prototypes yourself with LLM, workflow or AI coding tools.
Strong stakeholder management across many senior stakeholders with conflicting priorities, and comfort with rapid change.
