Overview: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our team as a Product Manager in the Core HCM domain . In this role, you will be responsible for leading initiatives to streamline and improve Global HR processes, ultim ately enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and employee experience across the organization in line with company policies and compliance.

About this role:

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in Workday Core HCM to join the People Platforms team. In this role, you will own the product strategy and continuous improvement of our Core HCM capabilities across the Hire to Retire process (excluding the Hire process, which sits with the Talent Acquisition & Attraction (TAA) team), with particularly strong focus on the Change Job business process, as well as Termination and data management. You will also need working knowledge of Workday security and integrations to understand how changes in this space ripple across the wider Workday landscape. This is a strategic, solution-oriented position where you will collaborate with global leaders and cross-functional teams—including process owners, technology, security, and support functions—to accelerate implementation timelines, manage the product lifecycle, reduce operational issues, apply prioritization frameworks, and build a transparent, high-quality product roadmap.

The role is weighted roughly 50–70% product management and 50–30% process ownership; in practice the two are heavily intertwined, and the successful candidate will move fluidly between defining what we build and defining and standardizing how the underlying HR processes work.

Key responsibilities

Product

Product Strategy & Roadmap

Define and execute a strategic product roadmap for Workday Core HCM aligned with organizational goals and evolving market needs, with a strong emphasis on the Change Job business process, Termination, and data management across the Hire to Retire lifecycle (excluding Hire, owned by TAA).

Feature Prioritization & Backlog Management

Collaborate with process owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and user feedback; own and groom the product backlog in Jira (or equivalent).

Requirements & Development Oversight

Translate business needs into clear product requirements, well-crafted user stories, and acceptance criteria. Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle using agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Quality Assurance & Testing

Partner with solution and QA teams to define test strategies—particularly for Change Job, Termination, and other core data change scenarios—and support testing efforts to ensure the reliability and performance of product releases.

Stakeholder Engagement & Product Evangelism

Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for your products. Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition to stakeholders and end-users.

User-Centric Design & Feedback Loops

Engage with users to gather insights, validate solutions, and drive continuous improvement through iterative feedback and data-driven decision-making.

Training & Change Enablement

Collaborate with change management teams to develop training materials, user guides, and communication plans that support adoption and maximize product value.

Security & Integrations Awareness

Work with security and integration teams to understand the downstream and upstream impact of Core HCM changes (e.g., Change Job, Termination, data changes) on business process security, access, and integrations, ensuring product decisions account for these implications.

Process

Process Design & Documentation

Conduct comprehensive assessments of current Hire to Retire processes (excluding Hire), particularly Change Job, Termination, and related data management workflows, to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

Develop, implement, and maintain process documentation and guidelines, ensuring these are scalable and adaptable across regions and business units, and are clearly reflected in the supporting Workday configuration.

Process Standardization

Develop and maintain global standards for Change Job, Termination, and data management processes to enable consistency and compliance across all regions.

Conduct regular checks to identify variances and areas for optimization, and facilitate the sharing of best practices across regions.

Process Simplification & Automation

Use data-driven insight (including process mining where available) to identify complex, redundant, or unnecessary steps in Change Job, Termination, and data management processes, and redesign them to remove bottlenecks and reduce errors.

Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and evaluate technology solutions that streamline processes and enhance the employee and HR user experience.

Continuous Improvement

Implement continuous improvement initiatives—drawing on methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen where relevant—and define metrics and KPIs to measure process performance and track progress.

Change Management & Compliance

Lead process change management activities tied to product releases, including training, documentation, and progress monitoring.

Ensure Change Job, Termination, and data management processes comply with relevant data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements; support audits and help implement corrective actions where gaps are identified .

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (preferred).

Minimum 7 years of experience as a Digital or Software Product Manager and/or Process Owner in the HR Technology domain.

Deep, hands-on expertise in Workday Core HCM, with demonstrated strong expertise in the Change Job business process specifically; solid working knowledge of Termination and data management processes.

Broad working knowledge of Workday more generally, with the ability to understand how Core HCM changes interact with other modules.

Working knowledge of Workday security (e.g., domain and business process security) and integrations, sufficient to identify downstream impacts and collaborate effectively with specialist teams.

Strong understanding of HR processes and systems in large, global, and matrixed organizations, including the wider Hire to Retire lifecycle.

Strong experience working with agile methodologies and tools such as Jira (or similar), including facilitating agile ceremonies (e.g., stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives).

Demonstrated strength in crafting clear, well-structured user stories and acceptance criteria.

Experience in process design, standardization, and continuous improvement; familiarity with methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen is a plus.

Demonstrated ability to develop business cases for automation and process improvements.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.

Experience working with industrial or frontline organizations (e.g., retail, manufacturing, logistics ) is a plus.

Passion for innovation and driving meaningful change in the HR tech landscape.

*A. Product Development*

* Lead the development of new imitation jewellery collections based on current fashion trends, market research and customer requirements.
* Identify new product opportunities, designs, materials, finishes and manufacturing techniques.

Product Manager - NxtWave Academy

NxtWave | Hyderabad | Mon-Fri | Full-Time


About the Role


The Product Manager - NxtWave Academy owns the learning product: the experience that takes a student from enrolment through active learning to course completion. This is the product-side owner of the Academy's retention and engagement north star - the person who moves activation, weekly-active-learning, progression and in-journey drop-off through the product itself (features, nudges, personalization, AI-first learning tools). It is a hands-on, experimentation-first, AI-first role: you frame problems, separate assumption from evidence, and ship and read experiments rather than execute a pre-decided feature list.

What You'll Own


Learning Product & Funnel Ownership

  • Own and improve the in-product learner journey: activation -> active learning -> progression -> completion.
  • Define and track the Academy learning-product metric tree (activation, WAL, progression velocity, feature adoption, in-journey drop-off).
  • Diagnose drop-off with data before proposing a fix; instrument events and build the dashboards you rely on.

AI-First Product Delivery

  • Ship features leveraging LLMs, agents, retrieval and automation (adaptive practice, doubt-solving, recommendations); write clear PRDs/DRDs.
  • Partner with Engineering, Design and Data for fast, high-quality delivery; maintain backlog clarity across initiatives.

Experimentation & Prioritization

  • Run structured, hypothesis-driven experiments across the learning journey; read them honestly and kill bad bets.
  • Separate validated evidence from stakeholder assumption before committing engineering effort.
  • Prioritize a constrained roadmap and defend trade-offs.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Align Engineering, Design, Data, Curriculum and the Retention Head on a single prioritized roadmap.
  • Present recommendations - including 'no build' recommendations - to leadership with evidence.
  • Ensure learner privacy, data safety and ethical AI usage; own pre-launch QA and safe rollout.

What Success Looks Like

  • Improve new-learner activation rate (student reaches the first meaningful learning milestone) by an agreed % QoQ, owned end-to-end (hypothesis -> build -> measure -> iterate).
  • Reduce in-product drop-off at the weakest identified journey stage by an agreed % within 2 quarters of it being flagged.
  • Improve weekly-active-learner (WAL) rate and average course-progression velocity through product interventions (in-app nudges, streaks, resume-flows, personalization).
  • Ship statistically-sound product experiments every quarter across the learning journey, each with a documented hypothesis, result, and ship/kill/iterate decision.
  • Define, instrument, and own the Academy learning-product metric tree; every shipped initiative has a pre-defined success metric before engineering effort is committed.
  • Ship AI-first learning features (adaptive practice, doubt-solving, recommendations) that show measurable lift in progression or engagement for the targeted cohort.

Must-Have

  • Has owned a product surface end-to-end and can name an activation / engagement / retention / progression metric they personally moved, with a number.
  • Can walk through a real experiment: hypothesis, design, result, and the ship/kill/iterate decision it drove.
  • Comfortable doing their own funnel/cohort analysis (SQL or a product-analytics tool like Amplitude/Mixpanel).
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and multi-stakeholder pushback; can prioritize a constrained roadmap and defend the cuts.

Good-to-Have

  • EdTech / learning-science / gamification / subscription-growth experience - faster ramp on learner-journey mechanics.
  • Has built or briefed personalization / recommendation / adaptive-learning systems.
  • 0->1 product experience in an unstructured, low-process environment.

  • Hyderabad
  • MondayFriday (5 days)

Fixed + annual variable + retention component. Final structure by level and experience.

Position Summary

The incumbent will be responsible for market intelligence, competitor benchmarking, customer insights, product requirement inputs, commercialisation planning, scientific product communication, and product launch readiness.

The role will not be responsible for product engineering, technical development, regulatory documentation, brand strategy, or day-to-day marketing campaign execution. These responsibilities will remain with the respective functional teams. The role will provide product strategy, positioning, commercialisation, launch, and portfolio management inputs to support cross-functional business objectives.

Key Result Areas (KRAs)

1. Market Intelligence & Opportunity Assessment

Market Research & Customer Insights

  • Conduct market research to identify emerging healthcare trends, unmet customer needs and growth opportunities.
  • Gather market feedback from healthcare professionals, distributors, retailers, patients, caregivers and internal stakeholders.
  • Analyse market dynamics, category developments and industry trends.
  • Identify opportunities for portfolio expansion, category development and product line extensions.

Competitor Benchmarking

  • Monitor competitor products, innovations, pricing strategies, packaging formats and positioning approaches.
  • Conduct product benchmarking studies and comparative analyses.
  • Identify product differentiation opportunities and improvement recommendations.

Opportunity Evaluation

  • Support development of business cases for new product opportunities.
  • Evaluate commercial attractiveness, market potential and feasibility of new product concepts.
  • Present findings and recommendations to management for decision-making.

2. New Product Development Support

Product Requirement Definition

  • Translate customer and market insights into product requirement inputs.
  • Support development of Product Requirement Specifications (PRS) in collaboration with Design & Product Innovation and R&D teams.
  • Ensure customer, clinical and commercial requirements are adequately represented during product development discussions.

Cross-Functional NPD Coordination

  • Coordinate with Design & Product Innovation, R&D, Quality, Procurement and Manufacturing teams during NPD projects.
  • Monitor progress of assigned product development initiatives.
  • Support the timely completion of project milestones and launch readiness activities.

User Feedback & Validation Support

  • Coordinate user evaluations, clinician feedback sessions and product validation activities.
  • Collect and document user feedback for incorporation into product improvement initiatives.
  • Support product refinement discussions based on customer and healthcare professional insights.

3. Product Commercialisation & Launch Management

Commercialization & Go-to-Market Strategy

  • Lead the development and execution of commercialisation strategies for new products in collaboration with Marketing, Sales, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing.
  • Define product positioning, target customer segments, value propositions, pricing recommendations, and go-to-market plans for new product introductions.
  • Drive cross-functional launch readiness by ensuring alignment of product, commercial, operational, and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop launch success metrics and monitor achievement against commercialisation objectives.

Product Launch Management

  • Lead end-to-end product launch planning and execution to ensure the successful market introduction of new products.
  • Ensure timely availability of product literature, feature-benefit documentation, packaging content, training materials, sales enablement tools, and marketing collateral.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to address launch dependencies and mitigate risks impacting launch timelines.
  • Conduct post-launch reviews to evaluate market acceptance, sales performance, customer feedback, and achievement of launch objectives.

Product Lifecycle Management

  • Analyse market trends, customer insights, competitive developments, and sales performance to identify opportunities for portfolio optimisation.
  • Recommend product enhancements, line extensions, repositioning strategies, and product rationalisation initiatives based on business needs and market dynamics.
  • Develop and execute lifecycle management strategies to maximise product value and sustain long-term portfolio competitiveness.
  • Partner with Design & Development, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and Sales teams to drive continuous product improvement initiatives.

4. Scientific Product Communication

Product Knowledge Development

  • Develop scientifically accurate product information and technical content.
  • Develop and maintain product feature-benefit documentation, competitive product comparison matrices, and product knowledge resources for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop technical product descriptions and usage guidance content.

Scientific Content Support

  • Provide technical and scientific inputs for brochures, catalogues, packaging content, instructions for use, videos and digital product content.

Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About the Role

Harness is looking for a Staff Product Manager to define the future of Agentic Application Security. You will lead our Code Security and AI Security Agents portfolio, spanning static application security testing (SAST), AI-powered vulnerability triage, and autonomous remediation.

As AI coding agents transform how software is built, security must evolve beyond detecting vulnerabilities to autonomously investigating, validating, and fixing them at machine speed.

We are looking for a product leader who can help build autonomous security engineering systems that understand code, reason about security risks, generate secure fixes, and continuously validate outcomes across modern development environments.

What You'll Own
AI-Native Code Security: Own the strategy and roadmap for SAST, code analysis, reachability, exploitability, and AI-powered vulnerability discovery.
Autonomous Security Agents: Build intelligent triage and remediation agents that investigate findings, assess risk, generate fixes, and verify security outcomes.
Agentic Remediation Workflows: Drive autonomous repository analysis, multi-file code changes, dependency upgrades, test generation, regression validation, and pull request creation.
Agentic Developer Ecosystem: Integrate security into AI coding assistants, autonomous development agents, IDEs, SCM, and CI/CD workflows.
Next-Generation Security Testing: Explore LLM-driven security analysis, sandbox execution, exploit validation, and continuous security testing.
Product Strategy & Execution: Own product differentiation, customer engagement, roadmap execution, adoption, and business outcomes while partnering with engineering, security research, and go-to-market teams.
What We're Looking For
8+ years of product management experience in Application Security, AI Developer Tools, DevSecOps, or software engineering platforms.
Strong understanding of application security, SAST, vulnerability management, secure coding, and developer workflows.
Experience or strong technical familiarity with AI coding agents, LLM orchestration, tool calling, and autonomous software development.
Understanding of how agents reason over repositories, plan and execute tasks, modify code, run tests, and iteratively resolve failures.
Ability to translate advances in AI and software engineering into reliable, enterprise-grade products.
Proven experience driving product strategy, technical execution, customer adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
Strong technical judgment and ability to collaborate with engineering, security research, and executive stakeholders.
Nice to Have
Experience building autonomous coding agents, AI-native developer tools, or application security products.
Knowledge of code property graphs, dataflow analysis, reachability, exploitability, and software composition analysis.
Familiarity with multi-agent architectures, MCP, sandbox environments, agent memory, and feedback-driven execution.
Experience with automated vulnerability remediation, secure code generation, and verification workflows.
Background in software engineering, security engineering, or AI/ML.
Why Join Harness?

Help define the next generation of application security, where intelligent agents don't just identify vulnerabilities but autonomously investigate, remediate, and verify them.

At Harness, you'll work at the intersection of AI, application security, and software engineering to build security products designed for a world where humans and AI agents develop software together.

What You Will Have at Harness

Competitive salary
Comprehensive healthcare benefits
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave
Quarterly Harness TGIF-Off / 4 days
Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team-building events
Recharge & Reset Program
Monthly internet reimbursement
Commuter benefits
Harness in the news:
Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

Founded in 2015, ShareChat has social media brands such as the ShareChat App and Moj App and micro drama app QuickTV under its portfolio. QuickTV, the newest addition to ShareChat’s family of apps, crossed the 10 million downloads mark within 3 months of launch and currently has 60Mn MAUs across the network viewing the vertical episodic content.
Today, the ShareChat network maintains a whopping 1,000 Cr ARR and is India’s leading social media platform servicing users across the country in 15 regional languages. This growth has led to a 28% YoY revenue growth in the July-Sept (2025-26) quarter and increased it by more than 60% in the Oct-Dec quarter.

What does the team do?
We’re a lean, high-ownership product team running two of ShareChat’s newest bets. Magic Share is an AI-first app for creating personalised, shareable content in your language, from festival wishes to business posters. We own its growth, subscription monetisation and the scaling of AI-led supply. ShareChat Supply is the creator marketplace behind the platform. We build creator monetisation, improve creation quality, bring AI into the creator economy and scale creation across short video, episodic and personalised content. You’ll work directly with the product lead and own features from PRD to experiment readout.

What You’ll Do
AI-Native Product Building (Must-Have):
You build things yourself instead of stopping at the spec. You should be able to independently:
Prototype ideas using AI tools (e.g., Claude, other LLMs, no-code tools, lightweight scripts) as part of your daily workflow
Build quick MVPs, experiments, or internal tools to validate hypotheses before engineering bandwidth is committed
Use AI for rapid iteration across UX, content, analysis and decisioning
Feature Ownership: Own features end to end across two product lines: Magic Share (a subscription consumer app) and SC Supply (Creator Earnings Program, creation flow and Cashout). This covers problem discovery, PRDs, working with design and tech, rollout and the post-launch readout.
Growth & Monetisation: Drive growth on Magic Share across onboarding and funnel conversion, trial-to-paid, retention, notifications, localisation and the marketing-to-onboarding flow. Track trials, cancellations and CAC vs. LTV.
Supply Scale-Up: Drive SC Supply product work, including scaling the Creator Earnings Program beyond its pilot and pulling the levers that improve supply quality.
Data-Driven Decisions: Own the analytics for everything you ship: instrumentation specs, A/B experiment design and readouts, dashboards and RCAs. You should be able to read your own experiments and build your own funnels using SQL, without waiting on an analyst.
Agile Execution: Own QA and testing (QA plans, on-device verification), bug triage, getting fixes through tech and sprint follow-through. Work daily with engineers and designers to ensure high-quality, high-speed delivery.
Collaboration: Work directly with the product lead and coordinate with cross-functional teams including Design, Engineering, Marketing and Creator teams to align launches with business goals.

Who you are
3-4 years of experience in the product field, including analytics, with at least 1-2 years as a consumer or growth PM/APM in a B2C product company.
Product + Analytics: You have done both product and analytics work. You have written PRDs and shipped features end to end. Profiles with only analyst or SPA experience and no hands-on product ownership will not be a fit.
Analytical Rigor: Strong hands-on proficiency in SQL is mandatory. You have worked with product instrumentation and A/B testing, and you can turn ambiguous problems into measurable metrics.
First Principles Thinking: You don’t follow “best practices” blindly. You break problems down to their core units and reason upward.
Background: You come from a product-first B2C organisation, ideally with a strong academic background, and you are comfortable working through ambiguity.
Execution Mindset: A “bias for action.” You prefer a launched product that can be iterated upon over a perfect plan that never sees the light of day.
AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools like Claude day to day for research, analysis, specs and prototyping.
Language & Culture: An understanding of India’s diverse cultural and linguistic landscape is a massive plus.

Where Will You Be?
Bangalore (Hybrid)

What’s In It For You?
At ShareChat, our values (Ownership, Speed, User Empathy, Integrity, and First Principles) are at the core of our ways of working. We believe in hiring top talent and grooming future leaders by providing a flexible environment to aid growth and development.
Our Elite Benefits Suite:
Wealth & Security: ESOPs and comprehensive insurance coverage.
Lifestyle: Hybrid working culture, Gym allowance, and Zomato coupons.
Family Support: Monthly childcare allowance for women employees.
And Many more…

Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection.

What We Offer

At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.

Group Summary

Magna is more than one of the world’s largest suppliers in the automotive space. We are a mobility technology company built to innovate, with a global, entrepreneurial-minded team. With 65+ years of expertise, our ecosystem of interconnected products combined with our complete vehicle expertise uniquely positions us to advance mobility in an expanded transportation landscape.

Job Responsibilities

We are seeking a Technical Product Manager to lead the definition, delivery, and scaling of analytical products powered by machine learning and emerging GenAI capabilities. This role will translate business needs into product roadmaps, prioritized backlogs, and production-ready solutions, working closely with data scientists, engineers, architects, business stakeholders, and governance teams. The ideal candidate combines strong technical fluency in AI/ML and cloud platforms with hands-on product leadership and Agile delivery experience.

Major Responsibilities

Define and own product vision, strategy, roadmap, and release priorities for analytical, machine learning, and selected GenAI products.
Partner with business stakeholders and end users to identify high-value problems, validate needs, and translate them into product requirements, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery and business case development through MVP, pilot, production rollout, adoption, and value realization.
Work with data science and engineering teams to shape ML-driven and GenAI-enabled solutions, including appropriate RAG-based use cases, with focus on usability, technical feasibility, and responsible deployment.
Own the product backlog and delivery cadence; facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
Lead and coordinate a cross-functional product squad of approximately 4-5 team members, aligning dependencies across architecture, engineering, data, security, and business teams.
Define product success metrics and monitor adoption, product performance, and business impact such as productivity, quality, cost, or cycle-time improvement.
Communicate roadmap, progress, dependencies, risks, and realized outcomes to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

Knowledge and Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Business/Technology Management, or a related field.
Agile, Scrum, Product Owner, or Product Management certification is preferred.

Work Experience

3 - 5 years of experience in technical product management or product ownership, with demonstrated experience developing analytical or data products, particularly machine learning-enabled solutions.
Experience delivering AI/ML products across discovery, development, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement stages.
Experience with GenAI products or use cases is preferred, including familiarity with LLM-enabled applications, RAG, MCP etc. concepts.
Experience leading or managing a small cross-functional delivery team or squad of approximately 3 – 4 members.

Skills And Competencies Required To Perform The Job

Product Management: Ability to create product strategies and roadmaps, manage priorities, develop business cases, write clear requirements and user stories, and balance user value with technical feasibility.
Analytical and ML Products: Sound understanding of the machine learning product lifecycle, data needs, model performance considerations, deployment dependencies, and product monitoring.
GenAI Concepts: Working understanding of LLM-enabled applications, embeddings, vector search, prompt considerations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and evaluation fundamentals.
Cloud Platforms: Working knowledge of AWS and Azure platforms and how cloud data, analytics, and AI/ML services support product development and deployment.
Agile Delivery: Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies, Scrum or Kanban practices, sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
Team Leadership: Ability to guide a small cross-functional team, resolve delivery blockers, align dependencies, and foster ownership and accountability.
Stakeholder Communication: Ability to translate technical AI/ML concepts into business terms and clearly communicate decisions, progress, risks, and value to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Business Value Measurement: Experience defining KPIs and measuring adoption, efficiency gains, cost impact, quality improvements, cycle-time reduction, or other product outcomes.
Governance and Responsible AI: Awareness of security, data privacy, model risk, responsible AI, and governance considerations when delivering AI-enabled products.
Tools: Experience with product delivery and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Power BI, Confluence, or equivalent platforms.

Working Conditions and Environment

No Travel

Any Additional Information

Excellent English communication skills, both spoken and written.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-making abilities.
Ability to collaborate effectively across product, business, technology, and governance teams.

Awareness, Unity, Empowerment

At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.

AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure

As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.

Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision-making.

If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.

Regular / Permanent

Group

Magna Corporate

Key Responsibilities

Own the delivery plan for the Hospital Management Information System across all three phases — sequence, dependencies, and the critical path to the first hospital go-live
Drive the product roadmap for the modules hospitals actually use, and hold the line between what a customer asks for and what belongs in the product
Collaborate across engineering, design, domain and clinical advisors to define success measures, priorities and implementation plans; manage each module from concept through to go-live
Own scope and change control with the customer, using the later phases as the pressure valve when scope grows
Develop the implementation plans, processes and workflows that make a rollout repeatable from the second hospital onwards
Be the single point of accountability for whether the programme ships, when, and whether the customer knows

Voice of Customer

Translate what doctors, nurses, billing staff and hospital management need into user stories, through continuous discovery — floor visits, interviews, and time spent watching the work as it is actually done
Use both usage data and direct feedback to judge whether a feature is working, and to inform what comes next
Analyse trade-offs across customer value, clinical benefit, cost and effort
Run regular demos with the hospital and bring the reaction back to the team the same week
Carry the relationship day to day: the standing update, the escalation, and the uncomfortable conversation about scope or dates

Delivery Oversight

Prioritise work through an ordered backlog of user stories with clear timelines, and keep two sprints of ready, unambiguous work in front of the team
Define and communicate acceptance criteria drawn from business and customer needs
Run planning, stand-up, review and retrospective — short, decided, and worth attending
Track progress against the plan honestly, and report slippage the week it becomes likely rather than the month it becomes certain
Own the risk log, and the closing of the items on it
Own the go-live and hypercare plan with the customer: cutover sequence, training schedule, who is on the floor on day one, and what the rollback looks like
Keep the decision log — decisions taken in a corridor and never written down get re-litigated a month later

Team Enablement

Engage with the team regularly to give feedback on work in progress and to clarify requirements
Coordinate with the founder and the technical leads on resourcing, sequencing and where specialist expertise is needed
Remove blockers — chase the decision, get the access, find the missing answer, clear the dependency
Provide performance management feedback for team members
Protect the team from mid-sprint interruption, and say no on their behalf

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's degree in any discipline, or equivalent work experience — this role is not a technical position and no engineering background is required
Six or more years running software delivery in teams of eight or more, with clear personal ownership of dates and commitments, as a product manager, delivery manager, programme manager or scrum master who did more than facilitate
Proven experience driving and scaling high-performing teams without being their technical leader
Strong communication skills, with the ability to hold a room containing a hospital's medical superintendent and a room containing engineers on the same day, and to explain each to the other
Customer-first mindset, with the judgement to say no to a customer and yes to the product
Comfortable saying "this will be late" early, and to whoever needs to hear it
Experience facilitating requirement discovery sessions to understand business context, user intent and solution objectives
Experience taking a product from concept to launch in front of real users
Experience collaborating with development teams on feasibility assessment and change management
Able to follow a technical discussion well enough to know what is being decided and what it costs, without making the call yourself
Highly organised, with proactive resource and dependency management
Experience with JIRA or similar backlog and project management tools
Willing to travel to the pilot hospital regularly and to be on site through go-live
Preferred experience in hospital, healthcare or another regulated environment where a bad release has consequences beyond a refund
Preferred experience of an enterprise implementation involving data migration, staff training and a hard cutover date
Preferred exposure to Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled products

Job Description

AuxoAI is a global platform-based services firm helping companies turn strategies into practical digital and AI solutions. We use digital and Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies to drive growth, enhance operations, improve customer experiences, and provide actionable insights from data.

What We Do

We work across industries like healthcare, high-tech, CPG, and finance in sales, marketing, and customer support functions. We accelerate digital and AI journeys through:

AI Application Development
Data, Digital and Cloud acceleration using AI
AI Native Product Engineering

Role Summary

AuxoAI is seeking a Product Manager / Product Owner with deep, hands-on expertise in configuring and implementing payroll on SaaS HCM platforms (UKG Pro, Workday, Oracle HCM Cloud, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP, Dayforce). This is a domain-first, client-facing role ideal for a payroll solution or functional consultant who wants to apply that expertise to AI-powered products.

Responsibilities

Map current-state implementation and onboarding processes to identify bottlenecks.
Design future-state processes with measurable gains in cycle time and accuracy.
Own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog; write epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Prioritize AI use cases such as document extraction, requirements mapping, rules validation, and test automation.
Act as the authority on payroll and HCM configuration, codifying SME knowledge into business rules.
Define success metrics, support pilot delivery, and shape the roadmap from pilot to scale.

Requirements

8+ years in HR and payroll technology, including 5+ years configuring/implementing payroll on SaaS HCM platforms.
Expertise in company/legal entity setup, tax setup, pay groups, earnings, deductions, and data conversion.
At least two full-lifecycle payroll implementations as a solution/functional consultant.
Strong command of US payroll terminology.
Experience writing requirements for engineering teams as a Product Owner or Business Analyst.
Working understanding of AI products (LLMs, document extraction) and hands-on use of AI tools.

This Director , product Management will be responsible for designing, developing, and overseeing innovations in core Clearwater investment data management platform namely Single Data Plane . Our market leading, cloud native, single instance multi-tenant architecture intakes data from thousands of sources and creates a golden source of truth.

Reporting to VP, Product Management based in the U.S, this role will oversee defining the product requirements and planning its development to production and working closely with clients to make them successful. Additionally, the Product Manager is tasked with crafting the product roadmap necessary to achieve bookings, client NPS, and gross margin targets associated with their component. 

To facilitate growth, the product manager will collaborate with internal stakeholders, clients, and prospects to identify new product capability requirements. They maintain close collaboration with their development teams to ensure the successful creation and introduction of these new capabilities to the market. Furthermore, the Product Manager takes charge of testing and implementing these fresh features with clients and actively promotes future growth to a broader audience of Clearwater clients and prospects. 



Responsibilities: 

Team Span: responsible for handling 2 – 3 scrum teams spanning 12 – 15 engineers 
Continuously evaluate current data platform, and build a short (0 – 6 months), medium (6 – 12 months) and longer-term roadmap for a highly scalable, automated and resilient data platform 
Prioritize decisions across products with data driven justification 
Establish alignment on the product roadmap among multiple development teams. 
Efficiently lead the development of cross-product capabilities. 
Contribute to the formulation of the department's development and training plan. 
Advocate for a culture of communication throughout the organization. 
Build release specific product briefs that articulate the client problem for target personas, value, priority and high-level approach 
Keep current with latest technology development in data management, competitors and apply those insights to CW product strategy and execution. 



Required Skills: 

Prior experience in Investment management industry with strong knowledge of Security Reference, Trade, Analytics, Pricing, Accounting(ABOR/IBOR) , Performance, Custody data domains is a must have. 
Proven ability to manage roadmaps for data Ingestion platforms , Data management feature/functions (Data Quality, Data Governance, Information delivery etc.) including execution, implementation, and influencing skills within the asset management space. 
8+ years of experience of as a Product Manager (Ideal but not vital) that owns all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle in a B2B enterprise SaaS environment. 
Knowledge of investments and investment accounting (Very important) 
At least 5 years of experience in structured financial data management platforms across one or more of these: master data management, ETL/ELT, data warehousing or data lake house 
Exemplary interpersonal, communication, and project management skills 
Excellent team and relationship building abilities, with both internal and external parties (engineers, business stakeholders, partners, etc.). 
Ability to work well under pressure, multitask, and maintain keen attention to detail. 
Strong leadership skills, including ability to influence via diplomacy and tact.

Role Overview

DrinkPrime runs a subscription business built on physical hardware. Our internal operations span finance, hardware production, inventory, procurement, warehousing, and field deployment. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager for Internal Business Systems to map how these workflows run today, design better ways of working, and convert them into clear system requirements that engineering can build against.
This is an internal systems and process role, not a consumer product role. You do not need to be a finance or hardware expert, but you do need to be exceptional at process thinking, data discipline, stakeholder management, and execution.

What You Will Do
Map current-state workflows across finance, hardware production, inventory, procurement, warehouse, and operations.
Identify the gaps causing data mismatch, manual work, delays, duplication, and unclear ownership.
Design improved workflows — including draft business rules, approval flows, and exception handling. Drive stakeholders toward a clear recommendation and decision
Define source-of-truth logic for key business data: inventory, hardware units, vendors, invoices, production batches, stock movement, and deployment.
Own the roadmap for internal business systems, and convert workflow design into clear, stable, well-prioritised product requirements.
Produce clear documentation like SOPs, process flows, and requirement specs, and monitor enforcement.
Enable adoption of new workflows: training, rollout support, and tracking whether process and data quality are genuinely improving

Requirements

What We Require
DrinkPrime is a Bengaluru-based consumer technology company making clean drinking water more accessible through IoT-enabled water purifiers offered on subscription. We serve over one lakh customers across Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, and Hyderabad.
Our business combines consumer technology, connected hardware, field operations, supply chain, and subscription economics at scale. As we grow, we are investing in stronger internal systems and processes that give teams reliable data, clear ownership, and scalable ways of working.
4+ years in product management, business systems, internal tools, business analysis, ERP or systems implementation, operations systems, or B2B workflow products.
Hands-on ownership of at least one internal business system end-to-end. You have implemented, migrated, or significantly extended a named system — ERP, WMS, inventory, procurement, invoicing, or equivalent. Having used such a system does not qualify.
Direct experience with operational or physical-goods workflows — production, inventory, warehouse, logistics, supply chain, or finance operations.

What We Also Expect
Strong process-mapping and structured problem-solving skills.
Ability to convert ambiguous business problems into clear product requirements.
Working fluency in data quality, source-of-truth design, exception handling, and reporting.
Comfort operating with non-technical stakeholders across finance, operations, production, warehouse, and procurement.
Strong written communication and documentation discipline.
The ability to push for clarity and constructively challenge weak process ownership.

Success In This Role

Research ideas translated into high-quality MVPs within short cycles

Clear feedback loop improving both product and research outcomes

Why Join Us

We're Osome - an international fintech startup making the lives of entrepreneurs easier. We help thousands of businesses kick admin, accounting and bookkeeping out of their day-to-day, so they can spend more time on what's important to them. We've developed a unique solution that combines SaaS with a human-in-the-loop approach to provide full-fledged services in real-time.
We’re experiencing rapid growth in both client base and team, which now comprises around 500 people across our offices worldwide. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for more bright minds who are excited to make a real impact by solving complex problems.

What To Expect
Intelligence builds the AI capabilities no single team at Osome should carry alone, and helps every other team ship AI well. It works in three modes. It owns cross-cutting capability. It enables product teams by pairing with their engineers, so the pattern transfers and the team runs it afterwards. It incubates only by exception: building inside another team's area when that team has no capacity, always with a written hand-back plan.

This is a hands-on PM role. You'll find problems by talking to end users, dig into the data in BigQuery and Postgres to prioritise, prototype cheaply before committing engineering effort, and ship small fixes yourself. You'll also be the team's main liaison with Operations.

What You'll Do
Own the Intelligence roadmap, OKRs and delivery, with two or three big bets each quarter. You make the prioritisation calls, own the business outcome behind the backlog, and write the release notes when things ship.
Set the evaluation bar for AI across Osome: eval datasets, confidence thresholds, human-review sampling and go/no-go gates.
With our Security team, set the safety and data-handling bar for AI across Osome: escalation rules, pre-action checks on agents, fail-open vs fail-closed behaviour, privacy and retention, client data isolation, and provider governance (e.g. zero data retention agreements).
Define the success metrics for each AI product before it ships, then keep checking the data yourself after launch to see whether it's working. Brief the analyst on what to build, and review the result. Use that evidence to make model and provider calls, e.g. benchmark a new model against our own labelled documents before switching.
Break epics into clear stories and tasks that engineers can pick up without a meeting. Pair with product teams' engineers to build AI features, and define what "successfully handed over" means.
Be the team's liaison with Operations: run training and feedback rounds, collect baseline data, and drive adoption until the AI version beats the manual process.
Run a small research track: test new techniques and approaches (e.g. retrieval, memory or agent patterns) on our own problems, and write up what we should adopt and what we should skip.
Represent this team's priorities to senior stakeholders.
As the team grows, mentor other PMs and help manage them.

Who You Are
Evaluated against our PM capability framework. At the Senior PM level, that means:
Strategic impact: you can define and drive a strategy spanning 12 months or more for a platform-style team whose customers are other teams, tied to a company-level goal such as gross margin.
Domain ownership: you own the OKRs, roadmap and business outcome of a complex, ambiguous, cross-functional area. You understand applied LLM/ML products deeply (evaluation, retrieval, memory, agent safety), and can become credible in our accounting and operations domain within two quarters.
Collaboration: you drive high adoption of new tools with operations teams, including the processes needed to run them. You build consensus among senior leaders with conflicting goals, and you can say no while leaving the stakeholder feeling heard.
Problem-solving: you map ambiguous, system-level problems, and know when a rule, a classifier or an LLM is the right tool.
Execution: you reliably ship complex, cross-functional launches involving Operations and other product teams. You prototype to de-risk before committing engineering time, and you spot risks early.
AI-literacy: hands-on well beyond prompting. You build prototypes and ship small PRs with AI coding tools, build eval datasets and run model experiments, read traces, and judge where models fail.
Leadership: you shape direction across teams you don't manage, improve how the team works, and are ready to mentor at least one other PM as a player-coach.

What you bring
AI/ML features shipped to production, with quality measured after launch (accuracy, coverage, deflection).
Experience building evaluation datasets and running model experiments: thresholds, go/no-go gates, human-in-the-loop decisions, and reading traces in an observability tool (we use Langfuse) to see where models fail.
Experience shipping AI features that handle sensitive or financial data, and deciding when they should escalate to a human or stop.
Daily use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to read code and ship small changes.
Strong SQL. You can pick the right metrics for a product and explain what you need to an analyst. Data modelling is not required.
Experience working directly with operations teams: running training, collecting feedback, and proving time saved against a manual baseline.
A track record of good calls under ambiguity, and of checking afterwards whether they were right.
(Nice to have) Setting company-wide safety and data-handling rules for AI: fail-open vs fail-closed policies, privacy and retention, and client data isolation, including knowing when a new AI vendor needs a security review before it sees any data.
(Nice to have) Bookkeeping or accounting literacy: enough double-entry, chart-of-accounts and GST/VAT knowledge to judge whether an AI accounts review or document check is right. Either a qualification or hands-on bookkeeping experience counts.
(Nice to have) Document AI/OCR in production: classifying or extracting invoices, bank statements and receipts, and the trade-offs between coverage, accuracy, confidence thresholds and cost.
(Nice to have) Agentic systems or MCP in production: agents or tools that take real actions, with permissions, human approval steps and multi-step evaluation.

Our Benefits
Multi-cultural environment to enhance your global perspective.
Learning opportunities and mentorship from peers and leaders.
Remote working arrangement.
An agile working model focused on goals and performance.

Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. AI Specialists don’t get better by accident. Hill climbing is how we improve them. We test against real customer environments, find what’s failing, fix it, and test again. Now we want every AI Specialist team to climb this way, faster, and without needing us to run it for them. You’ll own the product and the program that make that happen.

Own the hill climbing product roadmap and scale it across our priority AI Specialists and beyond.

Cut the loop time from a shipped change to a clear, actionable quality verdict from weeks to days. 
Convert eval findings into prioritized fixes with specialist product teams, and stay with those teams until the fixes ship. 
Turn hill climbing into a method product teams can run on their own, with the tools, guides and defaults to do it well and without heavy support from our team.

Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

You’ve owned a product roadmap and scaled a product from one team to many. 
You’ve run fast improvement loops on ML or LLM systems, from experiments and error analysis to prioritized fixes that shipped. 
You’ve taken a process that needed expert support and turned it into a tool or method other teams use without you in the room. 
You can line up product, engineering and business teams behind one plan and keep it moving. 
You have experience with agentic AI, enterprise workflow software or the ServiceNow platform.

Job Description:

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Cloudera is seeking a Senior Product Manager for the Cloudera Manager product. This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for one of the key lifecycle management tools serving the largest global enterprises across all industries including finance, manufacturing, tech and federal. Cloudera Manager is responsible for the lifecycle of mission critical clusters with thousands of nodes and petabytes of data.

In this role, you will lead and execute on a strategy to ensure Cloudera Manager provides enterprise capabilities with the ease of data SaaS products from on-premises to cloud. You will grow Cloudera Manager to be a tool once used by engineers to an experience that is straight forward for any data platform manager. You will partner closely with Engineering, PMO, Product Marketing, and Field organizations to deliver a market-leading experience in hybrid cloud.

As a Senior Product Manager you will:

Drive Intelligent Product Experiences: Shift the product strategy from infinite customization to a simplified user experience that provides optimal settings no matter the cluster configuration and active guardrails to eliminate operational fragility to prevent self-inflicted outages. Incorporate configuration recommendations, actionable health alerts, and actionable bad-configuration warnings directly into the product using AI trained on Cloudera’s knowledge base and real-time observability telemetry.
Simplify Accessibility for IT Generalists: Design intuitive workflows and self-guided administrative tools tailored for IT generalists with minimal big data expertise, making documentation a secondary resource and lowering the barrier to platform management.
Embed Intelligence: Execute Hybrid Architecture Modernization: Lead the long-term evolution of Cloudera Manager into an orchestrator of clusters across multiple clouds allowing customers to deploy use cases in a hybrid cloud topology.
Achieve Uninterrupted Core Operations at Scale: Optimize fundamental cluster lifecycle operations to manage environments up to 10,000 nodes, ensuring refresh and maintenance operations on 1,000+ node clusters execute within customer approved SLAs.
Define Predictable Lifecycle & API Guarantees: Establish and enforce structured release lifecycle policies that guarantee public API stability and backward compatibility to remove upgrade friction for enterprise customers.
Track Operational Success Metrics: Monitor and continuously improve key performance indicators, specifically focusing on increasing operational velocity, boosting prescriptive feature adoption rates, and reducing support escalation volumes.


We are excited if you have:

Bsc/Msc in related field or equivalent experience
Enterprise Platform Experience: 5+ years of experience in the enterprise software space with at least 2 years of Product Management experience. Strong foundational understanding of open datalakes, data movement, enterprise data governance, and big data architecture. 
On-Premise Knowledge: Basic technical understanding of virtualization, data center networking 
Public Cloud Knowledge: Basic technical understanding of VM-based public cloud deployments (IaaS/PaaS), object storage architectures (S3, ADLS, GCS), and network architectures for at least one major hyperscaler (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform).
Simplification & UX Modernization: Demonstrated success in transforming complex, developer-centric platforms into intuitive, "opinionated" products with active guardrails that eliminate manual operational friction.


You might also have:

CSP Partner Ecosystem Experience: Direct experience working with or within major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including partner co-development, cloud marketplace programs, or cloud-native integrations.
Competitive Landscape Awareness: Strong knowledge of modern cloud data platforms and competitive solutions, such as Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery/Bigtable, Amazon EMR/Redshift, or Azure Synapse.
Modern Datalakehouse Formats: Familiarity with open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg) and multi-cloud data architecture strategies.
Data Platform Administrative Experience: Strong background with managing enterprise platforms or supporting customers running enterprise scale deployments with over 100 Terabytes of data.

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Product Manager-Platform to be part of making this/that happen.

Position Overview And Objective

This Technical Product Manager role drives requirements, execution, and delivery for reliable, scalable data lake infrastructure and intelligent AI/ML capabilities that power Arctic Wolf’s security products and platform operations. The TPM translates complex business, security, and operational needs into clear product requirements and technical specifications—initially supporting 1–2 engineering squads (scaling to 2+) across sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, and milestone tracking. The role collaborates closely with Data Engineers, Data Science Engineers, Platform Architects and cross-functional stakeholders to support use cases such as log availability, telemetry analysis, threat detection, and intelligent alerting while ensuring solutions adhere to robust data security, privacy, and governance standards. The role requires foundational technical fluency in distributed data systems and AI/ML lifecycles, Agile execution, and the ability to represent data platform capabilities authoritatively to integrating teams.

Owns the product backlog and delivery execution for 1–2 engineering squads (growing to 2+), managing prioritization, dependencies, risk mitigation, and on-time release milestones.
Collaborates with stakeholders (Platform Engineering, Data Science teams, Security Operations, and Architecture) to assess system capabilities, onstraints, and architectural trade-offs.
Validates, where possible, that High-Level Designs (HLDs) cover all validated use cases, data processing workflows, and performance requirements for platform features.
Presents direction, roadmaps, and delivery status for data platform and intelligent capabilities to development teams and consuming product stakeholders.
Answers authoritatively questions from teams integrating against data platform APIs, pipelines, and data access layers: what is supported today, what needs to be specified, and what is out of scope.
Identifies high-demand, heavy-lift platform requests, cost-optimization opportunities, and emerging AI use cases for consideration in future strategy and planning sessions.

Knowledge of Product Management discipline, requirements definition, and Agile/Scrum ceremonies and practices.
Educational background in Computer Science or Software Engineering, or 2–5 years of equivalent technical/product experience.
Foundational understanding of distributed data systems, data pipelines, relational/non-relational data modeling, REST APIs, and cloud infrastructure components (e.g., AWS, GCP).
Familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals and lifecycle concepts (e.g., training datasets, model evaluation metrics, inference pipelines, anomaly detection, or NLP).
Understanding of data governance, security, privacy, and compliance standards.
Begins to develop a system-level approach, understanding how data platform architecture, query performance, and indexing decisions ripple across consuming security products and operational costs.
Exposure to security concepts such as logging pipelines, telemetry analysis, monitoring, or threat detection systems a plus.

Complexity and Problem Solving

Collaborates with Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, Data Science Engineers, and internal stakeholders to maintain backlog priority, sizing, and acceptance criteria for data platform and AI enablement work.
Communicates and escalates unexpected delays, cross-team blockers, data quality issues, or non-prioritized asks from integrating teams.
